chapters.title: Chapter 451 - Make a Choice
paragraphs: “Commander believes that you know the whole process of vaccine development the best. So he hopes you can make the decision. No matter what the final outcome is, we will bear the consequences together and do our best to save this world.”
“Hint: You have triggered the mission of the next stage, the eighteenth stage ring mission, the unstable vaccine.”
“Mission Name: The unstable vaccine.

Mission Description: With your help, Dark Knights have finished the unstable vaccine by developing the first-generation meteorite. This vaccine may cause mutation of the first-generation virus, or it may completely eliminate the zombie virus and make this world return to peace.
Mission Requirements: Please make your choice.
“Hint: Your choice will greatly affect the follow-up storyline of the game. Please think carefully before making a choice.”
Fang Heng looked at the game hint and stroked his chin.
He had to make a choice?
That meant he had to bet on the probability?
Come on!
Fang Heng thought that he would encounter trouble later no matter what his choice was. It was nothing more than a choice between the easy and the challenging levels.
Choosing to release the vaccine seemed more uncontrollable, and the risk factor was higher.
“Genius, why don’t you make a safer choice?”
Mo Jiawei suggested reducing the risk.
He had a clear mind.
In comparison, Fang Heng had put so much effort into District 7 for a long time and even discovered something about the hila experiment. Yet he still hadn’t completed the mission.
However, there hadn’t been any news about the hila experiment in District 8 yet. How could they save the world just like that?
Obviously, there was a trap!
Fang Heng did not make any decision immediately. Instead, he asked, “If we choose to shelve the vaccine release for now, how long will it take us to obtain the vaccine that is confirmed to be safe?”
Everyone present turned their gazes to Qiu Yaokang simultaneously.
“It’s hard to say. There are too many factors that can affect the vaccine’s development. A single mutation could change everything. It could be a year or countless decades.”
Fang Heng’s heart sank.
He also wanted to reduce the risk, but there wasn’t enough time.
Fang Heng would be exposed on the main storyline contribution points leaderboard rankings of District 8 in one and a half days.
Even if he spent all his King of Gods’ points delaying his exposure, there would be another week at the most.
On the day he was exposed, Night Owl organization would find out that District 8 had restarted the main storyline mission.
They would likely continue to make trouble.
Besides, there were also the gaming unions and Federation in District 8.
Even Kou Huai from District 7 would interfere and cause him some trouble.
At that time, the secret that he had possessed Tier 3 space tearing device might also be exposed to the outsiders.
The more Fang Heng thought about it, the more he felt bothered.
He could almost foresee many troublesome things that would happen soon.
He had to hurry up!
Fang Heng felt that he had to make a risky choice.
Although he had a feeling that it would be a trap, he had no choice but to jump in.
Fang Heng decided to struggle a little more.
“How about we make a compromise between the two options? What if we set up a small area for testing?”

David was very conflicted. He said, “It’s quite difficult to control the mutations. Testing in a small area is not meaningful. We have to at least expand the test to the entire region. But this way, the released vaccine viruses will spread through the air, water, and soil. Then we’ll probably lose control of the whole process.”
Qiu Yaokang shook his head and said, “No, we can get more information and optimize the vaccine only if we test in a large area.”
“But it’s too risky.”

David was worried. He continued, “If any accident happens, the virus will mutate after being stimulated. It’s likely to cause the vaccine to fail. Also, the zombie virus will possibly evolve into a super virus. By then, we might even destroy the world with our own hands.”

“There is indeed such a possibility, but I think it’s the most effective choice if we bet on it. Otherwise, we might not have any breakthrough even if we spend ten years,” Qiu Yaokang said. “Fang Heng, this is up to you. What do you think?”
Fang Heng was in a dilemma.
What should he do?
They were both traps.
He could only choose a shallow one.
Fang Heng scratched his hair, feeling a little upset.
He was about to answer when a thought flashed through his mind.
“Wait a minute, Qiu Yaokang. In fact, we only need to get the test data of the released vaccines before optimizing them, right?”
David puzzlingly said, “But, Fang Heng, we have to carry out a large-scale test to get the data, and the test will have a probability of mutation.”
Qiu Yaokang raised his eyebrows. He vaguely understood the hidden meaning of what Fang Heng said.
“Fang Heng, do you mean the parallel world?”
“Yes!”
Fang Heng nodded and said, “Since it’s too dangerous to test the vaccine here, I can do it in the parallel world. I believe that they will be very willing to help me.”
“That’s right! We can carry the risk to District 7!”
Hearing that, Mo Jiawei shouted out loud and clapped his hands.
He thought Fang Heng’s idea was absolutely brilliant.
If they threw the vaccine into District 7, the worst outcome would be the destruction of that district, and Federation would be screwed.
However, they would be able to collect the relevant information about the vaccine in District 7.

Suppose they were lucky that the vaccine solved the zombie virus problem. In that case, Fang Heng could earn a large number of main storyline contribution points and immediately complete the main storyline in District 7. Then he could occupy that district.
It would be a sure win anyway!
Qiu Yaokang closed his eyes and carefully considered the plan proposed by Fang Heng. He nodded and said, “Your plan is theoretically feasible.”
“But...” David was a little hesitant. “But the unstable vaccine might also have a destructive effect on the parallel world. Shouldn’t we first communicate with Dark Knights in that world?”
Fang Heng felt rather guilty.
He thought to himself, “Just forget about Dark Knights in District 7.”
They were now enemies.
“I’ll go and communicate with them. David, that world is terrible. We have to hurry. This is the best way to save the world.”
“Okay.”
David stopped insisting.

Qiu Yaokang nodded and said, “Alright, I’ll get someone to organize the information and give you a sample of the vaccine and its production method. I need to follow up on the research plan in real time and get all information related to the vaccine immediately.”
“That means I have to deliver the message between District 7 and District 8 every day, right?”
Fang Heng rubbed his shoulder and agreed.
“Well, okay.”
Then, there was a question in Fang Heng’s mind.
“After getting the vaccine, should I throw it to District 5 or 7?
Should I take the risk to Federation in District 7 or the anti-Federal organizations in District 5?”
After a short thought, Fang Heng had an answer.
“Go to District 7!”
District 5 lacked a research room. He could hardly complete the vaccine production, experimental materials sample collection, and sample analysis of the final experiment in a short time.
Yet, he could use the strength of Scavenger Army in District 7.
Considering the time, he knew the best choice was to go to District 7.

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - The Fourth Stage
paragraphs: Federation headquarters in District 7.
Everyone was silent.
Overnight, the five shelters under Federation in the White Horse River region were attacked by the fusion Tyrant forms and were utterly destroyed.
“This is the report from the headquarters just now.”

The head of the intelligence department, Xiao Changle, passed down the file. He said in a deep voice, “Based on the images we obtained last night, we can now confirm that District 7 has entered the fourth stage in the game, the mutant worm form diffusion stage.
It was the high-level mutated zombies who attacked the shelter last night. They were a fusion of zombies and mutant worms.”
While the commanders were reading the report, Xiao Changle continued to explain.

“The fusion mutant worm form zombie was modified according to the Nemesis Plan of the previous Meteorite Company. Its strength is close to Tier 5. In addition, the mutated zombie has a skill that is difficult for us to deal with. It can reproduce the mutant worms.”
The picture on the big screen in the meeting room was switched to a photo of purple worms.
“As you can see, the fusion mutant worm form zombies can spread such tiny worms.

These worms are very dangerous. They can quickly infect the players in a short time. Due to their small size, they can even easily bypass the defensive settings outside the players’ shelter and directly attack the players guarding inside.
This kind of attack mode is rather challenging to guard against.”
As Kou Huai quickly flipped through the report, the veins on his forehead bulged.
It was the fourth stage of the game!
In the game’s history, only one server had experienced the fourth stage, which was some game region that had been destroyed!
During the fourth stage, the entire server had been destroyed. The zombie apocalypse world had also completely disappeared, and all the players had died.
For some unknown reason, Federation had blocked all relevant information about that incident.
Because of this, information about the fusion mutant worm form zombie had always been confidential.
Kou Huai realized that the situation was difficult.
It had been a battle between him and Fang Heng.
Why was the entire District 7 going to be destroyed?
Especially this morning, he had received a total of eight calls from different superior departments.
Right now, the entire elementary game command post of the game world was paying attention to District 7 of Zombie Apocalypse.
This was the first time Kou Huai had received such attention from his superiors.

“Xiao Changle, you have explained in your report that theoretically, Cook Barn will be able to develop fusion mutant worm form zombies only after Scavenger Army developed to a certain scale. How could this happen now? Why have they appeared now, and we’re suddenly on the fourth stage?”
Faced with the questions, Xiao Changle felt bitter.
He lowered his head and said, “This is not what the intelligence department expected.”
Kou Huai took a deep breath and held back his anger. “So, Fang Heng paid so much effort to capture Dark Knights just to obtain mutant worm form Zombies?”
What else could Xiao Changle say?
Facing the questions that he could not answer, Xiao Changle decided to keep lowering his head constantly.
“I’m sorry. I can’t answer you without the relevant information.”
“So what the h*ll do you know? I think the intelligence department of Federation can be just abolished!”
Kou Huai could no longer suppress the anger in his heart.
The intelligence department of Federation was really useless!

Ever since he started to battle with Fang Heng, he had clearly had the overall advantage. He had thought he could crush Fang Heng with a single slap, but it turned out he was constantly fooled by Fang Heng!
In terms of intelligence, Fang Heng was always one step ahead of them.
Now, Fang Heng had already turned the tables.
He had even begun to think of ways to destroy District 7!
“Let me ask you, what should we do now? Is there any way to deal with those worms?”

“We are researching it currently.” Xiao Changle lowered his head, not daring to look at Kou Huai at all. “I think we can use Dark Knights’ strength to research the mutant worms and try to develop a vaccine that can target the mutant worms.”
“How long will it take?”
Xiao Changle’s head was even lower.
He did not dare to answer Kou Huai’s question.
It would take at least a month, even under the optimistic estimation.
He was afraid that he would be instantly beaten to death if he answered this way.
“I’m asking you!”
“I don’t know yet...”
It was about to get dark.
Osborne was in the fortress in the abandoned mine area that had been occupied by Scavenger Army not long ago.
He stood outside the door of the hall on the second floor underground, leaning against the wall and gently rubbing his temples.
Too many things had happened in the short 48 hours since the new leader took over Scavenger Army.
Fang Heng developed the warlord potion, attacked Dark Knights’ branch, and found the secret box of Meteorite Company...
Last night, he even completed the research and development test for the fusion tyrant form.
Fang Heng had created too many miracles.
It felt like a dream.
Osborne was also forced to bustle about with Fang Heng all day long.
Until now, he finally had a moment to rest.
With a “ding”, the door of the elevator at the end of the hallway opened. Ni Shengtao walked out with a delighted look. He walked straight to the hall.
“Is Boss inside?”

“Yes, he’s in the hall,” Osborne replied. “He did a test for the fusion tyrant form last night and just came back this morning. Then he has been staying in the hall. He told us not to disturb him unless it’s an emergency.”
Ni Shengtao was greatly surprised.
“What? The fusion tyrant form? Is it the modified Tyrant form experiment left behind by Mr. Cook?”
“Yes.”
The fusion tyrant form was a great weapon left behind by Cook Barn.
With it, their Scavenger Army’s strength would be significantly improved!
Ni Shengtao was excited and immediately asked, “How’s he doing? How is the situation of the test?”
“Last night, he cleared a total of fourteen small and medium-sized shelters.”
“Fourteen?!”
Ni Shengtao’s eyes widened.
He even suspected that he had heard wrong.
How could the fusion tyrant form be so powerful?!
“Yeah, fourteen. The preliminary test results are perfect.”
Osborne did not like Ni Shengtao’s exaggerated reaction, even though he was also shocked when he had just heard this news.
Osborne continued to ask, “Why are you here? Anything to report?”

“Yes.” Ni Shengtao slightly adjusted his excited mood. Then he continued, “I have to report something unusual to Boss. There has been a mutant worm attack in the nearby White Horse River region. Many survivors’ shelters have been attacked by the mutant worms, almost all wiped out. Now, all the survivors’ shelters are in a panic.
This is good news for us, isn’t it? I’ve asked someone to test it. Just like the zombie virus, the members of Scavenger Army will not be attacked by the mutant worms.”
Ni Shengtao’s eyes flashed with excitement. “With this opportunity and Boss’s newly developed fusion tyrant form, we can quickly expand our territory and occupy the White Horse River region.”
Mutant worms? The White Horse River region?
Fang Heng seemed to have gone to the White Horse River region to test the fusion tyrant form last night, right?
Osborne was puzzled. He nodded and said, “I hope so.”

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - Panic Over the Swarm of Worm Bodies
paragraphs: The continuous stream of good news made Ni Shengtao happy. He imitated Osborne and half leaned against the wall on the other side. He asked, “What about you? Are you guarding here?”
“No, I just came back not long ago. I just got the first batch of recruits from the army. I need to confirm it with the commander.”

Osborne shook his head as he spoke, “In addition, our current situation is not as optimistic as you think. Our army has been attacked by many small-scale survivor teams. They are targeting our supply lines, and their movements are unusually agile. In the past two days, we have already received hundreds of reports of attacks. To a large extent, it has affected the transportation of supply. It is very troublesome.”
“Don’t worry. I have a feeling that the commander will find a way. He will definitely bring us to the end of this f*cking world.”
As Ni Shengtao spoke, he looked at the tightly shut door behind him. “What is the commander doing inside?”
“I’m not sure.”
As the two of them were talking, a crack appeared in the tightly shut door.
Fang Heng poked his head out of the door and immediately saw the two of them standing outside.
“Eh? You’re both here?”
“Commander, we have something to report to you.”
“Good, I also have something to talk to you about. Come in the hall.”
As he spoke, Fang Heng pushed open the hall’s door.
Ni Shengtao and Osborne did not suspect him and stepped into the basement hall together.
However, just as they stepped into the hall, Osborne and Ni Shengtao were stunned.
The two of them looked at each other in shock.
What was going on?
The repair of the space tearing device was completed?
In the center of the hall, the large-scale space tearing device was emitting circles of blue ripples.

The most advanced technology of the Meteorite Company, the former commander of the company, Cook Barn, had tried every possible means to replicate a large-scale space tearing device countless times but failed...
And now... Fang Heng could actually repair it?
How many things could he do in just 48 hours?
Ni Shengtao turned around and gave Osborne a look. “Repair the space tearing device? Isn’t he a potioneer?”
After the initial shock, Osborne responded to Ni Shengtao’s look and nodded to him, giving him a look.
“A mechanical builder who can develop the fusion Tyrant form is a qualified potioneer.”
There were too many secrets about the commander, and Osborne was already used to it.
Fang Heng stood in front of the large-scale space tearing device.
He was in a good mood.
The third step of the Federation’s counterattack plan, the repair of the space tearing device, was completed!
With the space tearing device, he was finally not fighting alone. He could contact the Leftway Gaming Guild in the outside world.
Fang Heng already had a good plan for the follow-up.

Next, he would first go to the Leftway Gaming Guild’s base to build a branch space tearing device teleportation point, then build a magnetic field sensing tower to expand the magnetic field sensing range. He would think of a way to search for more Hila organization samples, and he would increase the number of modifications for the fusion Tyrant form and increase his overall strength...
As for the Federation, he did not have the time to deal with them right now...
In order to prevent them from causing damage, he had to give them some trouble.
Coincidentally, the vaccine in District 8 was a good plan.

First, they had to think of a way to mass-produce vaccine antibodies and spread them out in the rear area of the Federation. Most likely, the vaccine might produce unknown consequences, disrupt the Federation’s layout, and slow them down...

Therefore, before he went to look for the guild leader of the Leftway Guild, Tian Zhen, he had to go back to the Scavenger Army headquarters and build a branch teleportation point. Then, he had to get Ding Min to speed up the mass production of the vaccine potion...
It should be about time.
“Commander, we’ve already completed the first batch of recruitment. This is the recruitment list.”
Osborne took a step forward and handed the list to Fang Heng.
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and put away the list.
He was going to ask Chen Yu and Tian Zhen to look into it and see if there were any players mixed in.
Osborne continued to report, “In addition, the shelter has been attacked by various small-scale shelter teams over the past two days. Our supply line has been greatly restricted.”
Fang Heng had also heard about the news that the Federation released two days ago.

The Federation had called on the players to work together to deal with the Scavenger Army. Once they succeeded in causing damage to the Scavenger Army, they would give rewards and war damage compensation.
Many players were blinded by the benefits in front of their eyes.
They did not have the ability to attack the Scavenger Army’s base camp directly, but they could still cause trouble for Fang Heng’s supply line.
The small-scale enemy attack and harassment tactics organized by the player teams were very troublesome.

They would bring great pressure to the Scavenger Army’s logistics. As time went on, the warlord potions and divine potions at the front line couldn’t be replenished. At that time, the team’s strength and morale would be greatly reduced. It was even possible to be wiped out.
The Federation still had a way to play dirty.
Fang Heng felt that this problem was a bit troublesome, and he didn’t have a good idea for the time being.
He also didn’t have the time and energy to deal with those players one by one.
“Hmm, for the time being, strengthen the guard team and strengthen the defense of the supply line. I’ll think of a way to solve this problem.”
“Yes, understood.”

Ni Shengtao also reported to Fang Heng, “Mr. Fang Heng, I’ve received news that there was an obvious anomaly in the White Horse River region last night. A large number of worm bodies have appeared. These mutant worm bodies have caused great damage to a large portion of the survivors’ shelter in the White Horse River region. I think now is the best time to act.”
Hearing this, Fang Heng was stunned.
Unknown worm bodies?
The White Horse River region?
Why did these two names sound familiar?
Fang Heng opened the game log and flipped through a few pages.
[Hint: Your mutated worm body has launched an attack, causing 3-point damage.]
[Hint: Your mutated worm body has received fatal damage. It died]
[Hint: Your mutated worm body is attempting to parasitize.]
[Hint: Your mutated worm body has completed the central nervous system infection...]
There were thousands of game hints in a row.
Only then did Fang Heng realize that the 1,000 purple mutant worms that he had used the fusion Tyrant form skill to release last night were not all dead.
After he went offline, the mutant worm bodies that were on standby began to wander aimlessly in the White Horse River region, trying to parasitize anyone they met.
A day passed.
The players in the White Horse River region were miserable. There were even two shelters that almost completely fell because of the worm bodies!
The mutant worm bodies could actually be so strong?
Fang Heng stroked his chin and began to think.
At present, including the proliferator, he could have a maximum of eight fusion Tyrant forms.
In other words, under ideal conditions, he could produce 400 small mutant worm bodies per hour.
Perhaps he could let the small worm bodies go to the Federation’s frontline shelter to play and cause more chaos for them?
The plan was working!
Fang Heng’s eyes were burning. He raised his head and said, “Ni Shengtao, don’t make any moves for now.”

“Let’s wait for a while more and gather a team to protect the logistics team. Recently, I have a batch of important materials to transport. First, I have to ensure the safety of this batch of materials. There must be no problems.”
Ni Shengtao cupped his fists and said, “Yes! Understood!”

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - Plan Approved
paragraphs: [Item: Special Anti-virus Vaccine.]
Description: The vaccine sample was developed by the Dark Knights (District 8).
Description: This vaccine was developed to work against the first-generation virus. It is extremely unstable and carries a huge risk.
Description: Player’s anti-infection ability is greatly increased after injection (duration is related to the basic attribute, maximum 30 days).
“The vaccine sample developed from first-generation meteorites? Where did you get it? From the Dark Knights?”
Ding Min received the vaccine from Fang Heng.
She looked at Fang Heng with an anomaly, as if she wanted to see through him completely.
It had only been a day, so how did Fang Heng get the vaccine?
“That’s not important. How long do we need to replicate it successfully?”
“No, this is very important. It looks very unstable. I have reason to suspect that it has been modified.”
Ding Min held the sample in her hand and observed it with a serious expression.
“It won’t be. I guarantee that it won’t be a problem.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he rummaged through his backpack and passed the Deep Blue Enigma mask over. “Oh right, I almost forgot. I also brought you this.”
Ding Min was pleasantly surprised.
“A sample of the experimental set? You actually found a sample of the Deep Blue Enigma?”
Ding Min’s attention was immediately attracted by the mask package in Fang Heng’s hands.
She instantly put the matter of the vaccine to the back of her mind. She picked up the mask and began to study it.
“That’s great. With the sample, we can directly analyze the mask and develop a more efficient...”
“How could the sample be preserved so well?”
[Hint: Ding Min’s favorability rating has increased slightly.]
[Hint: Ding Min’s loyalty to the Scavenger Army has increased to 94.]
“Cough, cough.”
Seeing Ding Min study the mask for more than ten minutes, Fang Heng could not help but interrupt, “Dr. Ding, the vaccine is very important to us.”
“I know.”
Ding Min’s attention was still on the ingredient list of the mask package.

“I will study the sample of the vaccine. It’s useless to rush me. I can provide you with the vaccine for testing tomorrow morning. In theory, with enough ingredients, it is expected to reach the regional test dosage that afternoon.”
“Yes, I have already asked Ni Shengtao to collect the medicinal ingredients. The first batch of test dosage can be guaranteed.”
After receiving Ding Min’s accurate reply, Fang Heng heaved a sigh of relief.
Dr. Ding Min’s personality was a little strange, but her ability in experiments was still convincing.
Fang Heng calculated with his fingers.
Later, he still needed to build a space tearing device branch teleportation point in the army headquarters.
After that, he would rush back to the headquarters of the Leftway Gaming Guild’s shelter at night to meet up with Tian Zhen.
He would also build a teleportation point there.

If everything went smoothly, he could complete the construction of the teleportation point in the morning. When that time came, he would rush back to make the vaccine. In the afternoon, he would start the vaccine proliferation test plan.
As the Leftway Gaming Guild lacked engineers who could build a small-scale teleportation device, Fang Heng could only personally bring a batch of zombie clones to build it.
It was already late at night when Fang Heng quietly drove the truck to the main base of the Leftway Gaming Guild.
“Fang Heng, I’ve been looking forward to this for a long time.”
Tian Zhen stayed up late and waited for Fang Heng for a long time.
When he saw Fang Heng, he couldn’t help but feel a little uneasy.
He never expected that Fang Heng would give him another huge surprise in a day.
Fusion Tyrant form!
This morning, he had obtained some screenshots from a secret channel of the video of the fusion Tyrant form’s attack on the Federation’s shelter last night.
After seeing the video, Tian Zhen could not calm down for a long time.
Fang Heng was the cause of it again!
The strength of the fusion Tyrant form had already reached the level of Tier 5 mutated zombie!
The entire Federation of District 7 was shocked.
“What are these?”
Looking at the zombies crawling out from under the truck one by one, Tian Zhen had a strange expression.
“They’re just for show.”
Fang Heng yawned and poured a bottle of coffee into his mouth. “How is it? Are the things ready?”
Tian Zhen was suspicious. He nodded and said, “They’re all ready. Come with me.”
Under Tian Zhen’s lead, Fang Heng led a group of zombies to the third floor of the basement of the shelter.
The construction materials for the branch teleportation point had been prepared. Boxes of materials were temporarily stacked in the corner of the hall.
Fang Heng walked to the boxes and checked them one by one.
The efficiency of the Leftway Gaming Guild was quite high.
Fang Heng nodded with satisfaction. “You’re quite fast. The news of the spatial rift’s construction hasn’t leaked out, has it?”

“No. Only the two core members of the guild know about the cooperation with you. In addition, according to the plan, I’ve begun to purchase the shelter and collect various materials to prepare for the establishment of the magnetic field detector branch.”
“There are already several companies negotiating the price. If we hurry, we can complete the purchase in a few days.”
“The main problem now is that we don’t have enough money. The guild still has a big gap in funds.”
Tian Zhen sighed and said, “Speaking of which, it’s also thanks to you that we can buy the territory at a lower price. Otherwise, we would have to spend more money.”
“Thanks to me? What do you mean?”
Fang Heng was stunned for a moment.

“Huh? Don’t you know? It’s all thanks to the fusion Tyrant form developed by the Scavenger Army. Right now, the Federation outside is going crazy. The Federation is looking everywhere for a way to deal with the mutant worm bodies.”
“A rumor has leaked out that the entire District 7 will face the threat of the mutant worm bodies. In the short term, the Federation has no way to resist the mutant worm bodies.”

“The players in District 7 all feel that the district will be greatly impacted. In addition, District 8 is gradually stabilizing. A large number of capable players are considering moving out of District 7 and choosing the safer District 8.”

“Since this morning, there have been a large number of game guilds’ company shelters in the eastern district. As for the other three districts, your game guild has not been affected by the mutant worm bodies for the time being. I reckon they are also in a wait-and-see state.”
Fang Heng pursed his lips and pondered.
He did not expect the mutant worm bodies to be so useful that they would cause such a huge impact on the Federation.

Unfortunately, the current situation of their Scavenger Army was not good either. They did not have enough members and combat strength. Otherwise, he could use this opportunity to expand crazily and directly beat the Federation to death.

“The Federation has already announced to the outside world that they are recruiting methods to control the mutant worm bodies. They have also offered a reward. As long as they find a way to deal with the mutant worm bodies, they will be able to provide resources equivalent to three large-scale shelters as a reward.”
“Three large-scale shelters! So many!”
Fang Heng was shocked by the Federation’s generosity.
It seemed that the Federation was really pushed to the brink...
“Exactly.” The deputy commander of the Leftway Gaming Guild, Zhong Lei, curled his lips and said, “Kou Huai is really bleeding this time.”
For a moment, Fang Heng was also dazzled by the reward. He even wanted to report himself to receive the reward.
The vaccine antibodies developed by District 7 would also work on the mutant worm bodies.
Wait a minute...
Reporting himself to the Federation to receive the reward?
Perhaps...
It might be feasible?
Fang Heng’s eyes narrowed, revealing a greedy gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - Reverse Optimization
paragraphs: “Fang Heng, what’s wrong?”
“Nothing.” Fang Heng came back to his senses. He eagerly patted Tian Zhen’s shoulder. “To be honest, I’ve thought of a plan. Aren’t we short of money? Tell me, can we ask the Federation for money?”
“Hmm? Ask the Federation for money? What does that mean?”
Tian Zhen was baffled when he heard that.
“Hehe,” Fang Heng chuckled and whispered into Tian Zhen’s ear.
Tian Zhen had a strange expression.
“T-this would work?”
“But, but...”

“There are no buts. Leave the rest to me. You just need to prepare the follow-up materials.” Fang Heng took out a list from his pocket, “By the way, there’s also a new recruitment list for the Scavenger Army. Help me see if there’s anyone familiar...”
Tian Zhen was still a little suspicious as he took the list.
He knew about the list, but Fang Heng’s plan was too...
“Alright, you guys go ahead. Leave the rest to me.”
Fang Heng said as he pushed Tian Zhen and Zhong Lei out of the hall.
“Bang!”
The door to the hall was tightly shut. Zhong Lei and Tian Zhen could hear the sound of the door being locked.
Zhong Lei felt awkward. He turned to Tian Zhen and asked, “Commander, this...?”
Tian Zhen thought for a moment.
Now that things had come to this, he decided to continue trusting Fang Heng.
“You stay here. If Fang Heng needs anything, help him do it.”
“Okay.”
“If you have any news, let me know immediately.”
“Understood.”
The next day, Tian Zhen returned to the game shelter.
In the morning, he had just signed an agreement with a company to purchase the assets of the shelter in District 7 in installments.
Too many things had happened in District 7 recently, making him physically and mentally exhausted.
All the chaos and disorder had started when Fang Heng entered District 7.
Tian Zhen realized that Fang Heng’s thinking was a little off after his brief contact with Fang Heng over the past few days.
To be more precise, Tian Zhen felt that Fang Heng’s plan was a little unrealistic.
Perhaps cooperating with him was not the best plan?
No!
Tian Zhen braced himself and cleared the chaotic thoughts in his mind.
Since he had made his choice, he had to go all out!
“Commander.”

While he was thinking, Zhong Lei hurriedly pushed the door open and entered. “You’re finally back. Fang Heng needs a lot of construction materials and medicinal ingredients. He told us to make preparations in advance. He said that he would send a batch of materials over later, and he also told us to prepare to purchase the next batch of medicinal ingredients. He will provide us with the details of the medicinal ingredients in a while.”
“So soon?”
Tian Zhen frowned.
For this gamble, he had already applied for a loan from a financial institution. However, it was not so fast. The loan still needed some time to be approved.
Their capital chain was very tight. They had no spare money to buy medicinal ingredients.
“Yes, he is in a hurry.”
“Our current funds are simply not enough.” Tian Zhen frowned. “Forget it. I’ll go and talk to him.”
“Don’t go. He has already left.”
“He left?”
Tian Zhen was even more confused. Didn’t they agree to build a teleportation door inside their shelter? Why did he leave just like that?

Zhong Lei closed the office door behind him. He walked to the front of the office with excitement and whispered, “God Fang Heng used the teleportation passage to return to the main base of the Scavenger Army in the morning. When he left, he left us some blue crystal pieces.”
Tian Zhen was stunned.
“Wait, slow down. You mean, Fang Heng has already built the teleportation device?”
“Yes, yes, I saw it with my own eyes.”
In one night?
The teleportation passage was completed?
Tian Zhen didn’t believe it at first, but then he thought of the plan that Fang Heng said last night...
After being stunned for a long time, a smile appeared on Tian Zhen’s face.
“Good!”
This was good!
It turned out that he was too small-minded!
In that case, Fang Heng could really carry out that plan!
Tian Zhen sighed in his heart.
After so many years, he had finally found a good teammate!
Those teammates in the past, it was already fortunate that he did not have to help them wipe their asses.
Tian Zhen’s mood instantly improved, and the dejected look on his face disappeared.
He was extremely glad that he had made such an excellent choice.
No!
Tian Zhen suddenly stood up again.
He could not be an incompetent teammate who would drag him down!
“Zhong Lei, get ready. Gather all the people in the team that we can trust. We have urgent matters to do next, and we must not make any mistakes.”
“Yes!”
In Zhong Lei’s impression, Commander Tian Zhen had always been very calm. It was rare for him to show such great joy and sorrow like today.
“What are you waiting for? Settle it quickly!”
“But Commander, regarding the funding, we should...”
“Don’t worry. The Federation will help us solve the problem soon.”
At the Scavenger Army headquarters.
“Commander Fang Heng, I have completed the research and development of the vaccine body. We can start mass production now.”

“In addition, I have already reengineered the vaccine according to your request. The antibody potion extracted from the vaccine can take effect on the mutant worm body. Even if it is already invaded by the mutant worm body, the vaccine can immediately kill the mutant worm body that is parasitic in the body.”

“However, it is only effective at the initial parasitical stage. Once the parasite takes control of the host’s nerve center, the death of the mutant worm body will cause the death of the host body as well.”
Ding Min reported her work to Fang Heng in a serious manner. However, her face was still covered with a mask, which made Fang Heng feel a little strange.
[Hint: Player has obtained an item — Mutant Worm Body Injection.]
Item: Mutant Worm Body Injection.

Description: After injecting, the human body’s blood will contain a special antibody. The antibody will cause the mutant worm body to react, making the human body immune to the mutant worm body parasite.
Fang Heng held the completed sample of the injection in his hand and looked at it.
Good stuff!
With this thing, he could exchange it for three shelters from the Federation!
But...
It seemed to be a loss?
The three large-scale shelter materials were equivalent to giving his own fusion Tyrant form a big cut.
Fang Heng touched his chin and pondered for a moment, then turned his gaze to Ding Min.
Ding Min looked at Fang Heng. “You have other questions?”
“Uh, Dr. Ding Min, can you further optimize the effect of the injection?”
Ding Min refused, “There’s no need for that. The effect has already been pushed to the limit.”

“No, no, no. I mean, can you adjust it in the opposite direction to weaken the effect of the injection and change it to the temporary effective one?” Fang Heng gestured with his hand. “Oh, it is to change it to an injection that can only be effective after it has been parasitized.”
Ding Min showed a puzzled expression.
It was not the first time she had done drug research and development. It was the first time she had heard of such a strange request.
“Also, you must pay attention to confidentiality during research and development. Add a few more dispensable medicinal ingredients to increase the difficulty of cracking the formula. Can you do it?”
Ding Min looked at Fang Heng suspiciously.
She really couldn’t understand Fang Heng. He kept bringing up these strange requests.
It was still alright. The difficulty of changing it was almost nothing to her.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - Antibody Injection
paragraphs: “Alright, you’re the boss. Give me another hour.”
“I knew it. This won’t be a problem for you. You’re the strongest researcher in the entire Scavenger Army!”
“Hmph.”
Ding Min snorted and shook her head. She turned her back and started writing in her notebook.
[Hint: Ding Min’s favorability rating has slightly increased.]
[Hint: Ding Min’s loyalty to the Scavenger Army has increased to 95.]
Looking at Ding Min’s back, Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.

He couldn’t see Ding Min’s attributes right now, but he was sure that Ding Min was definitely an S-level researcher! In a night, she had copied the virus antibody vaccine and Meteorite Company’s mask based on the information and samples!
He had to think of a way to trick her back to District 8!
Or when the matter at hand was over, he could go to the real world to get some skin care products for her?
Fang Heng pondered and continued to open the game map to observe.
If everything went smoothly, he would be able to get the first batch of antibody vaccines this afternoon. Then, he could find a place to spread the vaccine in large quantities for testing.
He had to find a good place.
In order to avoid getting himself into trouble, he might as well start from the other three regions of Zombie Apocalypse District 7.
He shall start from the western region!
Before that, he had to do something for the people of the Federation to get more money from them.
With that thought in mind, Fang Heng brought along the eight fusion Tyrant form, including the proliferator, and headed to the White Horse River region to spread the mutant worm virus.
The mutant worm tide was spreading crazily!
The entire Zombie Apocalypse District 7 was gradually falling into a panic because of this!
The invasion of the mutant worm bodies was too difficult to defend against.
They could infiltrate into the shelter from every corner that you would not expect, then bite a hole in your clothes and drill into your body to complete the parasitism!
After that, the player that was parasitized would become a zombie.
The zombie would cause secondary damage to the shelter.
In just a short day, the number of player deaths in the White Horse River region soared!
What was even more troublesome was that not only in the White Horse River region, the mutant worm bodies had begun to invade the region around the White Horse River.
Player forums in the eastern region of District 7 were filled with screams.

Originally, District 7 was a very stable region. However, after Fang Heng’s arrival, the strength of the Scavenger Army had greatly increased. In addition to the outbreak of the mutant worm tide at this stage, the confidence of the player in District 7 had become weaker and weaker, and many rich people with spare money had already begun to think of ways to evacuate from District 7.
Amidst the chaos, a new post in the forum attracted the attention of all the players.
“Just one shot! Mutant worm parasite! An immediate effect after one injection! Quickly come in and take a look!”
An advertisement?
At first, the player saw this advertisement as a joke. However, when they clicked on it, they discovered that the post was actually posted by the Leftway Gaming Guild.
The antibody vaccine that the Leftway Gaming Guild had developed could be used against the recently appeared mutant worm bodies infection?
A vaccine!
Within a few hours, the number of cooperative inquiries to the Leftway Gaming Guild had exploded.
Tian Zhen was currently sitting in his office chair, feeling very comfortable.
He had just rejected the Federation’s request to buy the mutant worm body vaccine from him.
The other party had offered him the number of resources that was equivalent to four shelters.
Tian Zhen was very tempted at the time, but he still refused.
He knew very well that Kou Huai would definitely call him personally.
As expected, a few minutes later, the phone rang.
It was Kou Huai calling.

“Kou Huai, we are old friends. Don’t you trust me? I swear to you, it’s not that I don’t want to provide you with the formula. I really don’t have the formula, but I can provide you with the finished product.”
According to the agreement with Fang Heng, Tian Zhen explained to Kou Huai, “Okay, of course, there’s no problem!”

“However, the production of the injection is very difficult. The first batch of the injection has been sold to the major game guilds. In addition, we need a lot of medicinal resources to produce it. We still need to spend some time preparing the injection.”
“What? Need to rush it? It’s not impossible, but we need more manpower and material resources. We still need to adjust the price...”
On the other end of the phone, Kou Huai’s face was gloomy.
He had never expected that the Leftway Gaming Guild had no consideration for him.
Kou Huai realized that ever since Fang Heng entered District 7, his control over District 7 had become weaker and weaker.
After this operation was over, the first thing he would do was to punish the Leftway Gaming Guild!
Kill the chicken to warn the monkey!
And also, that bunch of trash from the intelligence department! Even the player guilds had developed an anti-mutant worm injection, but there was still no news of them!
Kou Huai clenched his fists so tightly that they creaked.
“Alright, Tian Zhen, we’ll do as you say! I need at least 10,000 injections by tomorrow night. If I can’t get them, you’ll bear the consequences!”
With that, Kou Huai angrily hung up the phone.
Hearing the busy tone on the phone, Tian Zhen was secretly delighted.
He had never seen Kou Huai so flustered and exasperated before.
The Leftway Gaming Guild had been suppressed by the Federation for so long in District 7, but this was the first time they had the upper hand.
It was too awesome!
With the help of the Federation’s resources, they could proceed with the next step of purchasing medicinal ingredients and the shelters...
Spending the Federation’s money to deal with the Federation?
Fang Heng really knew how to play!
Wait!
Tian Zhen suddenly frowned and sat up straight in his chair.
Something was wrong!
Kou Huai was not a person who would give in so easily.
The single dose of vaccine he had previously prescribed was extremely expensive, but Kou Huai still agreed.
Kou Huai had agreed too quickly and straightforwardly.
Or was it because the mutant worm bodies had put too much pressure on him?
Moreover, Kou Huai had also requested to gather at least 10,000 injections by tomorrow night instead of requesting the first batch of syringes to be delivered as soon as possible...
The more Tian Zhen thought about it, the more he felt that something was wrong.
“Could it be that I’ve gone overboard...”
Tian Zhen muttered to himself in a low voice.
For safety reasons, he immediately dialed the internal line. “Go and investigate and see if there’s anything unusual happening in the Federation recently. Find out clearly!”
In the elementary King of Gods game, every server was divided into four regions.
Following the Federation’s encirclement of the Scavenger Army, the Scavenger Army branches in the western region had been completely wiped out.
The western region was the furthest from the White Horse River region in the eastern region, so for the time being, they were not threatened by the mutated worms.
Their days were quite comfortable.
In the western region, the Seventh Dimension Gaming Union.
Circles of blue light flashed through the portal on the first basement.
Fang Heng, wearing a mask, walked out of the portal with Zhong Lei and Ding Min.
Noyce, the vice president of the Seventh Dimension Gaming Guild’s shelter, went up to Zhong Lei.
“Zhong Lei, my old friend, long time no see.”
“Yes, long time no see. This time, we have encountered a troublesome mission. The location of the mission is in your western region. We need to rent your portal for one day. Sorry to trouble you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - Western Region
paragraphs: “There’s no need to be so polite. Our guilds have always cooperated with each other,” Noyce said as he pointed at a row of large trucks parked at the edge of the hall. “The trucks have already been prepared for you. Do you need anything else? Do you need me to send a few guides to follow you?”
Noyce’s face was full of smiles, but he was making plans in his heart.
Right now, the entire eastern region was trembling with fear over the mutant worm body. Why did the Leftway Gaming Guild suddenly come to the western region?
Could it be that they were here to expand the territory of the western region?
It looked like the other party was up to something big. All of a sudden, they had borrowed more than 20 trucks from them.
It was strange!
“No need to trouble yourself. We can do it ourselves.”
Zhong Lei did not know the real reason behind Fang Heng’s visit. He only knew that it was a very important matter. Thus, he whispered into Noyce’s ear, “It’s a hidden mission. Don’t leak it out.”
“I understand.”
Noyce smiled and nodded in agreement.
He had doubts about the true reason behind the Leftway Gaming Guild’s visit.
Recently, the matter of mutant worms had become a hot topic.
He felt that it might be related to the vaccine that the Leftway Gaming Guild had developed.
No matter what, the price of renting the teleportation passage was very high.
There was no reason for him not to earn this money.
Noyce was still unwilling to give up. He probed, “I heard that you guys have already developed an anti-mutant worm body vaccine?”

“Hahaha, it’s just luck. Currently, we have already started mass production. With the anti-mutant body vaccine, I believe that under the leadership of the Federation, the mutant worm crisis will be over very soon, right?”

“Of course, the crisis will pass very quickly.” Noyce nodded and stopped asking, “That is the freight passage. After the door opens, the truck will enter the first floor through a large cargo elevator. After that, it will be able to leave the shelter straight ahead. I won’t bother you anymore.”
After a few simple pleasantries, Noyce saw that he could not get any useful information, so he tactfully left with the guild players.
When Noyce left with his men, Fang Heng immediately took off the mask on his face.
He walked to the control panel and quickly adjusted the location of the spatial rift’s passage.
After a moment, the teleportation passage that had been repositioned once again emitted a weak blue light.
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
The floor shook slightly.
Eight fusion mutant worm Tyrant forms stepped out of the portal in succession.
Under Fang Heng’s control, they walked to the trailer behind the truck and lay down quietly.
Then came the ordinary fusion Tyrant.
The two ordinary fusion Tyrants squeezed into one trailer.
Then came the scarlet Lickers, which pounced on the truck behind them and entered the gap between the trucks.
Finally, there was the ordinary vine zombie team.
They squeezed each other and walked out of the portal, filling up the last space of the trailer.
It was the first time Zhong Lei saw such a large zombie team up close.
He was secretly glad.
Fortunately, Fang Heng was not their enemy.
However, Zhong Lei also felt very strange. Why did Fang Heng spend so much effort to bring so many zombie teams here?
Was he planning to attack the western region?
“Almost done.”
Fang Heng rubbed his neck, feeling bitter in his heart.
In the game, theoretically, only the Dark Knights had the teleportation passage.
The blueprint for the passage in the player’s hands was also obtained from the Dark Knights.
Moreover, the number was limited.
Fang Heng calculated that if he did not use the teleportation passage, it would take him two days to drive a truck to the western region.
The main storyline mission in District 8 couldn’t wait that long!
Therefore, Fang Heng had to spend more money to find a more reliable player union to rent a teleportation passage.
When all the zombies got on the truck, Fang Heng covered the truck with a layer of tarp.
In the end, more than 20 NPC survivors walked out of the passage.
They boarded the truck’s cab one by one.
The NPCs did not know what terrifying things were loaded under the tarp at the back of the truck.
Fang Heng finally checked and manually controlled the machine to open the iron door of the hall to the outside world.
“Let’s go!”
Ten minutes later.
The vice president of the Seventh Dimension Gaming Union, Noyce, watched as more than 20 trucks filled with “goods” left the shelter.
“Boss, should we send someone to follow them to take a look?”
“Yes, send someone to follow them. Keep a distance. Be careful not to be discovered.”
Olf nodded. “Understood! Leave it to me.”
After leaving the shelter, Fang Heng immediately headed toward the coordinates.
On the trailer behind the truck, several Lickers kept falling.
“Chi chi chi...”
After landing, the Lickers spread out in all directions.
A moment later, a white van appeared on the highway.
Olf led a small team of three to drive the van. They followed far behind Fang Heng in an attempt to monitor him.
“Look! What’s that!”
Olf suddenly discovered, to his surprise, that a red shadow had appeared on both sides of the road.
More than ten Lickers were blocking the middle of the highway.
It was Lickers!
“Chi chi chi!”
More than ten Lickers saw the white van and immediately pounced on it.
Olf and the others immediately raised their guns and counterattacked.
“Bang! Bang Bang Bang!”
“Quick! Ignore them! Just run over them!”
Hearing that, the driver stepped on the accelerator to the maximum and crashed into a group of Lickers in front.
However, the Lickers’ attack was beyond their expectations.
A Licker directly pounced on the top of the truck!
A sharp claw slashed past and tore a huge hole in the entire top.
Olf raised the automatic rifle, aimed at the top, and pulled the trigger.
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
The Licker was in pain and could not hold on to the truck. It fell heavily to the ground.
The remaining Lickers did not give up and chased after the truck from behind.
“Faster! Drive faster! Shake them off!”
Olf shouted and raised his automatic rifle with his other two companions to shoot at the Licker.
Suddenly, Olf felt something bite his wrist.
He raised his hand and frowned.
When did a cut appear on his hand?
When he took a closer look, a row of messages appeared on his retina.
[Hint: Unknown mutant worm body is trying to control your central nervous system.]
[Hint (obtained from low-level game difficulty): Based on your basic attribute, your central nervous system will be infected by the unknown worm body within 45 seconds...]
What was going on?
Mutant worm body!
When did mutant worm bodies appear in their western region!
He looked carefully.
There were actually tiny mutant worms in the truck!
And when did they appear in the truck!
Cold sweat broke out on Olf’s forehead. He suddenly realized that his companion, who was driving the truck, had suddenly stopped talking.
Was he infected?
Before he could figure it out, the car had completely lost control.
“Boom!”
With a loud bang, the car drove off the road and crashed into a huge rock beside the road.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - Vaccine Body Information Collection
paragraphs: “Fang Heng, we have entered the central area of the Western region and are heading towards the coordinates. There is an area of scorched ruins there. There are no usable materials nearby, so no player has established a shelter there.”

Seeing that everything was going smoothly, Zhong Lei breathed a sigh of relief and explained to Fang Heng in a low voice, “The Seventh Dimension is one of the larger gaming unions in the Western region. We’ve worked together with them a few times before, so we can be considered friends. Not long ago, the president had just contacted them, and they don’t have any plans for a guild shelter at the moment.”
“Mm.”
Fang Heng flipped through the game log and nodded. “Looks like the people from the Seventh Dimension aren’t too reliable. They’ve sent people to follow us.”
“What?”
Zhong Lei was stunned.
People? How did Fang Heng know?
Then, Zhong Lei realized that something was wrong.
Not to mention the fact that their guild and Fang Heng’s cooperation needed to be kept a secret. Once someone followed them, even their secret mission this time would be greatly affected.
“What should we do? Should we stop first and think of a way to get rid of them?”
“There’s no need. We’ve already gotten rid of them.”
Zhong Lei was stunned.
So fast? When did this happen? He didn’t see him making a move?

Fang Heng waved his hand, and he said casually, “I did some research earlier and found that the worm body can also invade the Licker’s body and temporarily live under the Licker’s skin. Although they can’t enhance the Licker, sometimes they can produce some unexpected enhanced effects...”
Hearing Fang Heng’s words, Zhong Lei suddenly felt a chill on his back.
So, Fang Heng had parasitized those mutant worm bodies on the Licker?
Zhong Lei comforted himself again and again. Fang Heng was not an enemy but a teammate.

“Hey, don’t look like that. I’m not a monster. I just want to study the cooperation between zombie team members and add some tactics. Shouldn’t we stockpile more mutant worm bodies and then spread them out?”

“Theoretically, we can’t do that.” Ding Min shook her head and said, “I’ve studied the mutant worm bodies. After they leave the body of the fusion Tyrant form for a period of time, their activity and attacking power will gradually decrease. It’s already the limit for them to survive for a week without finding a host. They can’t stock up and nurtured in large quantities.”
“Is that so...” Fang Heng was disappointed. “It’s a pity that we can’t use this bug.”

“But your idea is still very good. The Licker’s battle idea is a bit interesting.” Ding Min nodded and encouraged, “It’s a pity that the Lickers can’t provide enough nutrients to the mutant worm bodies. If the mutant worm body infects the Licker, it will greatly reduce the Licker’s function, and the loss outweighs the gain...”
Listening to the conversation between the two, Zhong Lei couldn’t help but shrink his neck again.
Sure enough, they were from the Scavenger Army. There was something wrong with both of them.
An hour later, the group arrived at the zombie virus vaccine spread point that Ding Min had chosen beforehand.
More than twenty trucks lined up and stopped by the roadside.
Ding Min got off the truck.
In front of her was a scorched ruin.
Fang Heng signaled to Ding Min with his eyes.
Ding Min’s expression was serious. She walked to the open space in front of her, carefully placed the box containing the highly concentrated vaccine on the ground, and pressed a button on the box.
“Step back a little.”
Ding Min took Fang Heng and the others to step back a distance.
“Is it done?”
“Yes, it will take some time to spread...” Ding Min looked at the experimental subject box in front of her and carefully observed it. “I need to collect the first sample in ten minutes.”
Fang Heng asked, “Will there be problems with my zombies?”
“There won’t be. Unless the vaccine body is improved in the next stage, the antibody vaccine’s effect on the zombies will be very limited. Besides, your zombie corpse is special.”
“That’s good.”
Zhong Lei, who was listening by the side, was confused.
He was very curious as to why he came all the way to the Western region.
Soon, a hint flashed in front of Fang Heng’s eyes.
[Hint: Player’s team has released a highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine.]
[Hint: The anti-virus vaccine is spreading...]
[Hint: Player’s main storyline mission has an anomaly... Auto-repair is processing...]
[Hint: Repair completed. The player’s team has triggered the main storyline mission — Vaccine Body Information Collection].
Mission name: Vaccine Body Information Collection.
Mission description: You have released a highly unstable anti-virus vaccine. The vaccine may cause a special mutation. Please collect as much information as possible.
Mission requirements: Try to collect information on the anti-virus vaccine and the zombies affected by the vaccine.
Mission reward: ??? (Affected by human intervention, unknown reward).
“This...”
Vaccine?
The main storyline special mission?
Unknown reward? Human Intervention?
Zhong Lei also received a team mission.
The amount of information provided by the mission was too large, and he hadn’t had time to enquire yet.
Just as he raised his head, Zhong Lei noticed that something strange had happened in the scorched area ahead.
“Hey, look over there.”
Fang Heng slightly narrowed his eyes.
“Chi! Chi chi!”
One by one, green-gray palms reached out from the ground.
Mutated zombies rose from the ground and struggled to crawl out.
Their bodies were covered in mud, and they let out wails as they slowly walked toward Fang Heng.
[Hint: The spread of the vaccine has caused a mutation of the virus in the area.]
[Hint: The current spread of the vaccine in the area is 0.32%. The mutation in the area is 0.05%. The purification of the area is 0.02%.]

Ding Min looked around vigilantly and moved closer to Fang Heng, and she said in a low voice, “Fang Heng, as I predicted, the probability of the virus causing a small mutation in the zombies is very high. I need to collect more samples.”
“Um. It seems that our luck is indeed not that good.”
Zhong Lei thought to himself, “Is this a problem of luck?”
He also became nervous. He took out the automatic rifle from his backpack and stood side by side with Fang Heng, getting ready for battle.
Zhong Lei noticed that Fang Heng had taken something out of his backpack and was in a fighting posture.
Five mutated zombies were also in the same posture as him.
They were holding the same special weapons as Fang Heng.
Eh?
What the hell?
Silver...
Are they needles!
“Chi chi chi...”
The next second, Zhong Lei heard a chafing sound.
Then, countless scarlet Lickers swept past them.
The Lickers’ sharp claws plunged into the mutated zombie team!
Fang Heng’s game log refreshed quickly!
[Hint: Your zombie clone (Licker) has killed a Tier 1 mutated zombie. You have obtained information related to the mutated zombie. Mission completion rate: 0.001%...]
Eh? Collecting information by killing a mutated creature?
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
It should be similar to the previous missions he had encountered. In theory, he could obtain the completion rate by killing the mutated zombies and collecting a sample.
However, the completion rate provided by killing one was too little?

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - Killing Monsters
paragraphs: In front of them, there was a bloody massacre.
Against a low-level zombie team, the Licker team, which had inherited part of Fang Heng’s attributes, had a huge advantage!
The Licker team, which had charged into the zombie team, instantly took control of the situation.
Before the mutated zombie team could climb out of the ground, it was pierced through by the Licker’s sharp claws.
Zhong Lei stood there for a while, then quietly put down the automatic rifle in his hand.
The Lickers had taken control of the situation.
The vaccine was still spreading, and the zombie team underground was still mutating. More and more zombies were coming out from under their feet.
Ding Min looked at Fang Heng and said, “Fang Heng, I need to collect more sample data.”
“Yes, I understand.”
While speaking, a Tyrant form zombie extended a few vines from its right arm and wrapped around a Tier 2 ghost claw zombie that had just been resurrected from the underground.
“Bang bang! Bang!”
The Tyrant took a step forward and brought the ghost claw zombie to Fang Heng.
Fang Heng suddenly reached out his hand and pressed the silver sample collector on the ghost claw zombie’s head.
“Clack...”
At the same time, the other zombie clones did the same thing as Fang Heng. They raised the live sample collector in their hands and stabbed the zombie’s head.
“Clack clack...”
[Hint: You have obtained a living sample of a Tier 2 ghost claw zombie * 6.]
Fang Heng carefully put away the live sample collector.
On the other side, five or six vine zombies staggered up and wrapped the mutated ghost claw zombie’s body tightly. Then, they slowly dragged it into the truck behind them.
“Bring it back, and we’ll study it later.”
Zhong Lei looked at what was happening.
Everything was beyond his understanding of this game.
It could work like that?
“Bang!”
Then, another Tyrant form wrapped around another Tier 2 mutated zombie and walked over.
As usual, Fang Heng picked up a new sample collector and poked the head of the mutated zombie.
In just a few minutes, almost all kinds of mutated zombies were collected.
Fang Heng opened the game log to check.

[Hint: District 7’s vaccine diffusion rate: 0.0001%, Western region’s vaccine diffusion rate: 0.0001%, player’s zone vaccine diffusion rate: 0.52%, zone mutation rate: 0.05%, zone purification rate: 0.03%.]
[Hint: Main storyline mission — Data collection mission completion rate - 0.005%.]
The data collection mission was too slow!
In addition, what were the vaccine diffusion rate and zone evolution rate?
Fang Heng pondered and turned to look at Ding Min.
“Dr. Ding Min, don’t you think our efficiency is a little slow?”
Ding Min frowned and said, “What are you trying to say?”
“Speed up the spread?”
“You better think properly. The risk will greatly increase if we speed up the spread.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng thought for a moment and nodded to confirm.
“Let’s do it.”
Time was tight, and he didn’t have time to waste.
Zhong Lei really wanted to ask Fang Heng what he was going to do, but before he could say anything, he heard heavy footsteps coming from the truck behind him.
He looked back.
Seven fusion Tyrant forms each carried a metal bucket that was more than a meter tall and walked down from the back of the truck.
They walked with heavy steps to the center of the empty muddy ground in front of them.
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
The metal buckets were placed on the ground one by one.
The Tyrant pressed the button on the metal bucket.
“Chi!”
The white, highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine gas visible to the naked eye shot out from the pores reserved in the metal buckets and quickly dissolved in the air.
[Hint: The anti-virus vaccine is spreading at an accelerated rate...]
“This...”
As time passed, Zhong Lei’s heart thumped wildly.
Crazy! Really crazy!
He saw countless mutated zombie reaching out their hands from under the scorched earth.
Starting from Tier 1 and Tier 2 mutated zombies in the beginning.
To Tier 3 after that...
Or even Tier 4!
Tier 5!
The fusion Tyrant forms had also joined the battlefield.
They clashed fiercely with the mutated giant zombie.
Fang Heng’s calm expression gradually turned into surprise and joy.

As the anti-virus vaccine spread faster, mutated zombies emerged from the ground around them. The entire scorched area was affected by the virus mutation, and countless high-level mutated zombie teams were reviving from the ground!
The number and strength of the mutated zombie teams were far beyond Fang Heng’s original estimation!
The small zombie team was surrounded by the zombie crowd from all directions!
The zombie team controlled by Fang Heng could no longer withstand the attack. Even Tyrant started to die under the attack of the mutated zombie teams...
“Boom!”
Tier 5 mutated zombie — Ghost eye!
Its body was covered with dense yellow eyes. Just looking at it made people feel nauseous. The powerful infection and hunting ability it possessed made the player extremely afraid of it!
Zhong Lei panicked. He carefully looked at Fang Heng, but he saw a strange look in Fang Heng’s eyes...
Eh? Surprise?
Zhong Lei felt like he had seen it wrongly!
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted.
Tier 5!
Great!
He had finally found it! Large groups of Tier 4 and Tier 5 mutated zombie teams!
Fang Heng’s game log refreshed at an extremely fast speed!
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 4 special mutated zombie — One-eyed.]
[Hint: You have obtained 281 survival points, Tier 2 evolution crystal * 1.]
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 3 special mutated zombie — Sharp blade...]
They were all evolution crystals!
It had been a long time since he had obtained so many points and evolution crystals so easily!
In less than half an hour, Fang Heng’s points and evolution crystals were increasing rapidly!
Zhong Lei couldn’t help but ask, “Fang Heng, should we retreat?”
Fang Heng glanced at the three Tyrants who were fighting against the ghost eye zombie, thinking that it was a pity.
He had been stuck at level 18 for a long time!
Not only was it difficult to kill a high-tier zombie corpse, but it would also take a long time just to find it!
It was not easy to find a chance to kill a zombie and obtain an advanced evolution crystal!
He thought that he would at least have to wait until he completed the main storyline mission, then obtain the ownership of the Zombie Apocalypse before he could slowly find a chance to level up.
He didn’t expect to see the hope of leveling up now!
But...
“Forget it.”
Fang Heng took a deep breath and let himself regain his senses.
With the spread of the anti-virus vaccine, the resurrected mutated zombie teams would become even stronger!
His current zombie clones were showing signs of being unable to hold on. He could no longer see the end of the zombie teams around him... If he was not careful, he might die here as well.
“Okay, that’s it for today. Let’s retreat first!”
After receiving Fang Heng’s order, the zombie Tyrant forms began to cover Fang Heng and the others as they retreated.
Eight zombie fusion Tyrant forms opened up a path in front of the truck.
The NPCs boarded the truck and brought the zombie test subjects that were tied up in the trailer behind them back to the shelter where they came from.

Against a low-level zombie team, the Licker team, which had inherited part of Fang Heng’s attributes, had a huge advantage!
The Licker team, which had charged into the zombie team, instantly took control of the situation.
Before the mutated zombie team could climb out of the ground, it was pierced through by the Licker’s sharp claws.
Zhong Lei stood there for a while, then quietly put down the automatic rifle in his hand.
The Lickers had taken control of the situation.
The vaccine was still spreading, and the zombie team underground was still mutating.
More and more zombies were coming out from under their feet.

They raised the live sample collector in their hands and stabbed the zombie’s head.
“Clack clack...”

It could work like that?

As usual, Fang Heng picked up a new sample collector and poked the head of the mutated zombie.

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - Escape Is More Important
paragraphs: “Shortly after you left the shelter, you were attacked by the Lickers? And you discovered a mutant worm body?”
Noyce was very confused when he heard the news of the team being wiped out.
What was going on?
When did the mutant worm bodies appear in the Western region?
Noyce realized the severity of the situation.
He was wondering if this matter was related to the Leftway Gaming Guild. Suddenly, his personal survival computer received several urgent messages.
Something big had happened in the scorched area!
A super-sized zombie tide had erupted!
A large number of high-tier zombies had spread out from underground, including a large number of Tier 4 zombies and a small number of Tier 5 zombies!
The zombie tide began to riot and spread rapidly in all directions. Several shelters had already been completely destroyed by the zombie tide.

It was said that a large number of zombie teams were still resurrecting in the scorched area. The giant-sized zombie teams were even spawning. It was only a matter of time before the entire scorched area fell.
After that, the wandering zombie teams would most likely spread to a few areas near the scorched area!
Boom!
Upon hearing the sudden bad news, Noyce immediately cursed in his heart.
Their base was near the scorched area!
If the information was accurate, when the scorched area completely fell, their Seventh Dimension Gaming Guild’s base would be the first to be attacked by the zombie teams!
Noyce had a feeling that a calamity had descended from the heavens.
He instantly threw the problem of the Leftway Gaming Guild to the back of his mind and began to think about how to deal with this crazy zombie horde!
The entire District 7’s Western region’s player forums were also in an uproar.

This giant-sized zombie tide in the scorched area came suddenly, and its intensity was even more shocking! For a time, all kinds of live streaming posts and videos were flying all over the forum, and everyone was panicking.
Noyce steadied his mind and hurriedly commanded the shelter’s players to strengthen the defensive line.
Not long after, large trucks lined up and drove into the shelter from the highway.
“Hi, Noyce.”
Zhong Lei stuck his head out of the driver’s seat and greeted Noyce.
“You’re back so soon?”
Noyce was very anxious.

Now that a big disaster was coming, Noyce was not in the mood to find out Zhong Lei’s real purpose in coming to the Western region. “I’m sorry, I have other things to deal with. There’s a big problem in the Western region.”

“Yeah, I heard about it too. When we came back, we saw a lot of wandering zombies on the road. Damn, a lot of zombies rose from the ground. You didn’t see that scene. It was too scary. We didn’t even finish our mission and escaped back.”
Seeing Noyce’s face, Zhong Lei was in a good mood.
Why did he send someone to follow them? It would be fun now!
While talking, Zhong Lei secretly glanced at the culprit, Fang Heng.
Fang Heng was sitting in the passenger seat, wearing a mask and pretending to be asleep.
“Damn it! Are you sure? Is the zombie tide heading toward our shelter?”
“To be precise, the zombie tide is very strange. The zombies are wandering aimlessly, so...”
Zhong Lei shook his head.
He was really scared.
Thinking back to the time when they escaped, they had relied on the eight enhanced Tyrant forms to fight their way out from the center of the zombie tide.
If they delay for more than ten minutes, they might be trapped in the center of the zombie tide and die.
Along the way, Zhong Lei saw countless zombies resurrecting from the underground.
“Damn it!” Noyce couldn’t help but curse, “What is going on with those zombies?”
“Who knows?” Zhong Lei spread his hands, looking helpless. “I’m sorry, Noyce. Those zombies are too scary. We can’t defeat them, so we have to run away. Anyway, good luck.”
After returning to the headquarters through the teleportation passage, Ding Min immediately gathered the research personnel in the headquarters to conduct research on the mutated zombies.
Fang Heng also entered the research headquarters, while Zhong Lei brought the NPCs back to the Leftway Gaming Guild through the portal and reported their trip.
After spending a lot of effort, Fang Heng controlled the vine zombies to lock the mutated zombies’ research bodies into the cultivation pod one by one.
“Gulp, gulp, gulp...”
After the cultivation pod was filled with a special liquid, the mutated zombies that were captured quieted down one by one and fell into a coma.
Fang Heng looked at the research objects in the cultivation pod curiously.
The entire Scavenger Army’s laboratory was bustling with activity.
Ding Min stood in front of the cultivation pod and carefully recorded the detailed data of each live sample in the cultivation pod.
“I’ll immediately start working on the mutated zombie team and find a way to get more information about the anti-virus. I need your Tyrant form to help me...”
“Of course, no problem.”
Fang Heng agreed immediately.
“What do you want me to do?”
As soon as he said that, a game hint appeared in front of Fang Heng’s eyes.
[Hint: Your apocalypse radio station has received an urgent message.]
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat, and he immediately turned on the survival radio.

[Zhong Lei: Boss Fang Heng, the Federation has made a big move. I’ve been blocked in the teleportation hall by the Scavenger Army. It’s very urgent. If it’s convenient, it’s best if we can meet each other quickly. We’re in the teleportation hall.]
“Eh, Ding Min, I...”
Ding Min noticed Fang Heng’s movement. She stroked her short hair and said, “Forget it. Go do your work. I’m here.”
“Phew, then I’ll leave it to you. I’ll bring you skin care products next time.”
Fang Heng nodded at Ding Min and left the laboratory in a hurry.
Ding Min took one last look at Fang Heng, who left in a hurry and shook her head helplessly.
She continued to concentrate.
“Research team! Prepare for the first round of testing for a Tier 1 mutated zombie...”
In the teleportation hall, Zhong Lei had just received the latest news from the headquarters and immediately rushed to Fang Heng.
Unexpectedly, the people from the Scavenger Army didn’t care about him and directly stopped him.
Feeling helpless, Zhong Lei could only send a message to Fang Heng for help.
Seeing Fang Heng appear, he came forward quickly.

“Fang Heng, we are in trouble. The president just got the news from a special channel. The Federation has gathered almost all the strength of District 7 and is preparing to complete the assembly by four o’clock tomorrow afternoon to launch a general attack on the Scavenger Army. There is news that their first batch of battle materials has been transported to the front line through the teleportation passage.”
Hearing this, Fang Heng immediately felt a headache.
No way?
Again?
Why is the Federation not willing to stop?
Fang Heng was quite angry.
If the Federation really didn’t care and did everything to find trouble with him, the Scavenger Army’s headquarters wouldn’t be able to hold on!
Zhong Lei was a little flustered. He asked, “Fang Heng, what should we do?”
“No need to panic. It’s very stable.”
Fang Heng licked his lips lightly, and a hint of madness flashed in his eyes.
Good!
Does he want to play?
Then they’ll play big!
