chapters.title: Chapter 461 - Playing a Big Game
paragraphs: Fang Heng raised his head and asked, “Do you know where they will gather?”

“Hmm, it should be in the Songxi Mountain area. The Federation has a large-scale shelter there, and all the materials are temporarily gathered there. The president and I have studied it before, and the chances of forcefully attacking there are very small.”
“Hmm.” Fang Heng continued to ask, “How are the preparations for the materials to make the anti-virus vaccine coming along?”

“We have reached an agreement with the Federation. We have used 10,000 doses of anti-mutant worm injections to exchange for a portion of the funds and a large number of medicinal ingredients. It is expected that the medicinal ingredients will reach our gaming union’s shelter before sunset tonight. When that time comes, we will secretly transport them through the teleportation passage to the research institute.”
Zhong Lei made a rough estimate. “Together with the materials that we purchased ourselves, it should be enough to make the second batch of highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine.”
“Alright.”

Fang Heng clenched his fist and patted Zhong Lei’s shoulder. “Go and tell the Federation that we’ve leveled up the anti-mutant worm injection again. It’s even more effective than the previous one. After the injection, we can remain immune to the attacks of the mutant worm bodies for a period of time. Ask them if they still want it. If they want it, they’ll have to pay more.”
“Ah? This?”
Zhong Lei was stunned.
What was going on?
They clearly knew that the Federation’s people had already rushed over. Why would they still think of a way to send bullets to the Federation?
Was Fang Heng crazy? Was he planning to take a large sum of money from the Federation and leave?

“Think of a way to get all the medicinal ingredients and materials from the Federation’s reserve. If they don’t have the medicinal ingredients, let them use the funds to pay for it. Also, before the sun sets tonight, the materials must be delivered to the Federation!”
Zhong Lei swallowed his saliva.
Medicinal ingredients?
Suddenly, Zhong Lei suddenly understood the purpose of Fang Heng’s move.
“Fang Heng... You mean to say...”
“Mm, you’re right.”
Smash a pot to pieces just because it’s cracked.
Mass-produce a highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine and then throw the vaccine to the Eastern region!
Zhong Lei felt a chill down his spine.
What the heck!
He did not expect Fang Heng to be so tough!
Previously, in the scorched area, only about half of the high-concentration anti-virus vaccine had been produced in the Western region.
Up until now, the entire Western region was still in chaos. It was thrown into chaos by the sudden outbreak of the giant-sized zombie tide.
In theory, if they had the Federation’s medicinal ingredients, they could produce a high-concentration anti-virus vaccine that was ten times stronger.
If the Federation encountered a zombie horde halfway through their attempt to attack the Scavenger Army...
Zhong Lei’s breathing became heavy.
Even the Federation would definitely be wiped out there!
Not to mention the Federation, even the entire Eastern region would be dragged into the zombie horde by the vaccine!
Even the Scavenger Army could not avoid being affected by the zombie horde...
“Hurry up. We have limited time. Quickly tell Tian Zhen to think of a way to do it. We don’t have much time.”
Zhong Lei took a deep breath.
“Okay!”
Watching Zhong Lei rush back to report, Fang Heng also stretched.
It was time to start working again.
Apart from making a large number of anti-mutant worm body injections to deliver to the Federation, he also needed to make a large number of highly concentrated anti-virus vaccines.
Fang Heng had already predicted that tonight would be a sleepless night.
Fine, if this went on, he would definitely stay up all night and die!
After thinking about it, Fang Heng threw down a mattress and quickly went offline to catch up on his sleep.
He went online again, and the first thing Fang Heng did was to look for Ding Min.
“Wait a moment.”
Ding Min was busy working in front of the experiment table.
After a moment, she put down the temporary potion that she had just finished, turned her head, and looked at Fang Heng.
“We’ve already done more than half of the research. The sample data we’ve collected so far is enough for us to improve and develop the first stage of the vaccine.”
“Improve and develop? You mean the antibody virus vaccine?”
Fang Heng was stunned.

“Yes. After improving, the probability of zombies mutating will reduce slightly from the vaccine’s effectiveness, and the speed of its spread will also increase slightly.” Ding Min said. She yawned and explained, “However, the improvement and development will still require some time.”
A row of game hints appeared in Fang Heng’s retina.
[Hint: The research team of the Scavenger Army has completed the analysis of Tier 1 mutated zombie live samples * 9. Main storyline — Data collection mission completion rate increased to: 84.124%.]
[Hint: The research team of the Scavenger Army has completed the analysis of Tier 2 mutated zombie live samples * 12. Main storyline — Data collection mission completion rate increased to: 102.288%.]
[Hint: Your current data collection has reached 100%. You can now proceed to level up the vaccine body.]
Fang Heng skimmed through the game hint and suddenly had an epiphany.
Therefore, the high concentration of the antibody virus vaccine could be leveled up.
In theory, as the virus continued to spread and the sample information collected increased, the vaccine would also continue to level up.
By then, the mutation rate of the zombies would improve, and the pressure on them would be greatly reduced.
Fang Heng opened the game hint and checked it again.
[Hint: District 7’s vaccine diffusion rate: 0.0005%, Western region’s vaccine diffusion rate: 0.0261%, player’s zone vaccine diffusion rate: 0%, zone mutation rate: 0%, zone purification rate: 0%.]
Should he increase the vaccine body diffusion rate to 100%? There was also the choice of zone purification rate.
Once the zone purification rate reached 100%, would it mean that the entire zone would be purified?
In the morning, the scorched area’s purification rate of 24 was already on the verge of collapse.
Wait...
If he could borrow the Federation’s strength, would he be able to increase the purification rate to 100%?
Fang Heng’s thoughts started to come alive again.
“Fang Heng.”
“Eh?”
Ding Min asked, “When do we start the research and development work?”

“No, there’s no need to be in such a hurry.” Fang Heng smiled gently and said, “It’s too late. It’s not good to stay up all night. You should go and rest first. You’ve worked hard these past two days. I’ll give you a day off, and you can continue to rest tomorrow. Leave the rest to me.”
New research and development? Improve the mutation rate of zombies?
Fang Heng couldn’t wait for the zombies’ mutation rate to be as high as possible!
He wasn’t in a hurry to develop an improved potion. He would talk about it in the future!
“Eh? Why are you so nice all of a sudden?”
Hearing that she didn’t need to stay up all night, Ding Min looked at Fang Heng in surprise.
Ever since Fang Heng became the commander of the Scavenger Army, Ding Min had classified Fang Heng as a fighter.
She was still not used to seeing Fang Heng give her a break.
“Hey, don’t look at me like that. I’m not a bad person...”
After confirming that Fang Heng was not joking, Ding Min’s mood improved a little. She rubbed her sore shoulder.
“Okay, then I’ll go rest.”
[Hint: Your favorability rating with Ding Min has slightly increased. Ding Min’s loyalty to the Scavenger Army has increased to 96].

“Hmm, it should be in the Songxi Mountain area.
The Federation has a large-scale shelter there, and all the materials are temporarily gathered there.
The president and I have studied it before, and the chances of forcefully attacking there are very small.”
“Hmm.” Fang Heng continued to ask, “How are the preparations for the materials to make the anti-virus vaccine coming along?”
“We have reached an agreement with the Federation.
We have used 10,000 doses of anti-mutant worm injections to exchange for a portion of the funds and a large number of medicinal ingredients.
It is expected that the medicinal ingredients will reach our gaming union’s shelter before sunset tonight.
When that time comes, we will secretly transport them through the teleportation passage to the research institute.”
Zhong Lei made a rough estimate.
“Together with the materials that we purchased ourselves, it should be enough to make the second batch of highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine.”
“Alright.”
Fang Heng clenched his fist and patted Zhong Lei’s shoulder.
“Go and tell the Federation that we’ve leveled up the anti-mutant worm injection again.
It’s even more effective than the previous one.
After the injection, we can remain immune to the attacks of the mutant worm bodies for a period of time.
Ask them if they still want it.
If they want it, they’ll have to pay more.”
“Ah?
This?”
Zhong Lei was stunned.
What was going on?
They clearly knew that the Federation’s people had already rushed over.
Why would they still think of a way to send bullets to the Federation?
Was Fang Heng crazy?
Was he planning to take a large sum of money from the Federation and leave?
“Think of a way to get all the medicinal ingredients and materials from the Federation’s reserve.
If they don’t have the medicinal ingredients, let them use the funds to pay for it.
Also, before the sun sets tonight, the materials must be delivered to the Federation!”
Zhong Lei swallowed his saliva.
Medicinal ingredients?
Suddenly, Zhong Lei suddenly understood the purpose of Fang Heng’s move.
“Fang Heng...
You mean to say...”
“Mm, you’re right.”
Smash a pot to pieces just because it’s cracked.
Mass-produce a highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine and then throw the vaccine to the Eastern region!
Zhong Lei felt a chill down his spine.
What the heck!
He did not expect Fang Heng to be so tough!
Previously, in the scorched area, only about half of the high-concentration anti-virus vaccine had been produced in the Western region.
Up until now, the entire Western region was still in chaos.
It was thrown into chaos by the sudden outbreak of the giant-sized zombie tide.
In theory, if they had the Federation’s medicinal ingredients, they could produce a high-concentration anti-virus vaccine that was ten times stronger.
If the Federation encountered a zombie horde halfway through their attempt to attack the Scavenger Army...
Zhong Lei’s breathing became heavy.
Even the Federation would definitely be wiped out there!
Not to mention the Federation, even the entire Eastern region would be dragged into the zombie horde by the vaccine!
Even the Scavenger Army could not avoid being affected by the zombie horde...
“Hurry up.
We have limited time.
Quickly tell Tian Zhen to think of a way to do it.
We don’t have much time.”
Zhong Lei took a deep breath.
“Okay!”
Watching Zhong Lei rush back to report, Fang Heng also stretched.
It was time to start working again.
Apart from making a large number of anti-mutant worm body injections to deliver to the Federation, he also needed to make a large number of highly concentrated anti-virus vaccines.
Fang Heng had already predicted that tonight would be a sleepless night.
Fine, if this went on, he would definitely stay up all night and die!
After thinking about it, Fang Heng threw down a mattress and quickly went offline to catch up on his sleep.
He went online again, and the first thing Fang Heng did was to look for Ding Min.
“Wait a moment.”
Ding Min was busy working in front of the experiment table.
After a moment, she put down the temporary potion that she had just finished, turned her head, and looked at Fang Heng.
“We’ve already done more than half of the research.
The sample data we’ve collected so far is enough for us to improve and develop the first stage of the vaccine.”
“Improve and develop?
You mean the antibody virus vaccine?”
Fang Heng was stunned.
“Yes.
After improving, the probability of zombies mutating will reduce slightly from the vaccine’s effectiveness, and the speed of its spread will also increase slightly.” Ding Min said.
She yawned and explained, “However, the improvement and development will still require some time.”
A row of game hints appeared in Fang Heng’s retina.
[Hint: The research team of the Scavenger Army has completed the analysis of Tier 1 mutated zombie live samples * 9.
Main storyline — Data collection mission completion rate increased to: 84.124%.]
[Hint: The research team of the Scavenger Army has completed the analysis of Tier 2 mutated zombie live samples * 12.
Main storyline — Data collection mission completion rate increased to: 102.288%.]
[Hint: Your current data collection has reached 100%.
You can now proceed to level up the vaccine body.]
Fang Heng skimmed through the game hint and suddenly had an epiphany.
Therefore, the high concentration of the antibody virus vaccine could be leveled up.
In theory, as the virus continued to spread and the sample information collected increased, the vaccine would also continue to level up.
By then, the mutation rate of the zombies would improve, and the pressure on them would be greatly reduced.
Fang Heng opened the game hint and checked it again.
[Hint: District 7’s vaccine diffusion rate: 0.0005%, Western region’s vaccine diffusion rate: 0.0261%, player’s zone vaccine diffusion rate: 0%, zone mutation rate: 0%, zone purification rate: 0%.]
Should he increase the vaccine body diffusion rate to 100%?
There was also the choice of zone purification rate.
Once the zone purification rate reached 100%, would it mean that the entire zone would be purified?
In the morning, the scorched area’s purification rate of 24 was already on the verge of collapse.
Wait...
If he could borrow the Federation’s strength, would he be able to increase the purification rate to 100%?
Fang Heng’s thoughts started to come alive again.
“Fang Heng.”
“Eh?”
Ding Min asked, “When do we start the research and development work?”
“No, there’s no need to be in such a hurry.” Fang Heng smiled gently and said, “It’s too late.
It’s not good to stay up all night.
You should go and rest first.
You’ve worked hard these past two days.
I’ll give you a day off, and you can continue to rest tomorrow.
Leave the rest to me.”
New research and development?
Improve the mutation rate of zombies?
Fang Heng couldn’t wait for the zombies’ mutation rate to be as high as possible!
He wasn’t in a hurry to develop an improved potion.
He would talk about it in the future!
“Eh?
Why are you so nice all of a sudden?”
Hearing that she didn’t need to stay up all night, Ding Min looked at Fang Heng in surprise.
Ever since Fang Heng became the commander of the Scavenger Army, Ding Min had classified Fang Heng as a fighter.
She was still not used to seeing Fang Heng give her a break.
“Hey, don’t look at me like that.
I’m not a bad person...”
After confirming that Fang Heng was not joking, Ding Min’s mood improved a little.
She rubbed her sore shoulder.
“Okay, then I’ll go rest.”
[Hint: Your favorability rating with Ding Min has slightly increased.
Ding Min’s loyalty to the Scavenger Army has increased to 96].

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - Bet
paragraphs: Fang Heng watched Ding Min leave.
Before he could leave the research room, Osborne brought the anxious Zhong Lei to look for Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, the Federation has agreed to our conditions!”
Zhong Lei’s breathing was somewhat heavy. The first thing he did was to look for Fang Heng and immediately report the latest progress of the Federation to him.

“The materials that the Federation has promised us have already been sent to our union headquarters. In addition, the Federation has also told us that they are very interested in the injection for the anti-fusion Tyrant form’s mutant worm body. They will be willing to increase the price to buy the injection.”
“Before noon tomorrow, they will want as many injections as we have!”
“Ha! What big words. Aren’t they afraid that I will pluck all his wool?”
Fang Heng was delighted when he heard that.
Coincidentally, they didn’t have any money, and the Federation sent them money!
Using injections to exchange for medicinal ingredients and money! A business without capital!
Fang Heng’s gaze shifted to Osborne at the side.
“Have you prepared the large warehouse that I need? Go gather all the potioneers in the Scavenger Army over there.”
“It’s already prepared. I’ll immediately gather people.”
Fang Heng’s heart was burning with passion.
Good!
Now, with the medicinal ingredients, the potioneers were also ready, and there was also that spendthrift from the Federation.
Everything was ready!
Tonight, roll it up for me!
Fang Heng spent the entire night perfecting his potion-making assembly line.
The NPC potioneers worked tirelessly with the zombie team.
Finally, at 10:30 am the next day, all the anti-mutant worm injections and high-concentration anti-virus vaccines that were supposed to be submitted to the Federation had been completed.
Boxes of finished products and metal boxes containing high-concentration anti-virus vaccines were neatly stacked in the corner of the large warehouse.
A total of six rows!
It was full of a sense of accomplishment!
Fang Heng stretched his body and poured a bottle of coffee into his mouth.
Next, it was time to carry out the next step of the plan.
Let Tian Zhen bring the anti-mutant worm injection to the Federation to ask for money! Then use the money to buy a shelter and build a magnetic field induction device!

At the same time, he had to think of a way to arrange the distribution of the high-concentration antibody virus vaccines in advance to ensure that the Federation could receive the big gift package he prepared.
Even though he had stayed up all night, Fang Heng was still in high spirits when he thought of the plan that was about to be launched.
Outside the warehouse, Zhong Lei also did not go offline to rest for the entire night.
He waited outside the warehouse for the whole night.
The pressure was too great.

President Tian Zhen couldn’t sleep at all, so he had Zhong Lei wait outside the warehouse for Fang Heng 24/7, reporting the situation every half an hour. If there was any news, he would report back immediately.
The entire Leftway Gaming Guild had placed their stakes on Fang Heng.
If Fang Heng failed, their game guild would also go bankrupt.
“Hua la la la...”
Hearing the sound of the warehouse door being opened behind him, Zhong Lei quivered.
He suddenly turned his head and looked behind him.
“Fang Heng? How’s the situation?”
Fang Heng stretched lazily and looked at Zhong Lei.
“Hmm, not bad. You’ve been waiting for me?”
Zhong Lei felt his heart beating wildly.
He couldn’t help but poke his head out to look inside the warehouse. He confirmed with Fang Heng once again. “Yes, have you finished the mutant worm body injections and vaccines?”
“Yes, it’s done. Get the people of the Federation to prepare to come and pick up the goods.”
Zhong Lei saw rows of large boxes in the warehouse. He said in surprise, “All the boxes are filled with anti-mutant worm injections?”
“That’s right.”
Fang Heng said and waved his hand forward, signaling the Scavenger Army elites to start moving the big boxes filled with anti-mutant worm injections to the teleportation hall.
“In short, I’ll leave the rest to you.”
Fang Heng said with a vicious expression and instructed, “You must extort a good sum from the Federation!”
“No problem! Leave it to our Leftway Gaming Guild!”
Zhong Lei also clenched his fists tightly, his face showing his excitement.
As he spoke, Fang Heng’s expression gradually calmed down as he looked behind Zhong Lei.
“Hey, you, isn’t it bad to eavesdrop on others?”
A figure slowly appeared behind Zhong Lei.
“No offense, Fang Heng, I’ve been waiting for you.”
What the hell!
Seeing the person who suddenly appeared behind him, Zhong Lei was shocked.
“Is that so?” Fang Heng shrugged. “I’m sorry, I’ve been really busy recently. How long have you been waiting?”
“About five hours.”
Zhong Lei was a little angry.
He was thinking about whether the people of Black Castle were sick? They actually sneakily lurked by the side for a full five hours!
What made Zhong Lei even more uncomfortable was that he had not noticed the presence of anyone around him!
Wu Siying was expressionless. She glanced sideways at the Scavenger Army elites who were moving boxes behind her.
“Anti-mutant worm injections? What are you thinking? Fang Heng? Are you ready to give up on the main storyline in District 7?”
“Not really.”
Fang Heng looked at Wu Siying. “Let’s get to the point. What do you want from me?”

“Being able to control the fusion Tyrant form is indeed a surprise to me. This is enough for Black Castle to conduct a new evaluation of you, but this alone is far from enough to take over the final ownership of District 7.”
“You should have received the news that the Federation has gathered all their strength to launch an attack on the Scavengers Army.”
“It is expected that the Federation will launch an operation before sunset today, and you actually chose to sell the potion to the Federation? What on earth are you thinking?”
When she realized that Fang Heng could control the fusion Tyrant form, Wu Siying was indeed surprised at Fang Heng’s strength.
She hoped even more that Fang Heng could join the Black Castle.
Last night, Wu Siying had been waiting for Fang Heng to come to find her.
Faced with the full force of the Federation, she felt that asking for help from the Black Castle was Fang Heng’s only choice now.
However, she waited, but Fang Heng did not arrive last night.
Therefore, Wu Siying could only look for Fang Heng herself.
And now, Fang Heng’s choice to sell the anti-mutant worm injection once again surprised her.
The fusion Tyrant form was clearly Fang Heng’s greatest trump card right now!
Yet, he was using it to exchange for money?
Was he thinking of giving up on the fight for the ownership of District 7?
“Ahem, of course, it’s about thinking of earning a sum of money from the Federation.”
Wu Siying could no longer understand Fang Heng.

“Fang Heng, if you join Black Castle, we can help you solve the Federation’s problems. We can also help you smoothly obtain the final ownership of District 7. Please believe in us. Black Castle will only invite the most outstanding player to join.”
“Is that so? I still have to thank you for thinking highly of me.”
Fang Heng curled his lips. “But I’m fine now. I don’t need your help.”
Wu Siying frowned.
She felt that Fang Heng was forcing himself.
“If you join the Black Castle, you can get more resources. It will only be favorable for you...”
“Forget it.” Fang Heng waved his hand and interrupted, “Let’s make a bet again.”
It was that bet again!
Wu Siying shook her head in her heart.
But Fang Heng kept talking.

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - Great Effort
paragraphs: “If I manage to resist the Federation, tell me the information about the final outcome of the main storyline. If I fail, you guys can do it instead, and I’ll join Black Castle. How’s my suggestion? ”
“Think about it carefully. Once the Federation starts an all-out attack on the Scavenger Army, we may not be able to help you. ”
“Of course. ” Fang Heng nodded. “I’m very confident that they can’t win. ”
Wu Siying stared at Fang Heng.
She was very curious about where Fang Heng’s confidence came from.
He could resist the entire Federation of District 7?
After thinking carefully, Wu Siying came to a conclusion.
The gamble was beneficial to her.
Fang Heng had already explicitly refused to join Black Castle.

If Fang Heng could really resist the Federation, then all the more Fang Heng would not choose to join Black Castle, and it would only be a matter of time before Fang Heng took control of the entire District 7.

Giving him information about the main storyline would not change anything, nor would it affect Black Castle. However, the main storyline information could be said to be a timely help to Fang Heng. It was equivalent to doing Fang Heng a favor.
If Fang Heng could not resist the Federation, Black Castle would win the entire bet and smoothly take Fang Heng under their wing.
Wu Siying nodded and said, “All right. Let’s bet on this, but I also have a condition. ”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up. “Go ahead. ”
“No matter what the outcome is, you owe Black Castle a favor. ”
“Deal! ”
Over at the Federation’s side, in a large-sized shelter located in the Songxi Mountain area of District 7, Kou Huai personally took charge.
He had mobilized almost all the resources of the Federation in District 7 for the upcoming operation.
There was only one purpose, and it was to completely destroy the Scavenger Army where Fang Heng belonged!
In order to avoid being sabotaged by useless teammates again, only the Federation and the Dark Knights were to be involved in the joint clearing operation.
It was unknown when Fang Heng’s existence had started to make Kou Huai feel fear.
Kou Huai decided to put all his chips on the table and destroy the Scavenger Army in one fell swoop!
“Are all the members here? ”
“All except the three teams from the Western region have arrived. They can set off at any time. ”

The deputy commander of the battlefield reported to Kou Huai, “Sir, yesterday, there was a super-sized zombie wave in the Western region for unknown reasons. The Western region suffered heavy casualties. At present, the zombie wave in the Western region is no longer spawning, but the crisis has not been resolved yet. The three teams from the Federation are doing their best to resist the aftermath of the super-sized zombie wave. I’m afraid they won’t be able to participate in the joint killing of the Scavenger Army this time. ”

“Okay, I got it. ” Kou Huai hummed. He had heard about what happened in the Western region the day before. However, for the time being, his attention was focused on Fang Heng, so he was not in the mood to pay attention to the crisis in the Western region.
Turning around to look at Xiao Changle, Kou Huai asked him again, “This has nothing to do with the Scavenger Army or Fang Heng, right? ”
Xiao Changle’s face turned serious. “I promise, absolutely not! ”

“Sir, the potion from Leftway Gaming Guild has been delivered, and the test has been completed. The effect is confirmed to be excellent. The potion can resist the mutant worm body for a short period of time. ”
“Okay! ” Kou Huai’s eyes lit up.
The most troublesome problem had been solved.
With the potion, Fang Heng’s trump card, the mutant worm body Tyrant, would be rendered useless.
However, Leftway Gaming Guild was still hateful!
They took advantage of the situation and demanded an exorbitant price for each bottle of anti-mutant worm body potion!
Kou Huai gritted his teeth, stomaching his anger.
He secretly swore.
After dealing with Fang Heng, he would make Leftway Gaming Guild cough out all the money!
“Sir! The heavy weapons are ready. ”
“Distribute all the resources. Get everyone ready. Take down the Scavenger Army in one go! We will move out in ten minutes! ”
“Understood! ”
Seeing that Xiao Changle was hesitating, Kou Huai frowned and asked, “Is there anything else you need to report? ”

“Sir, we suspect that the Scavenger Army might have been prepared in advance. Not long ago, we received a report. Many players who are cooperating with us reported that they found that the members of the Scavenger Army were retreating. ”
Kou Huai hummed, not paying much mind to it as it was normal for news of such a big operation to leak out.
Fang Heng must have also received the news in advance.

“So, he wants to give up the Scavenger Army’s periphery defense and shrink the defense line like a coward? Ha! Let’s see how long you can be cowardly for! ” Kou Huai could not help but sneer in his heart.
He then ordered, “Ignore them. Proceed according to the plan. The whole army will set off in ten minutes! ”
“Understood! ”
With the order, the Federation soldiers marched in the direction of the Scavenger Army.
Two hours later, the first team of the Federation arrived at Edge Creek Town.

“Reporting, sir! ” The first team in front had arrived at Edge Creek Town and found that there was no resistance in the town. The second and seventh teams had entered Edge Creek Town three minutes ago to investigate, but they did not find any traces of the Scavenger Army. It was confirmed that the Scavenger Army soldiers in Edge Creek town had retreated in advance.

“Okay. ” Kou Huai’s expression didn’t change, and he sneered in his heart, “As expected! They caught wind of the news and fled in advance! We’ll fight our way to your main base. Try to escape if you can then. ”
He then commanded, “Continue to attack. There’s no need to take a detour. Go directly to the Scavenger Army headquarter! ”
“Yes! ”
On a small hill far away from Edge Creek Town.
Fang Heng sat on the ground casually, holding a telescope and observing the ground from a distance. He stuffed an Oreo biscuit into his mouth.
After the Federation teams took over Edge Creek Town, they took a short rest in Edge Creek town, then quickly continued to move forward.
Looking from a high vantage point, the Federation teams banded together, exuding an imposing aura.
Fang Heng curled his lips and said disdainfully, “Do you see that? There are so many high-level weapons. It seems that Kou Huai really wants to kill me. He has spent a lot of money. ”

Wu Siying stood beside Fang Heng and asked, “Fang Heng, what exactly are you planning? Once the Federation officially starts to take action, even we can’t guarantee that we can save the Scavenger Army. ”
“There’s no need for you to save them. Our Scavenger Army is determined to stay alive and destroy this world. After all, anti-forces usually last till the end. ”
Fang Heng had a plan.
As he spoke, he turned on the survival radio and sent a message to Zhong Lei, “Do it! ”
Zhong Lei, who was in the sewer under Edge Creek Town, received the news and immediately spread the news to his subordinates.
The players in every corner of the underground sewer in Edge Creek Town received Zhong Lei’s message and immediately opened the valve on the metal box at the side.
Almost at the same time, game hints appeared in front of Fang Heng.
“Hint: your player team has released a highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine... ”
“Hint: the vaccine’s spread has caused a mutation in the virus in the area. ”
“Hint: District 7’s vaccine’s spread: 0.0004% , Eastern region’s vaccine’s spread: 0.00% , player’s zone vaccine diffusion rate: 0.001% ; zone mutation rate: 0.0001% , zone purification rate: 0% . ”

She was very curious about where Fang Heng’s confidence came from.
He could resist the entire Federation of District 7?
After thinking carefully, Wu Siying came to a conclusion.
The gamble was beneficial to her.
Fang Heng had already explicitly refused to join Black Castle.

If Fang Heng could really resist the Federation, then all the more Fang Heng would not choose to join Black Castle, and it would only be a matter of time before Fang Heng took control of the entire District 7.
Giving him information about the main storyline would not change anything, nor would it affect Black Castle.
However, the main storyline information could be said to be a timely help to Fang Heng.
It was equivalent to doing Fang Heng a favor.
If Fang Heng could not resist the Federation, Black Castle would win the entire bet and smoothly take Fang Heng under their wing.
Wu Siying nodded and said, “All right.
Let’s bet on this, but I also have a condition. ”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
“Go ahead. ”
“No matter what the outcome is, you owe Black Castle a favor. ”
“Deal! ”
Over at the Federation’s side, in a large-sized shelter located in the Songxi Mountain area of District 7, Kou Huai personally took charge.
He had mobilized almost all the resources of the Federation in District 7 for the upcoming operation.
There was only one purpose, and it was to completely destroy the Scavenger Army where Fang Heng belonged!
In order to avoid being sabotaged by useless teammates again, only the Federation and the Dark Knights were to be involved in the joint clearing operation.
It was unknown when Fang Heng’s existence had started to make Kou Huai feel fear.
Kou Huai decided to put all his chips on the table and destroy the Scavenger Army in one fell swoop!
“Are all the members here? ”
“All except the three teams from the Western region have arrived.
They can set off at any time. ”
The deputy commander of the battlefield reported to Kou Huai, “Sir, yesterday, there was a super-sized zombie wave in the Western region for unknown reasons.
The Western region suffered heavy casualties.
At present, the zombie wave in the Western region is no longer spawning, but the crisis has not been resolved yet.
The three teams from the Federation are doing their best to resist the aftermath of the super-sized zombie wave.
I’m afraid they won’t be able to participate in the joint killing of the Scavenger Army this time. ”
“Okay, I got it. ” Kou Huai hummed.
He had heard about what happened in the Western region the day before.
However, for the time being, his attention was focused on Fang Heng, so he was not in the mood to pay attention to the crisis in the Western region.
Turning around to look at Xiao Changle, Kou Huai asked him again, “This has nothing to do with the Scavenger Army or Fang Heng, right? ”
Xiao Changle’s face turned serious.
“I promise, absolutely not! ”
“Sir, the potion from Leftway Gaming Guild has been delivered, and the test has been completed.
The effect is confirmed to be excellent.
The potion can resist the mutant worm body for a short period of time. ”
“Okay! ” Kou Huai’s eyes lit up.
The most troublesome problem had been solved.
With the potion, Fang Heng’s trump card, the mutant worm body Tyrant, would be rendered useless.
However, Leftway Gaming Guild was still hateful!
They took advantage of the situation and demanded an exorbitant price for each bottle of anti-mutant worm body potion!
Kou Huai gritted his teeth, stomaching his anger.
He secretly swore.
After dealing with Fang Heng, he would make Leftway Gaming Guild cough out all the money!
“Sir!
The heavy weapons are ready. ”
“Distribute all the resources.
Get everyone ready.
Take down the Scavenger Army in one go!
We will move out in ten minutes! ”
“Understood! ”
Seeing that Xiao Changle was hesitating, Kou Huai frowned and asked, “Is there anything else you need to report? ”
“Sir, we suspect that the Scavenger Army might have been prepared in advance.
Not long ago, we received a report.
Many players who are cooperating with us reported that they found that the members of the Scavenger Army were retreating. ”
Kou Huai hummed, not paying much mind to it as it was normal for news of such a big operation to leak out.
Fang Heng must have also received the news in advance.
“So, he wants to give up the Scavenger Army’s periphery defense and shrink the defense line like a coward?
Ha!
Let’s see how long you can be cowardly for! ” Kou Huai could not help but sneer in his heart.
He then ordered, “Ignore them.
Proceed according to the plan.
The whole army will set off in ten minutes! ”
“Understood! ”
With the order, the Federation soldiers marched in the direction of the Scavenger Army.
Two hours later, the first team of the Federation arrived at Edge Creek Town.
“Reporting, sir! ” The first team in front had arrived at Edge Creek Town and found that there was no resistance in the town.
The second and seventh teams had entered Edge Creek Town three minutes ago to investigate, but they did not find any traces of the Scavenger Army.
It was confirmed that the Scavenger Army soldiers in Edge Creek town had retreated in advance.
“Okay. ” Kou Huai’s expression didn’t change, and he sneered in his heart, “As expected!
They caught wind of the news and fled in advance!
We’ll fight our way to your main base.
Try to escape if you can then. ”
He then commanded, “Continue to attack.
There’s no need to take a detour.
Go directly to the Scavenger Army headquarter! ”
“Yes! ”
On a small hill far away from Edge Creek Town.
Fang Heng sat on the ground casually, holding a telescope and observing the ground from a distance.
He stuffed an Oreo biscuit into his mouth.
After the Federation teams took over Edge Creek Town, they took a short rest in Edge Creek town, then quickly continued to move forward.
Looking from a high vantage point, the Federation teams banded together, exuding an imposing aura.
Fang Heng curled his lips and said disdainfully, “Do you see that?
There are so many high-level weapons.
It seems that Kou Huai really wants to kill me.
He has spent a lot of money. ”
Wu Siying stood beside Fang Heng and asked, “Fang Heng, what exactly are you planning?
Once the Federation officially starts to take action, even we can’t guarantee that we can save the Scavenger Army. ”
“There’s no need for you to save them.
Our Scavenger Army is determined to stay alive and destroy this world.
After all, anti-forces usually last till the end. ”
Fang Heng had a plan.
As he spoke, he turned on the survival radio and sent a message to Zhong Lei, “Do it! ”
Zhong Lei, who was in the sewer under Edge Creek Town, received the news and immediately spread the news to his subordinates.
The players in every corner of the underground sewer in Edge Creek Town received Zhong Lei’s message and immediately opened the valve on the metal box at the side.
Almost at the same time, game hints appeared in front of Fang Heng.
“Hint: your player team has released a highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine... ”
“Hint: the vaccine’s spread has caused a mutation in the virus in the area. ”
“Hint: District 7’s vaccine’s spread: 0.0004% , Eastern region’s vaccine’s spread: 0.00% , player’s zone vaccine diffusion rate: 0.001% ; zone mutation rate: 0.0001% , zone purification rate: 0% . ”

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - Trap
paragraphs: Wu Siying frowned.
She really could not understand what kind of backup plan Fang Heng had.
In the face of the Federation’s absolute strength, all resistance was futile.
“The game has begun, ” Fang Heng said as he threw away the Oreo biscuit in his hand.
In the dense forest behind him, eight fusion Tyrant forms and hundreds of Lickers were ready to make a move.
The federal team drove their combat trucks on the main road. In the middle of the team, there were even dozens of high-tier armored tanks.
There were also helicopters in the air to scout and provide support.
Fang Heng raised his binoculars and looked ahead.
He saw that the Federation team even had the Dark Knights with them.
Liang Hucheng was relatively more familiar with the terrain of Edge Creek Town.

For the current operation, he was appointed by Kou Huai as the leader of the vanguard exploration team. He personally led three teams to open the path at the front to investigate any ambushes they might encounter along the way.
Liang Hucheng had always been very cautious.
“Wait! ” Halfway through the journey, Liang Hucheng keenly noticed something and extended his hand to signal for the team to temporarily stop in their tracks.
Under the soil on both sides of the road, withered white palms extended upward.
Woo...
Along with the moaning of the zombies, the soil rolled, and the resurrected zombies struggled to climb out of the soil.
Bang, bang, bang!
Liang Hucheng’s federal team behind immediately pulled the trigger, and the powerful firepower was aimed at the zombie team.
In almost an instant, the zombie team that emerged from the ground was completely killed.
Liang Hucheng heaved a sigh of relief. He felt that he was too tense.
It was just a coincidence that they encountered a small-scale zombie wave.
Just as they were about to continue their journey, Liang Hucheng heard a player shout, “Captain! Look over there. ”
Hearing that, Liang Hucheng immediately looked in the direction that his subordinate pointed.
The soil on both sides of the road in front of them also began to churn. A dense mass of greenish-gray palms stretched out from the churning soil.
The gathered zombie team had already strolled onto the main road.

Liang Hucheng began to feel that something was a little strange, thinking, “Two consecutive zombie waves? Could it be that the probability of triggering the zombie wave increased because there are too many players gathered? ”
Bang, bang, bang, bang!
The Federation elites pulled the trigger again.
After a series of bullets were fired, the gunshots paused.
While the player switched their magazines, another zombie team wave emerged from the soil on both sides of the road.
The resurrected zombie teams seemed to be endless.
Liang Hucheng’s brows were tightly knitted together.
He realized that the trouble had just begun.
Just then, a player shouted, “Look over there! There’s more over there! ”
Another shouted, “And over there! ”
“Why are there so many of them? ” Liang Hucheng’s expression changed slightly.
Something was wrong!
Zombies were resurrecting not just in front of the federal team but also on both sides of the road behind them.
The speed and range of the zombies’ resurrection were rapidly expanding!
Liang Hucheng suddenly had a bad feeling.
He thought, “Is it just a coincidence? Or is it an ambush by the Scavenger Army? ”

Then, recalling the giant-sized zombie wave that broke out in the center of the Western region the day before, he mused, “No! Damn it! It could be the same giant-sized zombie wave! We’re definitely in trouble! ”
Liang Hucheng then decisively shouted, “Stop the operation for now! Set up a defensive line on the spot and report the situation to the commander immediately! ”
“Yes! ”
Behind the federal team, Kou Huai also heard the gunshots coming from the front.
The increasingly dense gunshots made him feel frustrated.
“Reporting to the commander! A zombie wave has been discovered in the area ahead! ”
“A zombie wave? ” Kou Huai was confused.
He mused, “Why are they taking so long to clean up a mere zombie wave? GIven the current strength of our team, it should be an easy feat. ”

The Signal Corps soldier didn’t know how to explain the situation in front of them, either. “Sir, the zombie wave is expanding. The front scouting team has fallen into the range of the zombie wave. There are still a lot of zombies resurrecting from underground! ”
While they were talking, gunshots were heard around them.
Kou Huai looked out of the window.
A dense zombie team emerged from the bushes on both sides of the road and rushed toward the main road.
Kou Huai narrowed his eyes and glanced at Xiao Changle, who was in charge of the intelligence department. “What’s going on? ”
Xiao Changle’s face froze. “How would I know? I’ve never seen such a scene before! ”
Ahem.

Facing Kou Huai’s murderous gaze, Xiao Changle coughed and pretended to be calm. “Sir, in theory, it should be because we have too many people, which triggered the random high-level zombie wave in the game. The strength of the zombies is not high. For safety reasons, I suggest that we clean up the zombie wave before we take action, ”
Kou Huai ordered, “Pass on my order to set up a defensive line on the spot. We will take action after we clean up the zombie wave. ”
“Yes, Sir! ” replied Xiao Changle.
Kou Huai glared at Xiao Changle.
The gunshots that had been ringing in his ears contributed to Kou Huai’s growing frustration.

Less than two minutes later, the Signal Corps soldier hurried over again. “Sir, according to the information we got from the helicopter, the zombie wave... ” Looking bewildered, he continued, “The zombie wave is continuously spreading! ”
“This... ” Xiao Changle frowned and mumbled to himself, “This is not right. Theoretically, the zombie wave will not spread... ”
Fang Heng!
Kou Huai’s heart sank.
He immediately realized that the present zombie wave was abnormal.
It was very likely that Fang Heng was sabotaging them! Otherwise, how could such a coincidence happen?
“Report the strength of the zombie wave. ”

“Other than the abnormally huge range, the zombie waves are mostly normal. Most of them are composed of normal zombies. There is a small number of Tier 1 zombies, with a handful of Tier 2 mutated zombies. ”
Kou Huai sneered in his heart upon hearing the report.
In order to completely wipe out the Scavenger Army, they had brought enough resources to complete a round of war of attrition!
“Pass down the order. Assume formation on the spot and kill as many as possible! ”
“Understood! ”
The federal team immediately formed a line at their original spot and began to defend against the zombie wave.
In the distance, on the hillside.
Seeing that the federal team didn’t choose to retreat but to defend on the spot, Fang Heng showed a knowing expression.
He knew that Kou Huai wouldn’t give up so easily.
If Kou Huai and the others had chosen to obediently retreat, he wouldn’t have known how to react.
But once the Federation chose to stay on the spot and defend for a while, then they would be dragged into the quagmire by the mutated zombie wave that was constantly spawning!
“Fang Heng. ”
Wu Siying looked at the federal team that was surrounded by the zombie horde below and asked, “How did you do it? ”
“It’s a secret. ”
“It’s impossible to resist the Federation with these zombies alone. ”
“Don’t worry. Just wait and see. ”
As the two of them were talking, Zhong Lei drove a motorcycle from afar and stopped in front of Fang Heng.
He glanced at Wu Siying beside him and whispered into Fang Heng’s ear, “Boss, it’s done. Those left in the sewer have retreated ahead of time. ”
“Well, thank you for your hard work. ”
In Fang Heng’s vision, rows of game hints refreshed rapidly.
“Warning: your team is continuously releasing highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine. ”
“Warning: the highly concentrated anti-virus vaccine is extremely unstable and is undergoing mutation. ”
“Hint (based on low-level game difficulty) : you can try to obtain information on the mutation to increase the controllability of the vaccine. ”
“Hint: current zone mutation rate: 5.42% , zone purification rate: 0.23% . ”

chapters.title: Chapter 465 - Plan Scorpio
paragraphs: What the h*ll was going on?
Tier 4 mutated zombie? !
Ever since the appearance of the Tier 4 mutated zombies, the Federation players began to lose their cool.
It was definitely not a normal zombie wave!
Normal zombie waves would never spawn a Tier 4 one-eyed zombie!
It must be a conspiracy of the Scavenger Army! !
Zombie waves kept emerging from the ground, and even the powerful firepower of the Federation was unable to stop them.
“Sir! Based on aerial observation, we have been surrounded by a large number of zombies! ”

“Sir, according to the latest situation update, the entire Edge Creek Town in District 7 has been attacked by an extremely terrifying giant-sized zombie wave. This zombie wave attack is similar to the one that happened in the scorched area of the Western region yesterday. However, its strength and speed of expansion are far greater than yesterday... ”
“Sir, a Tier 4 mutated zombie will pose a great threat to us! Requesting permission to use heavy weapons. ”
Kou Huai said in a deep voice, “Permission granted! ”
“Roger! ”
They had to defend against the wave consisting Tier 4 zombies!
“Is this your trump card, Fang Heng? ” Kou Huai muttered to himself softly. He knew very well that they could not retreat from the present wave.
If they retreated, they would give the Scavenger Army more time to catch their breath, which was something Kou Huai wanted to prevent and was afraid of.
Every time he gave Fang Heng time to catch his breath, the latter’s strength would increase greatly!
Kou Huai was afraid that if he retreated at the current point in time, the next time he saw Fang Heng, the latter would bring out all the Tier 6 zombies!
“Hint: current zone mutation rate: 15.42% , zone purification zone: 28.5344% . ”
Fang Heng stood on a high slope and watched the Federation kill the zombie team.
The zone purification rate was increasing rapidly!
“Good! Keep going, keep going! ” Fang Heng secretly cheered for the Federation.
He wanted the purification rate to quickly reach 100% and see if there were any new changes.
“I got it! ” Wu Siying finally understood everything when she saw Tier 5 mutated zombies appearing below. “I was mistaken. ”
Fang Heng was still cheering for the Federation in his heart. When he heard Wu Siying’s whispers, he couldn’t help but turn around and ask, “Eh? What did you say? ”

“I figured it out. You played a trick on Night Owl. You’ve completed the construction of the Tier 3 space tearing device, right? ” Wu Siying’s eyes flashed with confidence as she met Fang Heng’s gaze. “Perhaps others might not know, but you can’t hide it from me. I’ve experienced the ending of a certain Zombie Apocalypse before, so I’m very clear that the only thing that can cause such a terrifying zombie wave is the anti-virus vaccine! So you must have spread a large amount of anti-virus vaccine in the Edge Creek Town area, huh? ”
Fang Heng curled his lips, thinking that Wu Siying had hit the mark.

Wu Siying continued, “Everything has a reasonable explanation. The disappearance of the first-generation meteorite in District 5 was also your doing. Don’t deny this. Night Owl has already confirmed your previously forged identity. They’ve also confirmed that the first-generation meteorite and a large number of blue crystal ores in District 5 have been seized by the Federation. However, from the Federation’s internal operational information regarding District 5, there is no mention of the seizure of the first-generation meteorite and a large number of blue crystal ores. You were the one who took them all, weren’t you? ” She looked at Fang Heng with a burning gaze.

Wu Siying had finally figured it out! Her evaluation of Fang Heng rose to an extremely high level in a short period of time. She finally understood that she had always underestimated Fang Heng. “Impressive. Through the first-generation meteorite in District 5, you forcefully joined the main storyline in District 8. Then, you used the vaccine developed through the main storyline to spread it in District 7. I have to say that it is a well-thought-out plan. You could only have done this under the premise of creating a Tier 3 space tearing device and possessing a large number of blue crystal ores! ”

Wu Siying gave the final conclusion, “So, Night Owl was fooled by you. They mistakenly thought that the main storyline of District 8 had been cut off, and no one there could create a Tier 3 space tearing device anymore. But you did it. Not only did you do it, but you also kept it a secret. Your ambition is not only the main storyline in District 7 but also that in District 8, right? ”
Faced with Wu Siying’s aggressive questioning, Fang Heng maintained a calm expression.
However, Zhong Lei, who was standing beside him, could not remain calm.
What the heck!
Zhong Lei himself had not obtained much information about the game’s advancement. He listened to the section about District 7 and District 8 in a daze, but he heard a few key points.

Fang Heng could jump back and forth between District 7 and District 8? And the vampire invasion in District 5 was also related to Fang Heng? He secretly stole the first-generation meteorite from there? And then he used the vaccine developed using the first-generation meteorite to cause trouble in District 7? The guy was really an elite!

“All right. Just take it that you guessed correctly. ” Fang Heng waved his hand. He felt that the other party had already guessed most of the truth, so there was no need to continue hiding it. “Let’s get back to the main topic. Guessing is guessing, and gambling is gambling. You’ve lost this gamble. ”
Wu Siying closed her eyes.
She did not lose the round indignantly since she had obtained a high-value piece of information, and that was about Fang Heng having obtained great control over the main storyline of District 8!
According to Fang Heng’s current ability, even if he lost the final ownership of District 7, the final ownership of District 8 would still have a high probability of being taken by him!
Following that, aside from Black Castle, the Federation’s attitude toward Fang Heng would inevitably change drastically.
Cooperation was the best way.

Wu Siying made her decision and opened her eyes, nodding as she said, “If one is willing to bet, one must be willing to admit their loss. Since you are not willing to join Black Castle, we will not force you. We can still maintain a cooperative relationship. Remember, you still owe Black Castle a favor. ”
As she spoke, Wu Siying leaned over and whispered into Fang Heng’s ear, “Plan Scorpio. ”
“What do you mean? ”

“Follow this clue and continue to investigate. My special talent can weaken some of the damage inflicted by the regulations. Saying those two words have already caused me to lose a large number of King of Gods’ points. I can’t explain further, but the clue will definitely help you. ”

Wu Siying shook her head as she spoke, then slowly retreated. “My mission this time has already been completed. I look forward to our next cooperation. Very soon, after you’ve obtained the ownership of the world, we’ll meet again. I wish you good luck. ”
Fang Heng watched as Wu Siying’s figure gradually faded away until she disappeared before his eyes.
Zhong Lei was still stunned on the spot. He felt that the amount of information the two of them had exchanged was a bit too much for him to digest.

So, Fang Heng was currently fighting on both sides of District 7 and District 8 at the same time? However, what the hell was a Tier 3 space tearing device? A tool that Fang Heng used to travel across districts repeatedly? So, the teleportation gate could be further leveled up?
Just as Zhong Lei was feeling dizzy, he heard Fang Heng calling out to him.
“Zhong Lei. ”
“Eh? ”
“Plan Scorpio. ” Fang Heng revealed a thoughtful expression as he asked, “Do you know anything about it? ”
Zhong Lei shook his head in confusion. “I’ve never heard of it. Is it very important information? I can go back and borrow the strength of the guild to investigate it. ”
“Mhm, check it immediately after you go back. Remember to keep it a secret. ”
“All right. ”
At Zhong Lei’s response, Fang Heng retracted his gaze and continued to look at the battlefield below.

sentences.text: What the h*ll was going on?
Tier 4 mutated zombie? !
Ever since the appearance of the Tier 4 mutated zombies, the Federation players began to lose their cool.
It was definitely not a normal zombie wave!
Normal zombie waves would never spawn a Tier 4 one-eyed zombie!
It must be a conspiracy of the Scavenger Army! !
Zombie waves kept emerging from the ground, and even the powerful firepower of the Federation was unable to stop them.
“Sir!
Based on aerial observation, we have been surrounded by a large number of zombies! ”
“Sir, according to the latest situation update, the entire Edge Creek Town in District 7 has been attacked by an extremely terrifying giant-sized zombie wave.
This zombie wave attack is similar to the one that happened in the scorched area of the Western region yesterday.
However, its strength and speed of expansion are far greater than yesterday... ”
“Sir, a Tier 4 mutated zombie will pose a great threat to us!
Requesting permission to use heavy weapons. ”
Kou Huai said in a deep voice, “Permission granted! ”
“Roger! ”
They had to defend against the wave consisting Tier 4 zombies!
“Is this your trump card, Fang Heng? ” Kou Huai muttered to himself softly.
He knew very well that they could not retreat from the present wave.
If they retreated, they would give the Scavenger Army more time to catch their breath, which was something Kou Huai wanted to prevent and was afraid of.
Every time he gave Fang Heng time to catch his breath, the latter’s strength would increase greatly!
Kou Huai was afraid that if he retreated at the current point in time, the next time he saw Fang Heng, the latter would bring out all the Tier 6 zombies!
“Hint: current zone mutation rate: 15.42% , zone purification zone: 28.5344% . ”
Fang Heng stood on a high slope and watched the Federation kill the zombie team.
The zone purification rate was increasing rapidly!
“Good!
Keep going, keep going! ” Fang Heng secretly cheered for the Federation.
He wanted the purification rate to quickly reach 100% and see if there were any new changes.
“I got it! ” Wu Siying finally understood everything when she saw Tier 5 mutated zombies appearing below.
“I was mistaken. ”
Fang Heng was still cheering for the Federation in his heart.
When he heard Wu Siying’s whispers, he couldn’t help but turn around and ask, “Eh?
What did you say? ”
“I figured it out.
You played a trick on Night Owl.
You’ve completed the construction of the Tier 3 space tearing device, right? ” Wu Siying’s eyes flashed with confidence as she met Fang Heng’s gaze.
“Perhaps others might not know, but you can’t hide it from me.
I’ve experienced the ending of a certain Zombie Apocalypse before, so I’m very clear that the only thing that can cause such a terrifying zombie wave is the anti-virus vaccine!
So you must have spread a large amount of anti-virus vaccine in the Edge Creek Town area, huh? ”
Fang Heng curled his lips, thinking that Wu Siying had hit the mark.
Wu Siying continued, “Everything has a reasonable explanation.
The disappearance of the first-generation meteorite in District 5 was also your doing.
Don’t deny this.
Night Owl has already confirmed your previously forged identity.
They’ve also confirmed that the first-generation meteorite and a large number of blue crystal ores in District 5 have been seized by the Federation.
However, from the Federation’s internal operational information regarding District 5, there is no mention of the seizure of the first-generation meteorite and a large number of blue crystal ores.
You were the one who took them all, weren’t you? ” She looked at Fang Heng with a burning gaze.
Wu Siying had finally figured it out!
Her evaluation of Fang Heng rose to an extremely high level in a short period of time.
She finally understood that she had always underestimated Fang Heng.
“Impressive.
Through the first-generation meteorite in District 5, you forcefully joined the main storyline in District 8.
Then, you used the vaccine developed through the main storyline to spread it in District 7.
I have to say that it is a well-thought-out plan.
You could only have done this under the premise of creating a Tier 3 space tearing device and possessing a large number of blue crystal ores! ”
Wu Siying gave the final conclusion, “So, Night Owl was fooled by you.
They mistakenly thought that the main storyline of District 8 had been cut off, and no one there could create a Tier 3 space tearing device anymore.
But you did it.
Not only did you do it, but you also kept it a secret.
Your ambition is not only the main storyline in District 7 but also that in District 8, right? ”
Faced with Wu Siying’s aggressive questioning, Fang Heng maintained a calm expression.
However, Zhong Lei, who was standing beside him, could not remain calm.
What the heck!
Zhong Lei himself had not obtained much information about the game’s advancement.
He listened to the section about District 7 and District 8 in a daze, but he heard a few key points.
Fang Heng could jump back and forth between District 7 and District 8?
And the vampire invasion in District 5 was also related to Fang Heng?
He secretly stole the first-generation meteorite from there?
And then he used the vaccine developed using the first-generation meteorite to cause trouble in District 7?
The guy was really an elite!
“All right.
Just take it that you guessed correctly. ” Fang Heng waved his hand.
He felt that the other party had already guessed most of the truth, so there was no need to continue hiding it.
“Let’s get back to the main topic.
Guessing is guessing, and gambling is gambling.
You’ve lost this gamble. ”
Wu Siying closed her eyes.
She did not lose the round indignantly since she had obtained a high-value piece of information, and that was about Fang Heng having obtained great control over the main storyline of District 8!
According to Fang Heng’s current ability, even if he lost the final ownership of District 7, the final ownership of District 8 would still have a high probability of being taken by him!
Following that, aside from Black Castle, the Federation’s attitude toward Fang Heng would inevitably change drastically.
Cooperation was the best way.
Wu Siying made her decision and opened her eyes, nodding as she said, “If one is willing to bet, one must be willing to admit their loss.
Since you are not willing to join Black Castle, we will not force you.
We can still maintain a cooperative relationship.
Remember, you still owe Black Castle a favor. ”
As she spoke, Wu Siying leaned over and whispered into Fang Heng’s ear, “Plan Scorpio. ”
“What do you mean? ”
“Follow this clue and continue to investigate.
My special talent can weaken some of the damage inflicted by the regulations.
Saying those two words have already caused me to lose a large number of King of Gods’ points.
I can’t explain further, but the clue will definitely help you. ”
Wu Siying shook her head as she spoke, then slowly retreated.
“My mission this time has already been completed.
I look forward to our next cooperation.
Very soon, after you’ve obtained the ownership of the world, we’ll meet again.
I wish you good luck. ”
Fang Heng watched as Wu Siying’s figure gradually faded away until she disappeared before his eyes.
Zhong Lei was still stunned on the spot.
He felt that the amount of information the two of them had exchanged was a bit too much for him to digest.
So, Fang Heng was currently fighting on both sides of District 7 and District 8 at the same time?
However, what the hell was a Tier 3 space tearing device?
A tool that Fang Heng used to travel across districts repeatedly?
So, the teleportation gate could be further leveled up?
Just as Zhong Lei was feeling dizzy, he heard Fang Heng calling out to him.
“Zhong Lei. ”
“Eh? ”
“Plan Scorpio. ” Fang Heng revealed a thoughtful expression as he asked, “Do you know anything about it? ”
Zhong Lei shook his head in confusion.
“I’ve never heard of it.
Is it very important information?
I can go back and borrow the strength of the guild to investigate it. ”
“Mhm, check it immediately after you go back.
Remember to keep it a secret. ”
“All right. ”
At Zhong Lei’s response, Fang Heng retracted his gaze and continued to look at the battlefield below.

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - Breakthrough
paragraphs: In Edge Creek Town of District 7, a zombie team swarmed toward the central main road.
Armored trucks formed a circle, forming a weak defense net.
Under the heavy firepower of the Federation, the zombie team in the periphery fell.
However, just as they fell, the inner zombies swarmed out to the periphery.
“Howitzer! Quick! Howitzer! ”
“Tier 5 giant zombie! ” Seeing the giant hand from deep underground, the deputy commander of the Federation was shocked. The Federation elites were also shocked.
“It’s a giant zombie! Get the light cannon ready! Don’t let it come back to life! ”

“Sir, I suggest we retreat. ” Xiao Changle panicked. He immediately tried to persuade Kou Huai, who was standing next to him, “The zombie wave is still spreading rapidly. It is spreading at an extremely fast speed, and there is no sign of it stopping. If it continues like this... ”
“Shut up! ” Kou Huai’s eyes were bloodshot.
Retreat at the current juncture? And leave Fang Heng alone?
Bam!
Just then, Kou Huai staggered as the ground of the highway cracked open. A giant, greenish-gray hand suddenly reached out of the ground.
Boom! Boom! Boom
Several howitzer shells hit the zombie’s hand!
The giant zombie pushed away the heavy rocks on the ground and tried to crawl out of the ground.
“Let’s retreat... ” Xiao Changle’s voice was pleading. “Let’s just count Fang Heng lucky this time that we encountered the zombie wave. We will die if we continue like this. ”
He tried to persuade them patiently, “We can go back first and come back after a while. There’s no need to fight the zombie wave head-on... ”
Kou Huai clenched his fists tightly. He didn’t believe what Xiao Changle said about encountering the zombie wave out of bad luck!
It was obvious that Fang Heng had planned all of it in advance!
But he had no choice but to make the decision to retreat, no matter how unwilling he was in his heart!
Kou Huai had a strong premonition.
Once he retreated at the current juncture, he would no longer be able to pose an effective threat to Fang Heng.
He was about to lose the final battle for the ownership of the entire District 7.
More than ten years of planning would be destroyed in an instant!
Kou Huai clenched his teeth and spat out two words, “Retreat! ”
“Yes! ! ” Xiao Changle felt relieved to keep his life. He hurriedly shouted through his communicator, “Retreat! Evacuate the non-combatants first! Quick! Don’t you hear me? ! ”
It was easier said than done to retreat!
Even the powerful Federation would suffer losses when surrounded by zombie team after zombie team!
The helicopter hovered in the air and lowered the rope from above.
“Sir, let’s retreat first. ”
Kou Huai took a deep breath and climbed up the rope ladder.
Xiao Changle followed behind Kou Huai and boarded the helicopter.
He heaved a sigh of relief and looked down with a guilty conscience.
He finally retreated to safety.
“Wait, what is that! ? ” Xiao Changle’s heart was seized in an instant.
He saw a rocket launcher attack flying toward the helicopter from afar.
“Quick! Get out of the way! ”
The helicopter quickly pulled up.
Xiao Changle’s hands were tightly clutching the steel pipe of a handrail!
The helicopter narrowly avoided the rocket launcher attack.
Kou Huai’s pupils constricted as he looked through the window of the helicopter in the direction of where the rocket launcher attack came from.
He vaguely saw several tall figures standing on the high slope in the distance.
It was fusion Tyrant forms!
“Fang Heng! ” Kou Huai’s eyes were about to pop out.
“Ha, what a pity. I haven’t mastered heavy weapons. My aim isn’t that good... ”
In the distance, on a hill, Fang Heng was using binoculars to observe the helicopter in the distance. “But... ”
Swish, swish, swish, swish!
Behind Fang Heng, the eight fusion Tyrant forms raised their rocket launchers once again and fired another round at the helicopter in mid-air.
“Again! ”
Swish, swish, swish!
Under the attack of the rocket launchers, the helicopter dodged left and right in a frenzy.
However, after several rounds of firing, a rocket launcher shell hit the helicopter in the air.
Boom! ! !
After being hit head-on, the entire helicopter exploded in the air!
“This... ” Zhong Lei looked at Fang Heng carefully from the side.
Kou Huai was on that plane, right? So Kou Huai was also dead, right?
Zhong Lei looked at Fang Heng, and an unspeakable admiration rose from the bottom of his heart.

He really killed the highest-ranking executive officer of District 7 of the Federation just because of a disagreement? Why did it feel like he was a little more terrifying than the anti-federation forces?
Looking at the helicopter that exploded into a ball of fireworks in the air, Fang Heng couldn’t help but sigh in relief.
In fact, Kou Huai had given him a lot of pressure.
According to the game’s settings, after a player died, they would undergo rebirth in the King of Gods’ space for a period of time.
During that period of time, the player could log in and log out as usual, but they were unable to enter the various game worlds. Hence, it was known as lockdown time.
Seeing that the players from the Federation were beginning to retreat in an orderly manner, Fang Heng waved his hand.
The restless Lickers in the forest immediately charged into the zombie team.
Apart from that, there was a large number of mutant worm bodies that had been prepared beforehand.
The Federation had bought many injections, so he had to make them waste some for them to buy more.
Fang Heng was busy musing to himself when something caught his attention. “Eh? ”
Dark red hints rapidly refreshed in the bottom right corner of his retina.
“Hint: you have killed a Tier 2 mutated zombie and obtained survival points... ”
“Hint: the current zone purification rate has reached 100% . The present Edge Creek Town zone has been purified! ”
“Hint: evolution has been completed. The present Edge Creek Town zone will not have a random zombie wave spawning. ”
“Hint: player has triggered the main storyline ending mission (normal ending) ‘Beautiful New World. ‘ ”
What the hell! Ending?
Fang Heng immediately clicked on the details to check.

Mission description: the antibody potion developed through the first-generation meteorite has the ability to purify the contaminated world! Even though you encountered a huge setback, you have temporarily purified this land! You have obtained the method to save the entire world!

Mission requirements: purify all regions of the world (if there are multiple player teams that have triggered the ending mission, they will share the mission. In the end, the first team with the highest contribution points ranking will receive all the rewards. The team reward will be distributed to individual players according to their contribution points) .

Mission reward: after completing the mission, the ending ‘Beautiful New World’ (A-level) will be triggered. Player will receive the mission reward for completing the ending and additional main storyline contribution points. After the ending has been completed, players in District 7 will be ranked according to the total main storyline contribution points, and the first-ranked player will receive the right to reign over District 7 of Zombie Apocalypse.
“Main storyline... ‘Beautiful New World’ ... ” Fang Heng muttered to himself and continued disdainfully, “How ironic. ”
Fang Heng took a deep breath and thought about what he should do next.
Currently, he had already triggered two normal endings.
They were respectively the tyrannical route where the Scavenger Army forcefully took over the world and the saintly route of vaccine development.
Therefore, the main storyline of District 8 was probably the saintly route.
Difficulty-wise, the two missions were similar.
