chapters.title: Chapter 467 - New Clue
paragraphs: Fang Heng made a rough deduction in his mind.

Even if he could continue developing and optimizing the vaccine in District 7, greatly increasing the level of the vaccine antibodies and reducing the speed and intensity of the zombie mutation, how long would it take to produce the amount of vaccine needed to purify the entire world, not to mention purify the entire world?
Fang Heng could already envision an extremely long battle ahead.
And in the long battle, the Federation and Night Owl would come looking for trouble for him!
“Annoying! ” Fang Heng rubbed his shoulders.
Perhaps there were other ways to trigger other quests to complete the main storyline faster.
Currently, there were only two clues left that could be traced.

The Hila experiment was one of them, which needed some time to work on. Leftway Gaming Guild had to be fully constructed before more boxes that were previously buried by Meteorite Company and the Hila tissue samples within them could be found.
The other clue was the information that Black Castle had just obtained, Plan Scorpio.
Fang Heng gradually sorted out his thoughts and began to plan the next step.
At present, the entire Federation suffered severe losses. Even Kou Huai had been killed by him and temporarily could not personally command the federal team.
At the very least, the Federation would not be able to organize a decent attack against the Scavenger Army in the near future.

Fang Heng could rest assured and boldly use the funds provided by the Federation to purchase industries in District 7. He could set up an electromagnetic induction tower and collect a Hila tissue sample to increase the strength of the Tyrant form.
The research and upgrading of the vaccine, the collection of the Hila tissue sample, and Plan Scorpio had to proceed simultaneously!
Who knew if there would be any mishaps after the main storyline. It was always good to have more preparation.
“Hey, Fang Heng... ” Zhong Lei had no choice but to interrupt Fang Heng, who was deep in thought. “If we don’t leave now, we’ll be surrounded by the zombie team. ”
Fang Heng stopped thinking. “Okay, let’s go. ”
Zhong Lei took a deep breath and took one last look at the area of Edge Creek Town, which was hellishly surrounded by the zombie team.
If someone told him that Fang Heng was an anti-federal organization terrorist at the present moment, he would definitely believe it.

“Fang Heng, this battle was beautifully fought! This is the first time Kou Huai and the others have lost so miserably! ” Tian Zhen had been paying attention to Fang Heng’s situation at all times. After receiving the news that the Federation had suffered a great defeat and that Kou Huai had even lost his life on the spot, he was greatly excited!
The gamble paid off!
Their entire Leftway Gaming Guild would rise up together with Fang Heng in District 7!

“Affected by this time’s giant-sized zombie wave, the players of District 7 have lost much confidence in the Federation. I’ve already spread the word that similar zombie waves will continue to occur throughout District 7. Many guilds have already been affected and are starting to sell their shelters to the outside world. I reckon that the price of shelters will soon plummet. At that time, we will be able to buy more shelters at a lower price and complete the production plan for the electromagnetic induction tower. In order to save money, I believe that we only need to buy a medium-sized shelter. After all, our goal is only to build the induction tower. ” Tian Zhen was increasingly trusting Fang Heng as a teammate. He felt as if everything was already under Fang Heng’s control, and the Federation was being played around by Fang Heng.
“All right. You decide. ” Fang Heng was also very satisfied with this new teammate.
For the time being, the plan to find Hila tissue sample could be handed over to him to carry out.
“Okay, and about the Plan Scorpio that you mentioned earlier, this is the relevant information that I asked people to gather, ” Tian Zhen said as he handed a file to Fang Heng.
“Huh? ” Fang Heng flipped open the file and had a thought. He raised his head and asked, “Meteorite Company? ”

“Yes, we can confirm that Plan Scorpio is a project led by Meteorite Company. There are huge gaps in the information, and I’m not clear about the details of the project. The information was provided by a player from our guild. About a few years ago in a nursing home, before she joined the company, she accidentally triggered a related mission. According to her, she had seen information about Plan Scorpio then. Unfortunately, she died in the nursing home at that time. The mission was halted, too. Then, it was abandoned. After so much time has passed, the players in the nursing home might have already triggered the mission. Searching for the mission now might not be of much use. ”
Indeed, District 7 had been in service for far too long.
Places that potentially had hidden missions had probably already been searched countless times by the players.
In theory, if there had been a hidden mission, it would have been triggered a long time ago.
“Yeah. Anyway, we still have to go over and check it out. ”
“The coordinates of the nursing home are in the North District. It’s too far to drive there. I’ll get Zhong Lei to bring you there through the teleportation passage of the other guilds. ”
“Okay. ”
Leftway Gaming Guild had always been very efficient.
Half an hour later, Zhong Lei and Fang Heng entered the North District through a teleportation passage and drove on the wide snowy road.
The coordinates for the trip were an abandoned nursing home, Far Mountain Nursing Home.
It was built halfway up the mountain.
It was a world of ice and snow, a vast expanse of whiteness.
If they had started randomly in the area at the beginning, it would definitely have been hell-level difficulty.
Players would face the risk of hypothermia, and survival would be extremely difficult.
The good news was that, perhaps because there weren’t many humans living in the area, the zombie density and zombie wave intensity were much lower compared to other areas.
Fang Heng drove the car toward the target location.
Time was short, so Fang Heng didn’t bring the zombie team with him.
He didn’t have much hope for the trip.
A faint light flashed, and Zhong Lei went online from the passenger seat.
He changed into a thick winter suit.
“Hey, Fang Heng, Good News. I just broke through North District’s forum’s firewall to search for Far Mountain Nursing Home, and I found out quite a lot. ”
Fang Heng’s attention was drawn over. “Huh? What did you find? ”

“There are quite a few players in the Eastern region who have explored Far Mountain Nursing Home. I heard that they were all attacked inside. I even found a few related party member recruitment posts, but there was no follow-up. I think they were all wiped out. ” Zhong Lei said excitedly, “The good news is that I just found the latest party recruitment post. It seems that they have some relevant information. ”
“Are you saying that the nursing home has not been fully explored by the players? ”

“Yes! ” Zhong Lei nodded and uttered, “This place is freezing. The big guilds would not choose to build a shelter here. The location of the nursing home is also very secure since it is built halfway up the mountain. ”
Fang Heng sped up and nodded, “That is good news. ”

“There’s an apocalypse merchant camp not far from the fork in the road ahead. ” Zhong Lei said with a smile, “Let’s go to the Apocalypse merchant camp first. The group on the forum seems to have gone in to explore a few times. I contacted them online and discussed exploring the nursing home with them. I think we should be able to get some useful information from them. ”
Fang Heng agreed, “That makes sense. ”

sentences.text: Fang Heng made a rough deduction in his mind.

Even if he could continue developing and optimizing the vaccine in District 7, greatly increasing the level of the vaccine antibodies and reducing the speed and intensity of the zombie mutation, how long would it take to produce the amount of vaccine needed to purify the entire world, not to mention purify the entire world?
Fang Heng could already envision an extremely long battle ahead.
And in the long battle, the Federation and Night Owl would come looking for trouble for him!
“Annoying! ” Fang Heng rubbed his shoulders.
Perhaps there were other ways to trigger other quests to complete the main storyline faster.
Currently, there were only two clues left that could be traced.
The Hila experiment was one of them, which needed some time to work on.
Leftway Gaming Guild had to be fully constructed before more boxes that were previously buried by Meteorite Company and the Hila tissue samples within them could be found.
The other clue was the information that Black Castle had just obtained, Plan Scorpio.
Fang Heng gradually sorted out his thoughts and began to plan the next step.
At present, the entire Federation suffered severe losses.
Even Kou Huai had been killed by him and temporarily could not personally command the federal team.
At the very least, the Federation would not be able to organize a decent attack against the Scavenger Army in the near future.
Fang Heng could rest assured and boldly use the funds provided by the Federation to purchase industries in District 7.
He could set up an electromagnetic induction tower and collect a Hila tissue sample to increase the strength of the Tyrant form.
The research and upgrading of the vaccine, the collection of the Hila tissue sample, and Plan Scorpio had to proceed simultaneously!
Who knew if there would be any mishaps after the main storyline.
It was always good to have more preparation.
“Hey, Fang Heng... ” Zhong Lei had no choice but to interrupt Fang Heng, who was deep in thought.
“If we don’t leave now, we’ll be surrounded by the zombie team. ”
Fang Heng stopped thinking.
“Okay, let’s go. ”
Zhong Lei took a deep breath and took one last look at the area of Edge Creek Town, which was hellishly surrounded by the zombie team.
If someone told him that Fang Heng was an anti-federal organization terrorist at the present moment, he would definitely believe it.
“Fang Heng, this battle was beautifully fought!
This is the first time Kou Huai and the others have lost so miserably! ” Tian Zhen had been paying attention to Fang Heng’s situation at all times.
After receiving the news that the Federation had suffered a great defeat and that Kou Huai had even lost his life on the spot, he was greatly excited!
The gamble paid off!
Their entire Leftway Gaming Guild would rise up together with Fang Heng in District 7!
“Affected by this time’s giant-sized zombie wave, the players of District 7 have lost much confidence in the Federation.
I’ve already spread the word that similar zombie waves will continue to occur throughout District 7.
Many guilds have already been affected and are starting to sell their shelters to the outside world.
I reckon that the price of shelters will soon plummet.
At that time, we will be able to buy more shelters at a lower price and complete the production plan for the electromagnetic induction tower.
In order to save money, I believe that we only need to buy a medium-sized shelter.
After all, our goal is only to build the induction tower. ” Tian Zhen was increasingly trusting Fang Heng as a teammate.
He felt as if everything was already under Fang Heng’s control, and the Federation was being played around by Fang Heng.
“All right.
You decide. ” Fang Heng was also very satisfied with this new teammate.
For the time being, the plan to find Hila tissue sample could be handed over to him to carry out.
“Okay, and about the Plan Scorpio that you mentioned earlier, this is the relevant information that I asked people to gather, ” Tian Zhen said as he handed a file to Fang Heng.
“Huh? ” Fang Heng flipped open the file and had a thought.
He raised his head and asked, “Meteorite Company? ”
“Yes, we can confirm that Plan Scorpio is a project led by Meteorite Company.
There are huge gaps in the information, and I’m not clear about the details of the project.
The information was provided by a player from our guild.
About a few years ago in a nursing home, before she joined the company, she accidentally triggered a related mission.
According to her, she had seen information about Plan Scorpio then.
Unfortunately, she died in the nursing home at that time.
The mission was halted, too.
Then, it was abandoned.
After so much time has passed, the players in the nursing home might have already triggered the mission.
Searching for the mission now might not be of much use. ”
Indeed, District 7 had been in service for far too long.
Places that potentially had hidden missions had probably already been searched countless times by the players.
In theory, if there had been a hidden mission, it would have been triggered a long time ago.
“Yeah.
Anyway, we still have to go over and check it out. ”
“The coordinates of the nursing home are in the North District.
It’s too far to drive there.
I’ll get Zhong Lei to bring you there through the teleportation passage of the other guilds. ”
“Okay. ”
Leftway Gaming Guild had always been very efficient.
Half an hour later, Zhong Lei and Fang Heng entered the North District through a teleportation passage and drove on the wide snowy road.
The coordinates for the trip were an abandoned nursing home, Far Mountain Nursing Home.
It was built halfway up the mountain.
It was a world of ice and snow, a vast expanse of whiteness.
If they had started randomly in the area at the beginning, it would definitely have been hell-level difficulty.
Players would face the risk of hypothermia, and survival would be extremely difficult.
The good news was that, perhaps because there weren’t many humans living in the area, the zombie density and zombie wave intensity were much lower compared to other areas.
Fang Heng drove the car toward the target location.
Time was short, so Fang Heng didn’t bring the zombie team with him.
He didn’t have much hope for the trip.
A faint light flashed, and Zhong Lei went online from the passenger seat.
He changed into a thick winter suit.
“Hey, Fang Heng, Good News.
I just broke through North District’s forum’s firewall to search for Far Mountain Nursing Home, and I found out quite a lot. ”
Fang Heng’s attention was drawn over.
“Huh?
What did you find? ”
“There are quite a few players in the Eastern region who have explored Far Mountain Nursing Home.
I heard that they were all attacked inside.
I even found a few related party member recruitment posts, but there was no follow-up.
I think they were all wiped out. ” Zhong Lei said excitedly, “The good news is that I just found the latest party recruitment post.
It seems that they have some relevant information. ”
“Are you saying that the nursing home has not been fully explored by the players? ”
“Yes! ” Zhong Lei nodded and uttered, “This place is freezing.
The big guilds would not choose to build a shelter here.
The location of the nursing home is also very secure since it is built halfway up the mountain. ”
Fang Heng sped up and nodded, “That is good news. ”
“There’s an apocalypse merchant camp not far from the fork in the road ahead. ” Zhong Lei said with a smile, “Let’s go to the Apocalypse merchant camp first.
The group on the forum seems to have gone in to explore a few times.
I contacted them online and discussed exploring the nursing home with them.
I think we should be able to get some useful information from them. ”
Fang Heng agreed, “That makes sense. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 468 - History of the Nursing Home
paragraphs: After spending more than three hours, Fang Heng and Zhong Lei arrived at the apocalypse merchant camp.
The camp was built in a world of ice and snow, and it looked rather dilapidated.
If it were any other place, the apocalypse merchant camp would have long been occupied by a large-sized guild.
Inside a small wooden cabin in the camp, two men and a woman sat at a table. They simultaneously raised their heads to size up Fang Heng and Zhong Lei, who had just entered.
“Zhong Lei? Fang Shuo? ”
“Yes, hello. Yi Qi, is it? We’ve communicated on the forum. ”
Yi Qi and the other two looked at Zhong Lei and Fang Heng suspiciously.
“I thought you guys were joking. I didn’t expect you guys to really come all the way here. ”
Yi Qi was a middle-aged big beardy man with a shotgun on his back.
“Let me get this straight. Our team has been exploring the nursing home for more than a month. We need elites. If you just want to gain some experience after joining the team, you can get lost now. ”
“Of course, we are very sincere. ”
The three of them looked at each other.
The capable woman with short hair said, “I am Vera, the long-range support in the team. You claim to know some secrets about Far Mountain Nursing Home. Let’s exchange information. ”
The young man who had been silent all the while added, “You guys go first. ”
Fang Heng was baffled and confused.
They were there to inquire about the news. How would they have information to share?
Ahem.
Zhong Lei coughed lightly and whispered into Fang Heng’s ear, “When I contacted them online earlier, I casually fooled them. I was acting according to the situation. ”
Zhong Lei looked at Vera and said, “I don’t think this is fair. ”
“It’s indeed not fair. ” Yi Qi nodded and said, “So you can refuse to cooperate and go back if you wish. ”
Zhong Lei frowned.
“It’s okay, Zhong Lei. It’s just some information. We will show our sincerity. But after our introduction, please fill in the blanks. What do you think? ”
“Okay, it’s very fair. ”
Fang Heng nodded and stood up. “Wait a moment. I’ll be back soon. ”
Under everyone’s eyes, Fang Heng slowly walked to the merchants of the apocalypse merchant camp behind the counter.
“What do you need? Survival points? ”
“Hey, I want to check the materials that are sold to the public. ”
“Feel free to look. The goods here are all top-notch. ”
“Hint: you have spent 342 thousand survival points to purchase all the remaining items available for sale in the survival camp. Your favorability rating with Anit has increased. ”
“Hint: you have sold some items such as pliers, cauldrons, oil drums, cotton seeds, sunflower seeds, and so on. Your favorability rating with Anit has increased. ”
“Hint: you have spent 341 thousand survival points to purchase all remaining items available for sale in the survival camp. Your favorability rating with Anit has increased... ”
“Hint: your favorability rating with Anit has increased to that of close friends. ”
More than a minute passed, and the old-fashioned apocalypse merchant, Anit, broke the silence.
“All right, Fang Heng, because it’s you. ”
“Thank you so much. ”
“Give me a moment. ” Anit turned around and rummaged under the counter for a moment. Finally, he took a bunch of keys and walked toward Yi Qi and the others.
He stood in front of the table.

“I’ll tell you the story of that nursing home. Where do I begin... I remember that building was already there when I was born. It was still an orphanage at that time. The orphanage was a charity project of Meteorite Company. Every year, Meteorite Company would make a donation to the orphanage. Oh right, they weren’t called Meteorite Company at that time. ”

He continued, “There are many rumors about that orphanage. I’ve heard many unreliable rumors, such as monsters, mental patients, and so on. Some people even said that the meteorite company was using those children to conduct inhuman human experiments in the orphanage. ”

Anit’s face showed disdain. “Nonsense. Who would believe that? After Meteorite Company’s research on the zombie virus was exposed, their finances were greatly affected. They stopped investing in charity. The orphanage was forced to disband due to a lack of funds. This house was bought by an outsider and converted into the current nursing home. After that, the zombie apocalypse happened, and Far Mountain Nursing Home gradually became abandoned. ”

He sighed and uttered, “I advise you to be careful. Ever since the zombie crisis broke out, that place has become strange, and the wild beasts in the mountains rarely go near it. There have always been survivors who want to go into the nursing home to check, but as far as I know, these people almost never have a good ending. ”
While speaking, Anit placed the keys he had just found onto the table and pushed it toward Fang Heng. “This is the key to the abandoned nursing home. ”
Everyone raised their heads in surprise.
“Anit, why do you have the keys to the nursing home? ”

“On a certain night after the zombie apocalypse broke out, the youngest son of the nursing home director came to me. He told me that there were monsters in the nursing home and that his family had all died at the hands of the monsters. He wanted to use the nursing home to exchange for a pistol from me. ”

Anit shrugged and continued, “To be honest, I rarely agree to loss-making deals. At that time, I thought it was a good deal, so I agreed. Later, I found out that the place was much more dangerous than I thought. You all know that this failed business is a matter of losing face. If you want to go into the nursing home to investigate, help me get some valuable things from it. ”
“Hint: player team has triggered the mission ‘Anit’s Honor. ‘ ”
Mission name: Anit’s Honor.
Mission difficulty: B + .

Mission description: you have learned about the history of Far Mountain Nursing Home from the apocalypse merchant Anit. Anit hopes that you can collect 2,000 survival points worth of materials from the nursing home and give them to him.
Mission reward: Anit’s favorability rating, survival points, and Anit’s treasure.
“No problem, Anit. Leave this mission to me. ” Fang Heng picked up the bunch of keys as he spoke.
“Hint: you have obtained an ancient bunch of keys. ”
Item: an ancient bunch of keys.
Description: the keys of Far Mountain Nursing Home. It looks a little shabby.
“Very well. I wish you good luck. If you need any materials, you can look for me to purchase them. ” After saying that, Anit returned to the back of the counter.
Yi Qi and the others fell silent at the same time. They all looked at Fang Heng with a strange gaze.
It was a little strange.

They had spent so much effort gathering information, but they had not been able to gather any information or missions about the nursing home. Yet, the player who appeared out of nowhere had actually obtained information just by casually chatting with a merchant, even triggering a mission and obtaining the keys.
Zhong Lei was also baffled. He even suspected that Fang Heng had been to the area before. “How on earth did Fang Heng do it? ” he wondered.

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - Investigation
paragraphs: “How is it? Do you still have any questions? ” Fang Heng held the bunch of keys in his hand and fiddled with it. “That’s about all we know about Far Mountain Nursing Home. Do you have any additional information? ”

Yi Qi and the others looked at each other, and finally, Yi Qi said, “Thank you for your information. In fact, we don’t know much about the background of Far Mountain Nursing Home. However, we’ve entered the nursing home three times before, trying to investigate the situation inside. ”
Fang Heng’s interest was piqued. He sat up straight and asked, “What are the details? ”

“In the beginning, we only did a simple search of the nursing home. After cleaning up a few mutated zombies in the nursing home, Vera sensed that there was something dangerous under the nursing home. Following this clue, we found an entrance in the basement. ”

Yi Qi continued, “We can already confirm that there is a huge building complex below the nursing home. Unfortunately, we were attacked just as we started to explore and thereafter escaped from the nursing home. ”
Fang Heng asked, “Who attacked you? ”
“I’m not sure. ” Thinking back to the situation at that time, Vera still had no clue. “We can’t figure out what attacked us. It moved so fast that we couldn’t see it with our naked eyes. ”
Zhong Lei frowned. “Was it a mutated zombie? ”
“I’m not sure. ” Vera shook her head.
“The probability is not high. ” Yi Qi thought for a while and added, “I was attacked by it, but my infection index didn’t rise. According to my judgment, it might not be a mutated zombie. ”
“Was it very strong? ”
“Yes! It was very strong. ” Vera’s expression was a little serious. “It’s different from the mutated zombie we’ve encountered before. ”

“Don’t worry. ” Yi Qi patted Vera’s shoulder to comfort her, “Last time, it happened suddenly, and it was very dark in the underground passage, so we didn’t see the enemy clearly. This time, we found a way to get two flashbangs. With sufficient preparation, we can at least figure out its true face. ”
Fang Heng rubbed his chin, thinking to himself.
It sounded a little troublesome.
Should he bring the fusion Tyrant forms over?
The damned place was too far. If he made the fusion Tyrant forms self-destruct, it would take more than six hours. Moreover, he would not be able to obtain a proliferator in a short period of time.

Based on the theoretical analysis and the unreliable information obtained from the player forums, the ceiling of Zombie Apocalypse’s combat strength was a Tier 5 mutated zombie. Under the Blood Moon state, the strongest mutated zombie’s combat strength was only comparable to a Tier 6 zombie.
Based on the capped combat strength, with his current ability, Fang Heng would most likely not be able to defeat a Tier 5 mutated zombie in a one-on-one fight.
However, it would not be a problem for him to save his life.
Even if he encountered an extreme situation at a small probability, District 8 still had a rebirth chamber that could be used.
Fang Heng believed that he could go inside and test the waters.

Vera continued, “Before we carry out this operation, I still need to confirm the target of the operation. Previously, when we were conducting a preliminary search of the secret area under the basement, we accidentally found a set of research materials related to the virus in a room. ”
“Research materials? ” Fang Heng’s eyes suddenly lit up. “Do you still have them? ”

“I gave the materials to a friend. He works for a big gaming company. According to him, the research materials are very useful. If we can find more relevant information from the basement, they are willing to pay a lot of money to buy it. ”
Fang Heng thought it was a pity. “Do you still remember the content of the materials? ”

Vera responded, “I didn’t really understand the contents. They should be related to a zombie virus experiment conducted by Meteorite Company. They contain all the experimental data. Players’ shelters can use them to increase the research level and the attractiveness of the shelter. ”
“Okay... ” Fang Heng nodded, feeling suspicious.
So Plan Scorpio was also a zombie virus project?

Vera uttered, “My friend promised me to buy all the information at a higher price than the market price. After we find a way to get the information, all the rewards gained from selling it will be shared equally among us. Do you have any objection to that? ”
Fang Heng immediately said, “The information is useful to me. I’m willing to buy it at double the price he promised you. ”
Hearing that, Vera and the other two were stunned. “Did we meet a rich man? ”
Vera confirmed with Fang Heng, “Double? Are you sure? One set of information will cost 3,000 survival points. ”
“3,000, deal, ” Fang Heng answered straightforwardly.
Previously, he had made a large sum of survival points by spreading the vaccine antibodies to create the zombie wave. Currently, he was extremely rich.
“Okay! ” Yi Qi immediately agreed. “Then, for the sake of better cooperation, why don’t we introduce our abilities to each other? ”

He looked at everyone, starting, “Let’s start with me. My special ability is piloting. I’m good at mechanical maintenance and armed combat. Vera has a special perception ability. Her perception attribute and will attribute have both broken through 10. She can sense the approach of some high-level life forms and give a warning in advance. Yuan Bin is good at close combat and long-range damage, and he has high-level weapon mastery. ”
When it was Zhong Lei’s turn, he said, “I’m also a damage-oriented person, and I’m good at using medium and heavy weapons. ”
Everyone shifted their gazes to Fang Heng.
“As for me... ” Fang Heng thought for a moment and said, “My abilities are quite complex, and I dabble a lot. I know a little of everything. ”
The few of them were stunned when they heard that.
Yuan Bin slapped his forehead and said, “Hey, brother, don’t tell me you’re an all-rounded player? ”
“That’s right. That’s what everyone calls me. All-rounded support. ”
Everyone looked at each other and understood.
So he was a rich support.
Ahem.
“All right. Do you have any materials that you need to replenish? If there’s no problem, we’ll start immediately. How about it? ”
“No problem. ”
After packing their luggage, the group started heading toward the nursing home on the hillside.
Fang Heng also realized that few people were on the mountain path leading to the nursing home.
Not even zombies could be seen, let alone animals.
Soon, along the path, an old building appeared in front of them.
“We’re here at Far Mountain Nursing Home. ”
Outside the nursing home, the main door was closed.
Fang Heng had just taken a few steps forward when he was stopped by Yi Qi who was behind him. “Don’t go through the main door. ”
Yi Qi explained, “There’s something inside. If we enter through the main door, we might disturb it. ”
Fang Heng frowned. “Then what should we do? ”
“Go through the back door. Follow me. ” Yuan Bin walked to the front of the group. He led the group around the nursing home and entered through the broken fence in the back garden.

“It’s best not to make any noise from here on. Try to speak as softly as possible. They might follow our voices and track us here, ” Yuan Bin explained in a low voice. “This place has very evil energy. ”
Using voice to track the enemy’s location?
It was a bit like a Licker.
As Fang Heng thought to himself, he followed Yuan Bin into the back garden of the nursing home.
The garden had not been cleaned for a long time, and it looked unmaintained.

Fang Heng rubbed his chin, thinking to himself.
It sounded a little troublesome.
Should he bring the fusion Tyrant forms over?
The damned place was too far.
If he made the fusion Tyrant forms self-destruct, it would take more than six hours.
Moreover, he would not be able to obtain a proliferator in a short period of time.
Based on the theoretical analysis and the unreliable information obtained from the player forums, the ceiling of Zombie Apocalypse’s combat strength was a Tier 5 mutated zombie.
Under the Blood Moon state, the strongest mutated zombie’s combat strength was only comparable to a Tier 6 zombie.
Based on the capped combat strength, with his current ability, Fang Heng would most likely not be able to defeat a Tier 5 mutated zombie in a one-on-one fight.
However, it would not be a problem for him to save his life.
Even if he encountered an extreme situation at a small probability, District 8 still had a rebirth chamber that could be used.
Fang Heng believed that he could go inside and test the waters.
Vera continued, “Before we carry out this operation, I still need to confirm the target of the operation.
Previously, when we were conducting a preliminary search of the secret area under the basement, we accidentally found a set of research materials related to the virus in a room. ”
“Research materials? ” Fang Heng’s eyes suddenly lit up.
“Do you still have them? ”
“I gave the materials to a friend.
He works for a big gaming company.
According to him, the research materials are very useful.
If we can find more relevant information from the basement, they are willing to pay a lot of money to buy it. ”
Fang Heng thought it was a pity.
“Do you still remember the content of the materials? ”
Vera responded, “I didn’t really understand the contents.
They should be related to a zombie virus experiment conducted by Meteorite Company.
They contain all the experimental data.
Players’ shelters can use them to increase the research level and the attractiveness of the shelter. ”
“Okay... ” Fang Heng nodded, feeling suspicious.
So Plan Scorpio was also a zombie virus project?
Vera uttered, “My friend promised me to buy all the information at a higher price than the market price.
After we find a way to get the information, all the rewards gained from selling it will be shared equally among us.
Do you have any objection to that? ”
Fang Heng immediately said, “The information is useful to me.
I’m willing to buy it at double the price he promised you. ”
Hearing that, Vera and the other two were stunned.
“Did we meet a rich man? ”
Vera confirmed with Fang Heng, “Double?
Are you sure?
One set of information will cost 3,000 survival points. ”
“3,000, deal, ” Fang Heng answered straightforwardly.
Previously, he had made a large sum of survival points by spreading the vaccine antibodies to create the zombie wave.
Currently, he was extremely rich.
“Okay! ” Yi Qi immediately agreed.
“Then, for the sake of better cooperation, why don’t we introduce our abilities to each other? ”
He looked at everyone, starting, “Let’s start with me.
My special ability is piloting.
I’m good at mechanical maintenance and armed combat.
Vera has a special perception ability.
Her perception attribute and will attribute have both broken through 10.
She can sense the approach of some high-level life forms and give a warning in advance.
Yuan Bin is good at close combat and long-range damage, and he has high-level weapon mastery. ”
When it was Zhong Lei’s turn, he said, “I’m also a damage-oriented person, and I’m good at using medium and heavy weapons. ”
Everyone shifted their gazes to Fang Heng.
“As for me... ” Fang Heng thought for a moment and said, “My abilities are quite complex, and I dabble a lot.
I know a little of everything. ”
The few of them were stunned when they heard that.
Yuan Bin slapped his forehead and said, “Hey, brother, don’t tell me you’re an all-rounded player? ”
“That’s right.
That’s what everyone calls me.
All-rounded support. ”
Everyone looked at each other and understood.
So he was a rich support.
Ahem.
“All right.
Do you have any materials that you need to replenish?
If there’s no problem, we’ll start immediately.
How about it? ”
“No problem. ”
After packing their luggage, the group started heading toward the nursing home on the hillside.
Fang Heng also realized that few people were on the mountain path leading to the nursing home.
Not even zombies could be seen, let alone animals.
Soon, along the path, an old building appeared in front of them.
“We’re here at Far Mountain Nursing Home. ”
Outside the nursing home, the main door was closed.
Fang Heng had just taken a few steps forward when he was stopped by Yi Qi who was behind him.
“Don’t go through the main door. ”
Yi Qi explained, “There’s something inside.
If we enter through the main door, we might disturb it. ”
Fang Heng frowned.
“Then what should we do? ”
“Go through the back door.
Follow me. ” Yuan Bin walked to the front of the group.
He led the group around the nursing home and entered through the broken fence in the back garden.
“It’s best not to make any noise from here on.
Try to speak as softly as possible.
They might follow our voices and track us here, ” Yuan Bin explained in a low voice.
“This place has very evil energy. ”
Using voice to track the enemy’s location?
It was a bit like a Licker.
As Fang Heng thought to himself, he followed Yuan Bin into the back garden of the nursing home.
The garden had not been cleaned for a long time, and it looked unmaintained.

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - Exploration Mission
paragraphs: Yuan Bin and the others had already entered the nursing home and explored it three times. They were familiar with the route and quickly led Fang Heng and the others around the back garden. They entered the interior of the building through a small door on the side of the back garden.
Click...
Yuan Bin carefully closed the wooden door.
He pointed forward, and the group continued forward along the pathway.
The gloomy weather in the north affected their vision.
Even in broad daylight, the interior of the room was still abnormally dark.
Fang Heng used the night vision ability of the Vampire Bloodline to survey the surrounding environment.
It was very chaotic.
On the wall, he could see dried and dark blood stains.
He could not be sure whether those blood stains were produced after the outbreak of the zombie crisis.
Following Yuan Bin, the group tiptoed and made several turns to arrive at the iron door at the end of the corridor on the first floor of the basement.
Yuan Bin tried to push the door open, frowning.
“What’s wrong? ”
Yuan Bin whispered, “It’s strange. The door’s locked. It wasn’t locked the last time we came. ”
Vera turned to look at Fang Heng. “Can the keys given to us by the camp’s merchant open the door? ”
“Let me try. ” Fang Heng took out a bunch of keys from his backpack. Comparing the key shapes, he chose one of the keys and stuffed it into the keyhole.
Click...
The iron door opened.
Behind the door was a storage room.
The room was abnormally messy. Wooden boxes of all sizes were randomly stacked on the floor.

“Someone must have been here. The last time we left, we didn’t even have time to close the passage. ” As Yuan Bin spoke, he walked forward and set aside the boxes stacked together on the floor, then lifted the carpet underneath.
There was an iron ring on the floor below the carpet that could be pulled up.
Yuan Bin walked to the edge of the iron ring and pulled up the attached iron chain with great effort.
Ka... Da, da, da...
The iron chain was pulled up slowly.
A passage leading underground was revealed.
Yuan Bin and the others took out flashlights from their backpacks.

Yi Qi walked to the front of the group and said, “I’ll lead the way. Everyone, be careful. Our goal this time is to search for information and try to avoid unnecessary battles. If we encounter any danger that we can’t resist, we’ll just run away. ”
Everyone nodded in unison.
Fang Heng looked around along the way.
He felt that Yi Qi’s group’s description of the monster was not very accurate.
The other party must be a creature that had the ability to think.
It was very likely to be a person.
They walked down the stairs and went through a passage, and a fork leading to three different paths appeared in front of them.
Vera stood at the intersection and closed her eyes to sense for a moment.
“I don’t sense any powerful enemies nearby, ” she said in a low voice. “On the path we previously took the road, we encountered danger halfway. This time, let’s try that path. ”
“Okay, let’s go. ” The group continued to explore the left passage.
Soon, Fang Heng found the door to a room at the side of the pathway.
Yuan Bin pushed the door first.
Thud...
The door was locked.
“It was the same when we came here before. Most of the doors here are locked. Don’t force the door open. The sound will attract the monsters. ”
Fang Heng tried to take out the keys given by the apocalypse merchant and compared their shapes again. However, the shapes were a total mismatch for the keyhole.
“The basement is Meteorite Company’s secret research room. Your keys most likely won’t work. Don’t waste time. ”
“Don’t worry. I still have a way, ” Fang Heng said as he took out a piece of iron wire from his backpack.
Yi Qi and the others stopped and looked at Fang Heng curiously.
Fang Heng twisted the wire into a special ring, stuffed the wire into the door, and fiddled with it a few times.
Ka...
With a soft sound, Fang Heng gently twisted the door handle.
The iron door opened.
“Hint: authentication successful. You have unlocked the door through your skill Lock Disablement. Your Lock Disablement skill’s experience points have reached the maximum. ”
“Amazing! That skill of yours is amazing! ” Yuan Bin was pleasantly surprised when he saw Fang Heng easily open the door. He lowered his voice and praised Fang Heng, giving him a thumbs up.
“It’s just so-so. Basic operation. ” As Fang Heng spoke, he poked his head into the room to take a look.
Behind the iron door was a relatively large dormitory room.
The dormitory was very large. With a cursory glance, he could see six beds and a separate bathroom.
It seemed that no one had been there for a long time, as the room was covered in a thick layer of dust.
The few of them followed Fang Heng into the room. They closed the iron door and searched the room separately.
“I found something. Come and take a look. ” Vera had found a diary under a shabby bed.
Fang Heng followed and went over to take a look.
The handwriting on the diary was crooked, like the handwriting of a primary school student.
“Hint: you have obtained Frege’s diary (incomplete) . ”
Entry 2.1 read: “I don’t like to write diary entries, but my mother forced me to write. So annoying. ”
Entry 2.4 read: “I hate him very much, but my mother always forces me to call him dad. ”
Entry 2.9 read: “Very good. He will never come back to bother me again. ”
Entry 3.4 read: “Daddy came back. He seems to have changed his bad habit. He no longer scolds me. But I still have to keep a diary, so annoying. ”

Entry 3.8 read: “The mister who sent me told me not to be sad. He told me that there are many children like me here and that I will soon find new friends. But I do not feel happy. I hate the way that mister looks at me. Mommy hates him too. Daddy hates him too. It was because of him that we had to move out of the house. ”
Entry 5.2 read: “I met a lot of new friends. It’s just that I have to face needles every day. I hate needles. Mommy told me that I should cooperate with the mister’s treatment. ”
Entry 5.6 read: “Rui Qi was so amazing. She knows many amazing magic tricks. So interesting! ”
“Hint: player team has triggered the special ring mission ‘Mysterious Nursing Home. ‘ ”
Mission name: Mysterious Nursing Home.
Mission difficulty: A.

Mission description: you have discovered a secret area below the nursing home. During the search, you found a strange diary. You are aware that there may be some secrets in this nursing home. Please try to find more clues.
Mission description: leave the nursing home and the current mission ring mission will default to failure. Final reward calculation will commence thereafter.
Mission reward: survival points.
Unfortunately, it was not a main storyline.
Fang Heng was a little disappointed.
After reading the diary and combining it with the game mission hint, Yi Qi and the others were even more confused.
The diary gave them a very strange feeling.

“Didn’t the boss of the apocalypse camp mention before that this place used to be an orphanage... ” Zhong Lei guessed, “The diary mentioned needles. Could it be that Meteorite Company is relying on orphans to carry out research on viruses? ”
“An orphanage... ” Fang Heng touched his chin and pondered.
“Don’t bother about it. If I have to say, this mission is a trap. ” Yuan Bin pursed his lips. “Don’t forget that we’re here to get money... ”
“Shh! ” Vera’s expression changed slightly.
She seemed to have sensed something and stopped Yuan Bin from continuing. “Enemies are approaching. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - Monster
paragraphs: Everyone immediately shut their mouths when they heard Vera.
Just then, they all heard the sound of footsteps approaching from the distance.
Yuan Bin was shocked and immediately adjusted his flashlight to the dimmest.
With the help of the weak light, everyone adjusted their formation and stood in position. Holding their breaths, they aimed their muzzles at the door of the room.
Soon, Fang Heng heard the sound of footsteps walking past the door.
It was getting further and further away.
Fang Heng carefully stepped forward and held the door handle.
His actions shocked Yuan Bin, who reached out and pressed his hand on Fang Heng’s shoulder. He mouthed, “Are you crazy? ”
Fang Heng glanced at him. “It’s fine. The situation’s very stable. ”
Stable my foot!
Yuan Bin quickly let go of Fang Heng and held the gun in his hands tightly, getting ready for battle.
Fang Heng gently twisted the door handle.
Da, da, da...
The old iron door made a faint sound.
Fang Heng opened a gap in the door and looked outside through it.
A faint light came from the right side of the pathway.
A figure had its back to them.
It bent its body and slowly moved forward along the corridor.
The entire basement was dark, and the figure had a flashlight in its hand to provide light.
He knew how to use a flashlight? Was it a human?
“Could he be the owner of the diary? ” Fang Heng turned to look at Vera and the others and suggested, “Why don’t we talk to him? Maybe we can trigger the follow-up mission? ”
“Don’t! ” Yuan Bin quickly stopped Fang Heng’s impulsive behavior. “What do you expect a monster to talk to you about? We almost died at his hands last time. ”

Yuan Bin thought to himself, “This teammate is really stupid and bold! I don’t know how he survived in the game for so long! Isn’t it better to just safely search for research materials and sell them for money? Wait... ”
Thinking that the generous buyer who would later buy the research materials was so stupid and bold, Yuan Bin had another epiphany. “Maybe that’s why he has the ability to make so much money. ”
“Found the map. ” Yi Qi found a map in the corner of the room and called everyone over to take a look. “Come and take a look. ”
“Hint: your team has obtained the blueprint of Plan Scorpio Research Institute (part) . ”
“Plan Scorpio! That’s right! ” Fang Heng mused as he went forward and looked at the map with everyone.
The first thing he saw was the symbol of Meteorite Company in the corner of the map.
The map showed that the entire underground area was very large.
To the west of the second basement was the dormitory room where the members of Plan Scorpio lived.
The large-sized central research room was in the fourth basement.
“Found it! It’s in the fourth basement! ” Yuan Bin exclaimed in a low voice.
“Yes, the information should be in the central research room in the fourth basement. ”

“We need to think of a way to go to the fourth basement. It seems that there’s no electricity supply in this place, so the elevator is probably not in operation. ” Yi Qi suggested while examining the map, “Why don’t we go straight down the stairs? What do you think? ”
“Yeah, I think it’ll work. ”
The five of them quickly came up with a plan.
After confirming that the monster in the pathway had gone far away, they quietly left the room.
It was much easier with the blueprint.
The group was very careful along the way, and they managed to find the stairs leading down without facing any danger.
They had just reached the third basement when their hearts skipped a beat.
There was light in the third basement!
There were still people living there? !
The light came from the large glass window of a room on the other side of the pathway.
Zhong Lei analyzed the blueprint in his hand and said in a low voice, “There is a description on the blueprint. The light is coming from the lounge of the research and development department. ”
“I can feel something inside. ” Vera shrank her neck. The sense of danger coming from the lounge made her feel very uncomfortable.
“Don’t alert the monsters. Let’s walk over carefully. ” Yi Qi turned off the flashlight in his hand and gestured at the group.
He pointed at the end of the passage and signaled for the group to bend over carefully.
It was a distance of five to six meters. As long as they could get past the window carefully without being discovered, it would be fine.
“I’ll go first. You guys follow after. ” Yi Qi took a deep breath and walked as lightly as possible. He bent over and carefully moved past the window.
He waved at the people behind him, indicating that everything was safe.
Vera and Yuan Bin were next.
The two of them also passed through the pathway without any danger.
Zhong Lei was the fourth.
He exchanged looks with Fang Heng, feeling that the trio was being overly cautious.
Zhong Lei walked forward, lowered his body like the others, and slowly moved past the window.
Halfway through, he suddenly noticed that Yi Qi and the others at the front of the pathway were frantically waving at him, seemingly drawing his attention upward.
The top?
Zhong Lei habitually raised his head.
Then, he saw a terrifying face.
That face was tightly pressed against the window. Its face was extremely distorted, and its facial features seemed to have been messed up.
The face that was pressed against the window was staring straight at Zhong Lei.
The moment he saw the face, Zhong Lei felt as if his body had been struck by lightning. He could not help but lean back, and a game hint appeared in his vision.
“Hint: you have been affected by the fear effect. ”
“Hint: you have entered a paralyzed state. ”
“Sh*t! Zhong Lei! Run! ! ” Yuan Bin shouted and took out an automatic rifle.
Bang! Bang, bang! !
The next moment, the window shattered.
A short figure jumped out of the window.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted as he stared at the monster that jumped out of the window.
A zombie?
It didn’t look like one!
It wasn’t short, but it had a hunched body. Its hair was disheveled, and it was half-kneeling on the ground.
“Do it! ! ! ” Yi Qi shouted.
Bang, bang! Bang, bang, bang! !
The sound of gunshots echoed throughout the passage.
The monster’s dodging ability was beyond everyone’s expectations. It moved quickly in the empty pathway and once again jumped into the lounge to hide.
Bang! !
In a paralyzed state, Zhong Lei felt something kick his abdomen!
His body flew up more than half a meter and crashed heavily into the wall behind him.
It felt as if he had been stabbed in the heart.
Before he could speak, Zhong Lei felt his body being tightly held by something, and his entire body was lifted into the air.
Fang Heng stared in Zhong Lei’s direction and could not help but narrow his eyes, wanting to see more clearly.
“Hint: your perception and will attribute both exceed 15. You have noticed some details. ”
Fang Heng saw three shadows in the air.
The shadows were extremely thin. Only when they attacked Zhong Lei did they reveal a rough outline. One of the shadows was tall and lifting Zhong Lei in the air.
What the hell!
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. He immediately raised his pistol and aimed at the shadows, pulling the trigger continuously.
Bang, bang! !
The bullets directly passed through the shadows.
It was useless?
The gunshots paused. While everyone was reloading their ammunition, the short monster once again leaped out of the lounge.
Its figure turned into a black shadow and flew toward Fang Heng at an extremely fast speed.
Vera shouted a warning, “Fang Shuo! Be careful! ”
Fang Heng frowned, his gaze focused on the monster that was rapidly approaching him.

The first thing he saw was the symbol of Meteorite Company in the corner of the map.
The map showed that the entire underground area was very large.
To the west of the second basement was the dormitory room where the members of Plan Scorpio lived.
The large-sized central research room was in the fourth basement.
“Found it!
It’s in the fourth basement! ” Yuan Bin exclaimed in a low voice.
“Yes, the information should be in the central research room in the fourth basement. ”
“We need to think of a way to go to the fourth basement.
It seems that there’s no electricity supply in this place, so the elevator is probably not in operation. ” Yi Qi suggested while examining the map, “Why don’t we go straight down the stairs?
What do you think? ”
“Yeah, I think it’ll work. ”
The five of them quickly came up with a plan.
After confirming that the monster in the pathway had gone far away, they quietly left the room.
It was much easier with the blueprint.
The group was very careful along the way, and they managed to find the stairs leading down without facing any danger.
They had just reached the third basement when their hearts skipped a beat.
There was light in the third basement!
There were still people living there? !
The light came from the large glass window of a room on the other side of the pathway.
Zhong Lei analyzed the blueprint in his hand and said in a low voice, “There is a description on the blueprint.
The light is coming from the lounge of the research and development department. ”
“I can feel something inside. ” Vera shrank her neck.
The sense of danger coming from the lounge made her feel very uncomfortable.
“Don’t alert the monsters.
Let’s walk over carefully. ” Yi Qi turned off the flashlight in his hand and gestured at the group.
He pointed at the end of the passage and signaled for the group to bend over carefully.
It was a distance of five to six meters.
As long as they could get past the window carefully without being discovered, it would be fine.
“I’ll go first.
You guys follow after. ” Yi Qi took a deep breath and walked as lightly as possible.
He bent over and carefully moved past the window.
He waved at the people behind him, indicating that everything was safe.
Vera and Yuan Bin were next.
The two of them also passed through the pathway without any danger.
Zhong Lei was the fourth.
He exchanged looks with Fang Heng, feeling that the trio was being overly cautious.
Zhong Lei walked forward, lowered his body like the others, and slowly moved past the window.
Halfway through, he suddenly noticed that Yi Qi and the others at the front of the pathway were frantically waving at him, seemingly drawing his attention upward.
The top?
Zhong Lei habitually raised his head.
Then, he saw a terrifying face.
That face was tightly pressed against the window.
Its face was extremely distorted, and its facial features seemed to have been messed up.
The face that was pressed against the window was staring straight at Zhong Lei.
The moment he saw the face, Zhong Lei felt as if his body had been struck by lightning.
He could not help but lean back, and a game hint appeared in his vision.
“Hint: you have been affected by the fear effect. ”
“Hint: you have entered a paralyzed state. ”
“Sh*t!
Zhong Lei!
Run! ! ” Yuan Bin shouted and took out an automatic rifle.
Bang!
Bang, bang! !
The next moment, the window shattered.
A short figure jumped out of the window.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted as he stared at the monster that jumped out of the window.
A zombie?
It didn’t look like one!
It wasn’t short, but it had a hunched body.
Its hair was disheveled, and it was half-kneeling on the ground.
“Do it! ! ! ” Yi Qi shouted.
Bang, bang!
Bang, bang, bang! !
The sound of gunshots echoed throughout the passage.
The monster’s dodging ability was beyond everyone’s expectations.
It moved quickly in the empty pathway and once again jumped into the lounge to hide.
Bang! !
In a paralyzed state, Zhong Lei felt something kick his abdomen!
His body flew up more than half a meter and crashed heavily into the wall behind him.
It felt as if he had been stabbed in the heart.
Before he could speak, Zhong Lei felt his body being tightly held by something, and his entire body was lifted into the air.
Fang Heng stared in Zhong Lei’s direction and could not help but narrow his eyes, wanting to see more clearly.
“Hint: your perception and will attribute both exceed 15.
You have noticed some details. ”
Fang Heng saw three shadows in the air.
The shadows were extremely thin.
Only when they attacked Zhong Lei did they reveal a rough outline.
One of the shadows was tall and lifting Zhong Lei in the air.
What the hell!
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
He immediately raised his pistol and aimed at the shadows, pulling the trigger continuously.
Bang, bang! !
The bullets directly passed through the shadows.
It was useless?
The gunshots paused.
While everyone was reloading their ammunition, the short monster once again leaped out of the lounge.
Its figure turned into a black shadow and flew toward Fang Heng at an extremely fast speed.
Vera shouted a warning, “Fang Shuo!
Be careful! ”
Fang Heng frowned, his gaze focused on the monster that was rapidly approaching him.

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - Fantasy Materialization
paragraphs: It seemed that only that monster was a physical entity.
Fang Heng stood still and immediately switched to the sniper rifle.
Item: Scavenger Type 4 sniper rifle (Ding Min’s customized version)

Description: the Sniper Rifle developed by Dr. Ding Min for the high-tier members of the Scavenger Army. It is coupled with the use of specially made gunpowder bullets, enhancing the penetrative power of the bullets at the expense of some accuracy. Requires an additional 20 points of strength to use. Extra loading time and aiming time are also required.
Description: it is said that no one in the Scavenger Army can truly control the rifle.
Tactical shooting; aim, focus!
Fang Heng’s pupils reflected the figure of the monster, and he steadily pulled the trigger.
Bang!
A gunshot sounded.
Almost simultaneously, the monster took action to dodge.
However, it was a little too slow!
Along with Fang Heng’s high strength attribute and level 18 gun mastery, the bullet from the sniper rifle grazed the monster’s shoulder.
Boom! !
The high firepower of the bullet shattered the monster’s entire arm!
The spot where the right shoulder was connected to the body was a bloody mess!
The impact also sent the monster flying backward.
Zhong Lei finally came back to his senses and was rid of his fear. He felt his body relax. Just as he landed, he saw the short monster flying toward him.
“Damn it! Die! ” Zhong Lei pounced toward the monster in the air and knocked it against a wall.
He whipped out a grenade and stuffed it into the monster’s mouth.
Boom! ! !
The next second, there was a loud sound.
The grenade exploded!
The monster’s head and Zhong Lei’s entire right arm were blown into a pile of flesh and blood.
“Hint: your team has killed Frege. Totaling battle contribution: you have obtained 332 survival points. ”
Phew...
It was over.
In just a short one-minute battle, everyone felt as if they had experienced a great battle.
Yi Qi and the other two felt as if they had barely escaped from death. At the same time, they carefully sized up Zhong Lei and Fang Heng.
They had never thought that both of them would actually be so dope.
Moreover, they were both ruthless.
Zhong Lei covered his shattered shoulder and endured the pain as he very skillfully took out a bottle of healing spray from his backpack.
Under everyone’s astonished gazes, a layer of white light enveloped Zhong Lei’s right arm, which had been destroyed by the explosion, and it rapidly began to recover.
In just a few seconds, Zhong Lei’s right arm was as good as new.

Seeing everyone’s confused gazes, Zhong Lei wiped the sweat from his forehead and explained, “It’s an A-level talent skill called Limb Regeneration. It just looks overpowered on the surface. After using it, for a long period of time, my HP upper limit will be reduced. ”
In the past, Zhong Lei had truly felt that that skill of his was very impressive.
This grenade move he did earlier was also a battle tactic that he had developed.
But after meeting Fang Heng, Zhong Lei felt that the skill was useless apart from showing off in front of the rookies.
After all, it probably would not be effective on fusion Tyrants.
“What the hell is that thing? ” Yuan Bin held back his disgust and walked forward to check the pieces of the corpse that had been blasted apart by the grenade. “Is he really human? ”
Vera flipped through the game log and asked, “Did you guys see the hint? Frege. Was he the one that left the diary we found earlier? ”
“Mhm, it’s very strange. ” Fang Heng lowered his head and began to ponder.
Frege had a superpower-type talent skill.
In the King of Gods’ game, players would randomly receive a talent skill when they first entered the game.
According to Fang Heng’s understanding, a very small number of players awakened a superpower-type talent skill.
That type of skill was generally rated at level-A and above.
Players aside, a few days ago, when he had just taken over the Scavenger Army, the mutant worm body in the box left by the former commander, Cook Barn, also had some superpower-type talent skill.
If not for the silence skill of the Vampiric Spirit Cane, he would have died there.
“I can’t find any clues on the corpse. ” Fang Heng walked to the broken window and looked at the interior of the research and development department lounge through the window.
The entire room was very clean, and there was a passage inside that seemingly led to a separate small room.
There should be more than one person living inside.
The situation was not good, and the danger was far from over.
Monsters like Frege had a rather unique way of attacking. If there were too many of them, he would not be able to handle it.

Fang Heng narrowed his eyes slightly and said, “He is not the monster we saw in the basement earlier. There should be other monsters in the nursing home. They might come back to investigate after hearing the commotion. ”
“Let’s speed up and find the research materials first, then we’ll leave immediately, ” said Yi Qi
“Okay! ”
Everyone immediately reached a consensus and continued to move toward the fourth basement.
As they arrived at the fourth basement, the passage in front of them dimmed again.
The power supply of the entire fourth basement had failed.
Yuan Bin took out a flashlight and tried to light up the front.
With the light from the flashlight and help with directions from the blueprint, they quickly found the central research room along the right side of the hall in the fourth basement.
“Found it. The central research room. ”
The alloy metal door was locked tightly, and there was a heavy iron chain wrapped around it.
A thick layer of dust was visible on the iron chain, suggesting that no one had been there for a long time.
Everyone made way for Fang Heng and turned back to look at him.
Fang Heng walked to the door, lowering his head to check.
The metal door should have been broken through by force a long time ago, then resecured with an iron chain.
Fang Heng took out a shotgun.
Item: Scavenger Type 4 shotgun (Ding Min’s customized version) . ”
Boom! !
With a loud sound, the chain was broken.
Fang Heng pushed the door to the research room open.
It was abnormally messy inside.
“Let’s start. Gather information. The faster, the better. ”
The team of five immediately began to search the room.
Fang Heng walked to a corner of the room and looked around for useful research materials.
“Hint: you have found research materials of Plan Scorpio. ”
“Hint: this item has a high research value. You can submit this information to any survival camp in exchange for a reward. You can also trade it with other players. ”
“It’s here! Found it! ” Fang Heng mused internally. His heart skipped a beat as he read through the research materials.

One section read: “Plan Scorpio: Frege. A child diagnosed with schizophrenia. After testing, we believe that he has the special ability of Fantasy Materialization. Ability name: Fantasy Materialization. Ability evaluation: S-. ”
“Plan Scorpio... Frege... ” Fang Heng muttered to himself after roughly scanning through the personal information section of Plan Scorpio, once again falling into deep thought.
He finally understood.
Mysterious abilities also existed in the Zombie Apocalypse world.
However, the occurrence of such mysterious abilities was extremely rare. There were only a few thousand cases in the entire world, and the average strength was not strong.
An ability like Frege’s that had extremely high destructive power was even rarer.
Meteorite Company’s Plan Scorpio was a research project based on such special abilities.
“But what does it have to do with the main storyline? Was I fooled by Black Castle? ” Fang Heng was puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - Ignores Defense
paragraphs: Bang!
A heavy knock sounded.
The people who were searching for information were stunned. They stopped their work at the same time and aimed their weapons at the door of the research room.
Boom! ! !
With a loud sound, the door to the research laboratory was broken open with a bang.
A young man with long black hair walked in from outside.
Bang, bang, bang, bang!
Without waiting for the other party to make a move, Yi Qi and the others pulled the trigger first and aimed at the door.
The young man stood still.
The two broken alloy doors, controlled by a special strength, floated in the air and shielded Wallace from the incoming bullets.
“Frege! You killed Frege! ! ”
Behind the doors, Wallace gritted his teeth, his eyes filled with hatred.
The long hair that hung down almost covered his entire face.
Fang Heng could not see his face clearly, but from his voice, he could tell that he was very young.
“Why! ! ! Why did you do it! ? ” Wallace roared.
The wooden tables and chairs in the entire room floated uncontrollably in the air, crashing toward the people who had fired the shots.
Yi Qi and the others had never seen such a scene before! Seeing that the guns were ineffective, they all gave up their attacks and dodged to the back to find cover again.
Fang Heng frowned.
Under such circumstances, it was most likely impossible to communicate with the other party.
They had to think of a way to get rid of him!
Fang Heng no longer hesitated. He took out his sniper rifle and aimed it at Wallace.
Wallace sensed the danger and quickly turned around, staring at Fang Heng.
With a raise of his hand toward Fang Heng, the surrounding wooden chairs attacked Fang Heng.
The latter stayed still, aiming the sniper rifle.
Bang! !
A gunshot sound rang out.
The wooden chairs that stood in the line of fire were blasted to smithereens!
Wallace instantly felt a strong sense of danger, and the two alloy metal doors in front of him flew forward to block the trajectory of the sniper bullet!
Boom! !
After being hit by the bullet from Ding Min’s specially made sniper rifle, the two alloy metal doors blocking Wallace exploded.

The doors had absorbed most of the explosion damage, but Wallace was still hit by the huge impact. He was sent flying for a distance before falling heavily to the ground, his body covered by the debris from the exploded metal doors.
Was he dead?
The trio was shocked by the power of Fang Heng’s sniper rifle, but they hurriedly recovered their senses to assist Fang Heng.
When the three of them realized that Wallace’s attack had stopped, they immediately raised their guns and fired wildly at the spot where he had fallen.
Bang, bang, bang, bang!
After firing a series of bullets, they exchanged glances with each other while reloading their magazines.
“Is he dead? ”
“I didn’t receive the game hint. I’m not sure... ”
Just as Vera finished speaking, she was startled.
Roar! ! !
The fragments of the alloy gate that had pressed down on Wallace’s body were instantly repelled.
“F*ck! ” Yuan Bin cursed loudly and immediately lowered his head to seek cover from the stray door fragments flung in all directions.
He was actually not dead yet?
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched as he continued to load the sniper rifle bullets.
“Why... ” Wallace slowly stood up with one hand on the wall, muttering with hot blood flowing down his face. “You degenerates! Why are you disturbing our peace! Roar! ! ! ”
Fang Heng, who was reloading sniper rifle bullets, narrowed his eyes.
Right after he saw visible sound waves spreading out in all directions, Fang Heng heard a roar in his ears.
“Hint: you have been affected by a special energy. You have received 300 damage (physical defense ignored) . ”

“Hint (this hint is triggered by basic occult) : you have received an elementary spiritual attack. You have entered a state of dizziness. Basic occult has reduced the duration of this repelling, dizziness, confusion, paralysis, and other statuses by 50% . Your will attribute is higher than 20 points. The duration of all negative effects sustained by this attack has been reduced by 60% . Your vitality is higher than 30 points. The duration of paralysis has been reduced by 70% . ”
The intense ringing in his ears seemed to be ringing in his brain.
Fang Heng saw lines of small words appearing rapidly in the lower right corner of his retina, and the scene in front of him also retreated rapidly.
Bang! !
His back slammed into the wall, and blood oozed out from his ears.
Fang Heng looked ahead to see Wallace staggering forward step by step.
Under his long hair was a pair of red pupils.
At that moment, Fang Heng was a little dazed. He felt like he had seen those pair of eyes before.
“Hint: you have recovered from paralysis. ”
When the stun time was up, Fang Heng regained his mobility and immediately switched to a shotgun with his right hand.
“Item: Scavenger Type 4 shotgun (Ding Min’s customized version) . ”

Description: a shotgun developed by Dr. Ding Min. It is equipped with a special enhanced gunpowder. The recoil force is extremely strong. It can only be used when the user’s strength is above 30. It can effectively deal with a heavily mutated zombie and a heavy tank with a single reload.
Description: it must be used with highly concentrated gunpowder bullets. Extremely destructive.
“Go to hell. ” Fang Heng pulled the trigger with one hand.
Boom! ! !
A loud explosion sounded.
Fang Heng’s body was knocked back against the wall due to the powerful recoil force.
Meanwhile, Wallace was sent flying, and he could no longer get up.
“Hint: your team has killed Wallace. Special item dropped: the key to the third basement’s secret research room. ”
Fang Heng shook his slightly injured arm, put away his shotgun, and spat a mouthful of blood on the ground.
“Are you all okay? ” Amidst the quietness, Fang Heng looked around.
“We’re all okay. ” After more than ten seconds, Vera was the first to recover from her paralyzed state. She panted heavily, took out a bottle of healing spray, and sprayed it into her mouth.
“The attack’s negative effects are too great... ” Vera looked at her remaining HP and exclaimed in her heart that she was lucky.
The other players also gradually recovered.
Wallace’s shockwave attack was too terrifying — large-scale damage, sure-hit, and defense-ignoring!
Fortunately, the damage was still within what they could take, so they were not instantly killed.
However, the various negative effects were a little overpowered. The paralysis state lasted for more than a minute!
As her HP slowly recovered, Vera turned to look at Fang Heng. At that moment, she suddenly realized that Fang Heng was different from the others.

Even with 12 points of willpower, Vera was pretty affected by the various negative effects including stun and paralysis. She had laid on the ground for nearly a minute before she recovered. On the other hand, Fang Heng only needed a few seconds to recover.

“Damn it, the difficulty of this stupid game is definitely over the limit. ” After recovering from the paralysis, Yuan Bin leaned against the wall and stood up while swearing, “I’ve hacked into an advanced game world’s forum and read it. I guarantee that this kind of attack that ignores defense is definitely something that only exists in advanced game worlds! It shouldn’t exist in Zombie Apocalypse! ”
