“Hint (this hint is triggered by basic occult) : you have received an elementary spiritual attack.
You have entered a state of dizziness.
Basic occult has reduced the duration of this repelling, dizziness, confusion, paralysis, and other statuses by 50% .
Your will attribute is higher than 20 points.
The duration of all negative effects sustained by this attack has been reduced by 60% .
Your vitality is higher than 30 points.
The duration of paralysis has been reduced by 70% . ”
The intense ringing in his ears seemed to be ringing in his brain.
Fang Heng saw lines of small words appearing rapidly in the lower right corner of his retina, and the scene in front of him also retreated rapidly.
Bang! !
His back slammed into the wall, and blood oozed out from his ears.
Fang Heng looked ahead to see Wallace staggering forward step by step.
Under his long hair was a pair of red pupils.
At that moment, Fang Heng was a little dazed.
He felt like he had seen those pair of eyes before.
“Hint: you have recovered from paralysis. ”
When the stun time was up, Fang Heng regained his mobility and immediately switched to a shotgun with his right hand.
“Item: Scavenger Type 4 shotgun (Ding Min’s customized version) . ”
Description: a shotgun developed by Dr.
Ding Min.
It is equipped with a special enhanced gunpowder.
The recoil force is extremely strong.
It can only be used when the user’s strength is above 30.
It can effectively deal with a heavily mutated zombie and a heavy tank with a single reload.
Description: it must be used with highly concentrated gunpowder bullets.
Extremely destructive.
“Go to hell. ” Fang Heng pulled the trigger with one hand.
Boom! ! !
A loud explosion sounded.
Fang Heng’s body was knocked back against the wall due to the powerful recoil force.
Meanwhile, Wallace was sent flying, and he could no longer get up.
“Hint: your team has killed Wallace.
Special item dropped: the key to the third basement’s secret research room. ”
Fang Heng shook his slightly injured arm, put away his shotgun, and spat a mouthful of blood on the ground.
“Are you all okay? ” Amidst the quietness, Fang Heng looked around.
“We’re all okay. ” After more than ten seconds, Vera was the first to recover from her paralyzed state.
She panted heavily, took out a bottle of healing spray, and sprayed it into her mouth.
“The attack’s negative effects are too great... ” Vera looked at her remaining HP and exclaimed in her heart that she was lucky.
The other players also gradually recovered.
Wallace’s shockwave attack was too terrifying — large-scale damage, sure-hit, and defense-ignoring!
Fortunately, the damage was still within what they could take, so they were not instantly killed.
However, the various negative effects were a little overpowered.
The paralysis state lasted for more than a minute!
As her HP slowly recovered, Vera turned to look at Fang Heng.
At that moment, she suddenly realized that Fang Heng was different from the others.
Even with 12 points of willpower, Vera was pretty affected by the various negative effects including stun and paralysis.
She had laid on the ground for nearly a minute before she recovered.
On the other hand, Fang Heng only needed a few seconds to recover.

“Damn it, the difficulty of this stupid game is definitely over the limit. ” After recovering from the paralysis, Yuan Bin leaned against the wall and stood up while swearing, “I’ve hacked into an advanced game world’s forum and read it.
I guarantee that this kind of attack that ignores defense is definitely something that only exists in advanced game worlds!
It shouldn’t exist in Zombie Apocalypse! ”

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - Unexpected Reward
paragraphs: Ordinary players would basically be sending themselves to their deaths in the face of such a special attack.
Yuan Bin felt both fear and relief.
Fortunately, his monstrously strong teammate was reliable and killed the monster in one shot. Otherwise, they wouldn’t even know how they died.

“Stop talking nonsense! ” With Vera’s help, Yi Qi stood up. “Let’s quickly gather information. After we find the information, we’ll immediately end the mission and retreat. We still don’t know how many monsters are gathered here. ”
Everyone nodded in unison.
No one wanted to stay in the damn place any longer. They quickly searched for research materials in the room.
“Damn it! This game is really bugged! ”

Just as they started searching, Yuan Bin discovered that the research materials in the research room had been shredded into pieces of waste paper. He started cursing again. “F*ck, we can’t even see it anymore! The data has been destroyed! ”
Zhong Lei’s brows were tightly knitted. He looked at Fang Heng, grabbed a handful of paper scraps on the ground, and gestured to him. “What I found is the same. It’s already beyond repair. ”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat when he heard that. He casually picked up a piece of information that had fallen into his hands.
Item: damaged research data
Description: a destroyed piece of information which contents can not be identified.
Wallace’s special ability had caused a spiritual energy fluctuation which ruined most of the papers in the room.
Bang!
Yuan Bin kicked the wall at the side as if he was venting, leaving a shoe print.
“F*ck! We’ve worked so hard for nothing! ”
No one paid attention to Yuan Bin, who was sulking. Everyone was silent, and the team’s morale became unusually low.

“Don’t worry. The destruction of the data might just be the game’s settings. Perhaps, it’s such that once we enter the research institute, we’ll be attacked by Wallace, which will lead to the destruction of the data. ” Fang Heng calmed everyone’s emotions. He slowly walked forward and picked up a key that was left beside the long-haired youth. “After all, we still have clues. ”
“Hint: you have obtained the key to the secret research room in the third basement. ”
Item: the key to the secret research room in the third basement.
Description: the key that Wallace carries with him. Can open the door to the secret research room on the third floor.

“Hint: player has killed Wallace. Completed the first stage ring mission: Exploration. Completed the second, third, fourth, and fifth stage ring missions ahead of time. Triggered the final mission: Wallace’s Secret. The reward will be calculated after all ring missions have been completed. ”
Mission name: Wallace’s Secret.
Mission difficulty: D.
Mission description: you have discovered Wallace, a young man with a special ability. He has a key on him. This key may lead you to the truth.
Mission requirements: try to restore the truth (leaving the nursing home area will default to mission failure, immediately entering the final rewards calculation) .
Mission reward: Survival points, special reward.
Fang Heng showed the key to everyone and said, “It seems that we have to go back to the third basement to check it out. ”
The third basement?
Everyone looked at each other.
“We can’t go back empty-handed. Since things have turned out this way, let’s go and take a look! We can also complete the mission! ”
“Yeah, you’re right. ” Vera also nodded. “I don’t want to go back just like this. What about you, Yuan Bin? ”
“Of course! ” Yuan Bin raised his hand in agreement. “It’s only D difficulty, so it shouldn’t be too dangerous. ”
Everyone roughly searched the central research room again. After confirming that they didn’t miss anything, they left.
“Fang Heng, you stay at the back of the team this time. We’ll cover for you. If you encounter any monsters again, think of a way to deal damage at the back. ”
After two consecutive battles, Yi Qi had already confirmed Fang Heng’s powerful combat strength. He immediately adjusted the formation to ensure that the team’s combat strength was maximized.
“Okay. ”
After switching the formation, the group returned to the third basement.
They returned to the pathway of the third basement.
The glass window shards were still on the ground, and a headless corpse lay on the ground.
Yi Qi led the way to the glass window and carefully peeked inside to take a look.
Then, he turned to look at Vera.
Vera shook her head. “I don’t feel any powerful enemies nearby. ”
Yi Qi made a safety sign to the people behind him, turned around, and entered the large lounge.
Fang Heng and the others followed after.
The hall was very large and clean. It seemed to be the residence of Wallace and the others.
They communicated with each other with their eyes and immediately began to explore the room.
Fang Heng walked to the side of the hall and noticed a group photo on the cabinet.
Upon picking up the photo to examine it, he noticed it showed children between three to ten years old. In total, there were more than 20 people in the photo.
Two of them were probably Wallace and Frege, whom he had killed previously.
Fang Heng’s heart sank.
Could there be more than 20 monsters left in the nursing home?
“Everyone, be careful. Keep your guards up while searching. ”
Everyone began to search the room.
Soon, Zhong Lei made a discovery. He pointed to a tightly shut metal emergency exit at the back of the pathway.
“Only this room uses an alloy door. It should be the secret research room. ”
Fang Heng walked forward and took out the key.
The others immediately stood behind Fang Heng and raised their muzzles.
Click.
The emergency exit opened, and Fang Heng carefully pushed open the door.
Zhong Lei’s index finger pressed on the automatic rifle. If there was any movement, he would immediately shoot.
However, the moment he saw the furnishings in the room clearly, Zhong Lei widened his eyes.
“This... ” Immediately recognizing the few things in the middle of the room behind the door, he swiftly turned his head and looked at Fang Heng beside him.
Meanwhile, Fang Heng’s face was also full of surprise.

Cultivation pod? ! What was such a thing doing there? ! There was actually three giant-sized cultivation pods placed side by side in the secret room. Two of the cultivation pod even had two pieces of flesh moving slightly within them! Could it be a Hila tissue sample? ! It was too similar! But how could it be stored in such a place? ! Could it be that Plan Scorpio was also related to the Hila experiment? ? But... Why wasn’t the Hila tissue sample stored in the special box made by Meteorite Company?
Several thoughts flashed through Fang Heng’s mind.
The other three were at a loss. They felt that the wriggling flesh in the cultivation pod was strange and instinctively didn’t want to step into the room.
Fang Heng slowly walked into the room and looked around.
After confirming that there was no danger, Fang Heng slowly raised his hands and pressed them to the glass of the two cultivation pods that contained Hila tissue samples.
“Hint: you have found two Hila tissue samples. ”
Confirming that they were indeed Hila tissue samples, Fang Heng was slightly excited.
“What a pleasant surprise! ” he thought.
Before going to the nursing home, he had never thought that he would be able to find a Hila tissue sample there.
With the two Hila tissue samples, the Scavenger Army’s production speed of divine potion and fusion Tyrant forms would double!

Fang Heng could not help but feel a little lucky. If he had not accidentally obtained information related to the Plan Scorpio from Black Castle, he might never have been able to find the last two Hila tissue samples himself.
However...

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - Partial Restoration
paragraphs: After the initial excitement, Fang Heng fell into deep doubt again.
It was too illogical!
Why would a Hila tissue sample appear in such a place?
Fang Heng’s brows were tightly knitted.
Suddenly, he saw a record book on the experiment table next to him.
Fang Heng walked forward and opened the book.
The book was blank, there was no record of anything.
A note slid down from the gap in the book and fell to the ground.
Fang Heng picked up the note, and when he saw the contents of the note clearly, his pupils dilated several times!

“I curse this land. The dead will no longer go to the land of rebirth. The wailing souls will continue to reincarnate into the world. Every time the crimson moon descends, the dead sinners will return from the depths of the earth. They will continue to suffer and reincarnate into death... ”
Fang Heng’s heart pounded furiously. His gaze gradually shifted downward until he saw the signature at the bottom: Hila Rui Qi.
What the hell!
In an instant, Fang Heng began to reorganize all the information he had so far.

He mused, “Returning from the depths of the earth, reincarnation, the crimson moon...Is Rui Qi the superpower previously mentioned in the diary? ! Is the Hila experiment referring to her? It all makes sense now. Hila, Plan Scorpio, Meteorite Company, first-generation virus, mutant worm bodies, and the Scavenger Army, they’re all connected! ”
Fang Heng frowned. He felt as if he had grasped the outline of the world, but there was still something missing. In any case, he felt that his view of the game world had been overturned.
All along, Fang Heng and 99.999% of the other players thought that the so-called Blood Moon was part of the game’s settings.
But now, it seemed that the ultimate cause of the whole zombie apocalypse was actually the curse of a crimson moon.
Fang Heng was a little confused. He tried to clear his mind but still felt that something was missing.
“Fang Heng, what’s wrong? ”
Seeing that Fang Heng was standing there like he was possessed after reading the note, Zhong Lei walked over curiously and patted Fang Heng’s shoulder.
“No, nothing. ” Fang Heng came back to his senses and handed the information he had just received to Zhong Lei for everyone to take a look.
“This... ” Everyone looked at each other after reading the contents of the note.
Was what was written on it real? A curse? Was it not just a joke?
With little information about the main storyline, the trio reacted differently from Fang Heng and thought it was a joke at first glance.

“I have a theory. ” Fang Heng pursed his lips and roughly sorted out his thoughts, then said in a deep voice, “The Plan Scorpio experiment was a special experiment used to study children with superpowers in the early operations of Meteorite Company. From the diary we obtained previously, we know that Hila Rui Qi was a powerful spiritual energy user. After that, the Hila experiment of Meteorite Company was named after Hila. I think that the company did research on Hila. Although I have no concrete evidence, if I had to guess... ”

As Fang Heng spoke, his eyes swept over everyone. “I think it’s the first-generation virus. Judging from the mutant worm body that was extracted from the Hila tissue sample and the mutant worm body found in the first-generation meteorite... The combination of a human with spiritual energy and the first-generation virus extracted from the first-generation meteorite may have caused Hila to develop an even more powerful special ability, and then something else happened. Maybe it’s related to the curse... ”
If it really was a curse, perhaps Meteorite Company felt fear, so they took apart Hila’s corpse and hid it in every corner of the world. That theory seemed to make sense.
His speculation ended there. As Fang Heng paused to think, he suddenly realized a very contradictory point.
From the timeline, the Hila experiment happened a few years before the zombie outbreak. Meteorite Company had already scattered Hila’s corpse in every corner of the world.

Theoretically, if the curse existed, then the zombie outbreak should have happened a long time ago. Why did the Blood Moon and the apocalypse only happen a few years after Hila’s death? Something was wrong!
While he was thinking, a hint flashed in front of Fang Heng’s eyes.
“Hint: player Fang Heng has tried to partially restore the truth to the game’s main storyline. Player team has completed the final stage ring mission: Wallace’s Secret. ”
“Hint: totaling contribution points. You have obtained 87,000 survival points. ”
“Hint: player has partially uncovered the hidden ending. Additional 5,000 main storyline contribution points have been awarded. Please continue exploring. ”
Vera and the others were stunned.
What the hell! Fang Heng was right?

Fang Heng’s guess was partially acknowledged by the game. They had also received hints about having completed the ring mission and partially uncovering the hidden ending. Additionally, they received more than 2,000 survival points and 100 main storyline contribution points.
It was indeed surprising that they could actually trigger the hidden ending message.
But...
After being surprised, Yi Qi and the others felt their heads throb.

They had spent more than half a month and risked their lives to find research materials in the nursing home to exchange for game points, not to achieve a hidden ending and 100 main storyline contribution points.

“With these rewards, are we supposed to fight with the Federation for the ownership of the main storyline? And what’s the use of these two disgusting pieces of flesh? ” The more Yuan Bin thought about it, the more unhappy he felt.
Meanwhile, Zhong Lei’s heart skipped a beat. He clearly noticed how Fang Heng had omitted to mention the 12 boxes hidden by Meteorite Company all over the world.

Zhong Lei quickly exchanged glances with Fang Heng before uttering, “Everyone, these three cultivation pods and the things inside are very important to us. I will spend my points to buy all of them. Please help me out and don’t reveal what happened today. As for the points, I will give you a satisfactory number. Please pardon us for hiding this. Actually, we are from Leftway Gaming Guild. We came all the way here to pursue a mission. The cultivation pod is our final mission target. Thank you for your cooperation and help along the way. ”
Eh? ! Was the cultivation pod important enough to warrant heavy spending?
Hearing Zhong Lei’s words, Yuan Bin instantly felt as if he had returned to heaven from hell. Not only did he not work for nothing, but he could also earn a large sum of money.
“Really? You are willing to spend money to buy these lousy things? ” he asked.
Vera secretly tugged at Yuan Bin and glared at him, thinking, “How can he say things unfiltered? ! ”
“No, they aren’t trash. ” Zhong Lei shook his head. He knew some things about the Hila tissue. The terrifying fusion Tyrant form was created using it.
“We’ll explain the relevant issues after we go out. The price will definitely satisfy you. It’s still too dangerous to talk here. Let’s go first. ”
“Yes, yes, yes. It’s dangerous here. Let’s talk outside, ” Yuan Bin immediately responded.
Everyone locked the door and made their way out of the nursing home. Along the way, the group did not encounter any danger.
However, Fang Heng’s internal confusion was still not relieved.
One step at a time!
Fang Heng patted his cheek.
Next, he had to think of a way to transport the Hila tissues back to the Scavenger Army headquarter and thoroughly search the entire nursing home to see if there were any new clues.

Meanwhile, Zhong Lei’s heart skipped a beat.
He clearly noticed how Fang Heng had omitted to mention the 12 boxes hidden by Meteorite Company all over the world.
Zhong Lei quickly exchanged glances with Fang Heng before uttering, “Everyone, these three cultivation pods and the things inside are very important to us.
I will spend my points to buy all of them.
Please help me out and don’t reveal what happened today.
As for the points, I will give you a satisfactory number.
Please pardon us for hiding this.
Actually, we are from Leftway Gaming Guild.
We came all the way here to pursue a mission.
The cultivation pod is our final mission target.
Thank you for your cooperation and help along the way. ”
Eh? !
Was the cultivation pod important enough to warrant heavy spending?
Hearing Zhong Lei’s words, Yuan Bin instantly felt as if he had returned to heaven from hell.
Not only did he not work for nothing, but he could also earn a large sum of money.
“Really?
You are willing to spend money to buy these lousy things? ” he asked.
Vera secretly tugged at Yuan Bin and glared at him, thinking, “How can he say things unfiltered? ! ”
“No, they aren’t trash. ” Zhong Lei shook his head.
He knew some things about the Hila tissue.
The terrifying fusion Tyrant form was created using it.
“We’ll explain the relevant issues after we go out.
The price will definitely satisfy you.
It’s still too dangerous to talk here.
Let’s go first. ”
“Yes, yes, yes.
It’s dangerous here.
Let’s talk outside, ” Yuan Bin immediately responded.
Everyone locked the door and made their way out of the nursing home.
Along the way, the group did not encounter any danger.
However, Fang Heng’s internal confusion was still not relieved.
One step at a time!
Fang Heng patted his cheek.
Next, he had to think of a way to transport the Hila tissues back to the Scavenger Army headquarter and thoroughly search the entire nursing home to see if there were any new clues.

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - Continuation
paragraphs: Seven hours later.
Zhong Lei made a round trip to the main base and rushed over with Dr. Ding Min and two other NPC survivors.

Ding Min was wearing a white down jacket, and almost half of her face was wrapped in a thick scarf. Her cheeks were slightly red from the cold. “I remember someone said that I would have a holiday today. ”
Fang Heng knew that he was in the wrong and smiled apologetically. “I’m sorry, I’m sorry. This is a special situation. I’ll make up for it tomorrow... Oh, no, the day after tomorrow. ”
“Hmph. Men. ” Ding Min snorted lightly, looked up at the shabby nursing home in front of her, and began to work.
“The Hila tissue sample was hidden in this place? ”
“Yes, I’ll take you there. ”
During the seven hours, Fang Heng had patiently searched the nursing home again.
Other than Wallace and Frege, there were two other humans with special abilities in the nursing home.
However, their abilities were very average and much weaker than Frege’s.
Fang Heng had tried to communicate with them but to no avail.
When the other party realized that they could not win, they directly self-destructed.
Other than that, Fang Heng did not find any other valuable clues.
Ding Min and the others followed Fang Heng back to the secret research room in the third basement.
“Eh? ” Ding Min uttered. She walked forward and carefully observed the pieces of flesh floating in the cultivation pods.
“How is it? Is there a problem with it? ”
“Yes, the live samples show traces of cultivation interference. The degree of activity is not as high as imagined. Optimistically, they can complete the transformation of two fusion Tyrant forms. ”
Ding Min began to drain the liquid in the cultivation pods, trying to put the Hila tissue samples into the metal box made by Meteorite Company.

Fang Heng cheered on the inside, “The findings are still considered good. I obtained at least two fusion Tyrant forms, and the production speed of the mutated worm body liquid mixture will be even faster in the future. ”
However, the mission line of Plan Scorpio seemed to have halted progress. It was a bit troublesome.
Thinking about it, Fang Heng raised his head and asked, “By the way, why do you think the Hila tissue sample is here? Could it be Meterorite Company’s doing? ”

Confusion briefly showed on Ding Min’s face, and she continued her investigation. “I also think it’s very strange. What I can confirm is that she was transplanted here a long time ago. As for whether it was done by Meteorite Company, I can’t be sure. ”
“Then, do you know of Meteorite Company’s Plan Scorpio? ”

“I’ve never heard of it. ” Ding Min’s expression was calm. “Meteorite Company is the largest scientific research company in the world. They have thousands of scientific research projects every year. Many of them have extremely high confidentiality, and even the Presidential Security Bureau doesn’t know about them. ”
Helpless, Fang Heng turned to look at Zhong Lei. “What intel do you have? ”

“I used the names of Wallace and Frege to search for relevant information in District 7’s paid database, and I got some information. Some newspapers reported that Wallace was detected to have superpowers and was involved in a superpowers training program of Meteorite Company. The specific name of the program is unknown. It’s probably Meteorite Company’s Plan Scorpio. ”

Zhong Lei continued, “After that, due to some special reasons, the research room was closed, and they were transferred to another research institute of Meteorite Company. I suspect that it’s related to the development of the first-generation virus. ”
Fang Heng scratched his head. The information provided by Zhong Lei was almost useless.

“If only we had been more careful and not have gotten entangled with the monsters on the fourth basement... ” Zhong Lei sighed, feeling a little guilty. It was not easy to find a big clue, but he had accidentally messed it up.
He felt that the game’s main storyline was once again at a dead end.
All the relevant personnel had died, and the relevant information had been destroyed.
What other leads did they have to work on?
“Fang Heng, what should we do? Can we no longer progress on the mission line of Plan Scorpio? ”
“No, not all hope is lost. ” Fang Heng felt that no one could give a definite answer to the question. Taking a deep breath and self-raising his morale high, he stated, “There’s still a way. ”
“Oh? There’s a way? ” Zhong Lei instantly became spirited and asked, “What’s the way? ”
In a short moment, Fang Heng thought of a plan. He calmly said, “Simple. Go to District 8. ”

Fang Heng mused, “That’s right! Let’s start again! If the storyline in District 7’s busted, we can go to District 8 to make progress! In theory, District 8 should have a similar building built by Meteorite Company for the purpose of researching Plan Scorpio. With our previous experience, we now know to be more careful when entering the nursing home in District 8. For safety reasons and to protect the research materials, we should lure out those research subjects that use spiritual energy before killing them. ”
Fang Heng rubbed his chin and thought about his next plan of action.
“T-That works? ” Zhong Lei moved his lips and did not speak for a long time after.
“Is that a game bug? ”
“Sir, this is a reply letter we received from our superiors. ”
“Give it to me! ” Kou Huai opened the reply letter and quickly read it.
Thud!
After reading the contents of the file, Kou Huai raised his fist and hammered the table hard.
His application to his superiors for Fang Heng to be listed as a Tier 1 wanted person and part of the anti-federation forces was once again rejected!
The reason was that there was not enough evidence. He needed more concrete evidence, preferably video evidence.

“What more evidence do they need? ! Everyone knows that Fang Heng is leader of the Scavenger Army in District 7 and part of the anti-federation forces! He’s obviously the mastermind behind it all! I even died at the hands of the fusion Tyrant form. Things are as plain as day, but they’re turning a blind eye to it? ” Kou Huai thought.
He knew that North River Heavy Industry had a hand in his application having been rejected time and time again.
“Substantial evidence... ” Kou Huai gritted his teeth.
After the failure of the attack on the Scavenger Army, the entire District 7’s federal forces were greatly weakened.
What should they do? Anger was useless.
Kou Huai quickly adjusted his emotional state and suppressed the anger in his heart. He began to think about how to deal with the crisis in front of him.
Presently, District 7 was unable to deal with the crazed zombie team.
No matter how hard he racked his brain, he could not think of a solution.
He could only choose to delay any countermeasures.
But if it continued dragging on...
Amid his distress, Kou Huai suddenly narrowed his eyes, raised his head, and looked at the Signal Corps soldier in front of him. “Who are you? ”
In front of him, the soldier’s face gradually distorted into a round face.
“Hi, Kou Huai. It’s been a while. It seems that you are enjoying yourself. ”
“Ji Qiubei! ” Kou Huai stared at him.

The real leader of the Night Owl organization rarely showed his face. In the real world, Ji Qiubei, with his special talent, had largely become the representative of the leader of the Night Owl organization.
“Don’t be nervous. I just want to talk to you. That’s all. ”
“Okay, let’s talk. ” Kou Huai’s hand was already on the alarm under the desk.

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - Investigation
paragraphs: “I can tell from your expression. The situation in District 7 doesn’t seem too good, right? ”
“What do you want to say? ”
“Of course, to offer cooperation. ”

Ji Qiubei’s round face didn’t seem aggressive at all, “To put it simply, we will help you get rid of Fang Heng. Of course, in order to help you, we need to set up a space stabilizing device in District 7. This is to help you and not for self-interest. You understand, right? ”
Kou Huai frowned. “This doesn’t conform to the rules. ”
Pfft.
Ji Qiubei covered his mouth and almost laughed out loud. “You look so funny when you are talking in shock. Who are we? Is there a need to be so pretentious? ”
Kou Huai stared at Ji Qiubei without saying a word.

“That’s enough. I don’t know about others, but you have sacrificed so much for the Federation. In the end? Just for this rigid rule, are you willing to watch District 7 fall into Fang Heng’s hands? ” Ji Qiubei moved closer and stared at Kou Huai. “Fang Heng doesn’t want District 7 at all. He only wants to destroy District 7, and you don’t care about the Federation. You only want District 7, right? ”
Kou Huai clenched his fists tightly.

“Don’t worry. After you’ve obtained the world, you’ll have the power in your hands. Based on the current advanced world game situation, the Federation won’t blame you for these things. They’ll only try their best to rope you in. Yes, just like Fang Heng. Let alone killing you once, even if he wiped out the entire District 7, there will still be a large number of idiots in the Federation who are afraid of death and will seek peace with Fang Heng. ”
As he spoke of the Federation, Ji Qiubei’s face was filled with disdain.
“The winner takes all. This has always been the case since ancient times. If you think about it carefully, you should know better than me. ”
Kou Huai took a deep breath.

“Don’t think about it. You already had a premonition, right? You will fail. You will be completely defeated by Fang Heng. After you fail, you will be abandoned by the Federation like a dog. You will have nothing all the same. My suggestion is very good. Why don’t you consider it? ”
Kou Huai raised his head. “No, I refuse. ”
“Hahahaha! Kou Huai! “Ji Qiubei laughed loudly. “I really didn’t expect that you would actually be so loyal to the Federation. However, I am willing to wait. ”
“There is no need to wait. I will not cooperate with Night Owl. ”
“Tsk, tsk, tsk, don’t lie to yourself. Why haven’t you pressed the alarm yet? ”
In the blink of an eye, Ji Qiubei’s face returned to that of a Signal Corps soldier.
“I get it. You think you haven’t reached a dead end yet, right? It doesn’t matter. I can give you time. You can see yourself as a smart person for now, but you will eventually understand. ”
Kou Huai watched Ji Qiubei leave and leaned back in his chair.
His back was already soaked in sweat.
Late at night, in District 8.
Fang Heng returned to the prison headquarters through the large-scale space tearing device.
“Hint: you have returned to District 8. ”
“Hint: you have triggered the ending of District 8’s main storyline, Beautiful New World (click here to see the details) . ”

“Hint: there are eight hours left. The ranking of the main storyline contribution points leaderboard rankings in District 8 will be announced to the public soon. You can choose to spend an additional 100 main storyline contribution points to extend the announcement time by 24 hours. ”
“Hint: each time the announcement time is extended by 24 hours, the main storyline contribution points consumed will be double that of the previous announcement time. ”
“So this is the beginning of the debt collection... ”
Fang Heng took a deep breath in a low voice. He endured the pain and spent 300 main storyline contribution points extending the period for two days.
“Fang Heng, how do you feel? ”
Victor had brought some men to guard the teleportation passage in advance, preparing to repair the space tearing device. He noticed that Fang Heng’s expression was not too good.
“It’s not a big problem. It’s just a little heartache. ”
“Huh? ” Victor had a puzzled look on his face.

“Fang Heng, where’s the research materials? ” Qiu Yaokang came up with two researchers and interrupted their conversation. He stared at Fang Heng with a burning gaze. “I heard that the research in the parallel world was a great success. What’s the specific situation? What about the relevant research materials? Did you bring them back? ”
“Yes, the anti-virus vaccine produced a violent mutation after it was released. This is the live sample I brought back. ”
Fang Heng gave a rough explanation. He took out from his backpack the large metal box containing the live samples and handed them to Qiu Yaokang.
“Okay... ” Qiu Yaokang opened the box.
He saw rows of carefully labeled live sample collectors inside and nodded indiscernibly. “Well done. ”

“I’ll give you the research report in two hours, ” said Fang Heng. He had brought Ding Min’s report back to the real world in advance. He planned to use the warp backpack slot to transport materials back and forth.
After all, it was too troublesome to set up inter-server teleportation.
Fang Heng previously did not dare to bring the sample back to the real world, fearing he would accidentally spread the zombie virus in the real world.
When that time came, the Federation might really come after him.
“Hint: player has submitted 134 live samples to the shelter, triggering the new research project: Upgraded Anti-Virus Vaccine. Current project level: level 1. Current project progress: 0%. ”
“Okay, I’ll start developing the vaccine first. ” Qiu Yaokang nodded at Fang Heng, closed the big box, and turned to leave, looking very cold.
“Hey! Fang Heng! ” Mo Jiawei called out and walked over from the side.
As soon as he received the news about Plan Scorpio project the previous night, he immediately took action and gathered information about the project in District 7.

“It’s a headache. I can’t find any clues related to Plan Scorpio. I’ve sent people to investigate several times, and I’ve even spent money to hire several professional teams to ask for information, but I still can’t find any useful information. ”

Fang Heng’s heart sank as he mused, “District 8 hasn’t been opened long enough, and the missions related to the Plan Scorpio haven’t been triggered by any players, huh... The plan was perfect, but it’s a failure from the first step. ”

“I’ve already hired several small player teams to investigate, and there will be feedback every day. I’ve asked them to focus on investigating children with special abilities and the charities and orphanages under Meteorite Company... ” As he spoke, Mo Jiawei yawned. “I can’t do it, Fang Heng. I can’t hold on any longer. I’m going to sleep. ”
“Wait a moment. ” Fang Heng grabbed Mo Jiawei.
It would take too much time just to investigate. Every day he dragged on meant consuming a large amount of main storyline contribution points.
Fang Heng thought that he had to try metaphysics. “There’s something else I need your help with. It’ll be quick. ”
“Eh, what? ”
Fang Heng pulled Mo Jiawei to the side and opened the map of Zombie Apocalypse’s District 8. “Come, just randomly pick a location. ”
Mo Jiawei was stunned for a moment before he reacted. “Really, bro? You’re still playing around? This has nothing to do with luck. Let’s not play metaphysics. ”

“You’re the one who’s playing around. Zombie Apocalypse already has superpowers. Metaphysics should also be a type of superpower, right? It’ll probably be useful. ” Fang Heng was serious as he urged, “Hurry up and empty your mind. Just randomly pinpoint a location based on your feelings. The difficult task of saving the world will fall on you! ”
Ha!
Mo Jiawei sighed heavily with a bitter face.
Under Fang Heng’s expectant gaze, Mo Jiawei reached out his finger and circled a few times over the map.

“Okay, I’ll start developing the vaccine first. ” Qiu Yaokang nodded at Fang Heng, closed the big box, and turned to leave, looking very cold.
“Hey!
Fang Heng! ” Mo Jiawei called out and walked over from the side.
As soon as he received the news about Plan Scorpio project the previous night, he immediately took action and gathered information about the project in District 7.
“It’s a headache.
I can’t find any clues related to Plan Scorpio.
I’ve sent people to investigate several times, and I’ve even spent money to hire several professional teams to ask for information, but I still can’t find any useful information. ”
Fang Heng’s heart sank as he mused, “District 8 hasn’t been opened long enough, and the missions related to the Plan Scorpio haven’t been triggered by any players, huh...
The plan was perfect, but it’s a failure from the first step. ”
“I’ve already hired several small player teams to investigate, and there will be feedback every day.
I’ve asked them to focus on investigating children with special abilities and the charities and orphanages under Meteorite Company... ” As he spoke, Mo Jiawei yawned.
“I can’t do it, Fang Heng.
I can’t hold on any longer.
I’m going to sleep. ”
“Wait a moment. ” Fang Heng grabbed Mo Jiawei.
It would take too much time just to investigate.
Every day he dragged on meant consuming a large amount of main storyline contribution points.
Fang Heng thought that he had to try metaphysics.
“There’s something else I need your help with.
It’ll be quick. ”
“Eh, what? ”
Fang Heng pulled Mo Jiawei to the side and opened the map of Zombie Apocalypse’s District 8.
“Come, just randomly pick a location. ”
Mo Jiawei was stunned for a moment before he reacted.
“Really, bro?
You’re still playing around?
This has nothing to do with luck.
Let’s not play metaphysics. ”
“You’re the one who’s playing around.
Zombie Apocalypse already has superpowers.
Metaphysics should also be a type of superpower, right?
It’ll probably be useful. ” Fang Heng was serious as he urged, “Hurry up and empty your mind.
Just randomly pinpoint a location based on your feelings.
The difficult task of saving the world will fall on you! ”
Ha!
Mo Jiawei sighed heavily with a bitter face.
Under Fang Heng’s expectant gaze, Mo Jiawei reached out his finger and circled a few times over the map.

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - Got It
paragraphs: In the end, his finger didn’t fall.
“But I really don’t feel anything... ”
“It’s fine. Just pick one randomly. Just treat it as a lucky draw. Don’t feel pressured. ”
“God, you said it yourself. ” Mo Jiawei swiftly shifted his gaze, pointed at the map, and giggled. “God, I think this place is not bad. ”
“Yeah! I think so too! ” Fang Heng nodded in agreement and looked at the map.
Upon closer look, he mused, “Eh? This place is... the Eastern region? It seems quite near, too... Damn, isn’t this the prison shelter? ! ”
“Are you kidding me? ” Fang Heng looked up again, but Mo Jiawei had already dropped a simple sleeping bag and logged off.
Fang Heng scratched his hair. Things had gotten troublesome.

He had thought that District 8’s Plan Scorpio would be an entry point, but who would have thought that it would be forcefully terminated because the server opening time was too short? Plan Scorpio being out of his reach was unexpected.
“Fang Heng! ” As he was thinking, Fang Heng heard a joyful shout.
When he turned around, he saw Lucia.
Lucia walked quickly to Fang Heng and stood in front of him. She looked at him with a certain kind of expectation in her eyes. “Fang Heng, I missed you. ”
Fang Heng silently opened his arms, in which Lucia passionately threw herself. “What were you whispering to Mo Jiawei just now? ”
“Nothing. It’s work-related. ”
“Oh... Can you bring me to the parallel world next time? ”
“It’s a bit difficult. I don’t think I can bring someone there in a short time... ”
Cough, cough.

David coughed lightly and walked over. “Commander Fang Heng, it’s such a coincidence that you’re here. I just heard that there’s an important breakthrough in vaccine research, so I brought people over to take a look. I think we’re all family now. We can participate in the research together and speed up the research. What do you think of this proposal? ”
Fang Heng understood. David had come over to optimize the improvement of the anti-virus vaccine.
“Sounds good! It’s all to save this world. ” Fang Heng’s answer was righteous.

“Hint: player’s favorability rating with the Dark Knights has reached the minimum requirement. Cooperative Research has been triggered. Currently, the players’ shelter’s research efficiency of the anti-virus vaccine has increased to 230% . ”
Fang Heng glanced at the game hint.
The Dark Knights’ research team was decently capable. With their help, research and development of the anti-virus vaccine would be accelerated.
Perhaps they could also provide some of the materials needed to make the vaccine.
Fang Heng was deep in thought.
“Why don’t I see Dr. Qiu Yaokang? I want to talk to him about the details of the collaboration. Dr. Qiu’s insight of vaccine research is unique and accurate. It’s admirable. ”
They had only exchanged a few sentences, but the other party was already talking about business.
Fang Heng nodded and said, “He just went to the research room. I’ll bring you there. ”
“I hope we can develop an effective vaccine as soon as possible. I feel like this world will soon return to peace. ”

“By the way, can you tell me in detail about what happened in the parallel world? I’m pretty curious about the Dark Knights in that world. How are they doing? I think they should be fighting to save this world. ”
Fang Heng’s face froze as he mused, “They don’t seem to be doing well... ”

Fang Heng hurriedly changed the topic as they walked along the underground passage of the prison. “I observed a strong mutation reaction when I was conducting an anti-virus vaccine experiment in the parallel world. As the vaccine spread, the mutation reaction gradually increased. It has been confirmed that there is a mutation of Tier 5 mutated zombies. ”

He continued, “It will probably be very difficult to spread the vaccine around the world. Moreover, it is very dangerous to spread the vaccine at this stage. I think we need to spend some time to continue optimizing it. We can try to spread it after developing a more stable vaccine version. ”
David nodded in agreement. “Yes, you are right. This world has already suffered too much. We should think of a safer method. ”
With the thought of giving it a try, Fang Heng asked casually, “Oh right, David, have you heard of Plan Scorpio? It seems to be related to Meteorite Company... Huh? ”
The air suddenly froze, and everyone stopped in their tracks at the same time.
Fang Heng, stunned, could not help but turn around.
As David and the Dark Knights all looked at Lucia at the same time, Lucia moved her lips and clenched her fists.
Under everyone’s gaze, Lucia didn’t say a word. She turned around and ran away quickly.
What was going on?
Fang Heng was baffled. He looked at David with a questioning gaze.
David also looked at Fang Heng with a strange gaze. “Fang Heng, you really don’t know? ”
Fang Heng was completely dumbfounded. “Huh? Should I know something? ”

“All right. It seems like you really don’t know. Lucia was once involved in Plan Scorpio. Apparently, something happened when she was a child because she couldn’t control her strength, and her parents died in that accident. I heard from Barker that Lucia has always blamed herself for this. As for the details... ” David sighed. “That’s all we know. ”
Fang Heng was stunned and a pair of scarlet pupils appeared in his mind.

“Lucia’s eyes! They’re exactly the same as the scarlet pupils Wallace had! Fang Heng instantly understood that the trigger point for the Plan Scorpio mission was the Dark Knights, and he felt very fortunate.
If it was in District 7, he would probably never be able to trigger the next main storyline.
“Wait... ” Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat as he mused. “So... Mo Jiawei’s superpower of metaphysics worked once again! ? ”

“Fang Heng, I’ve seen more in life than you have. Whether you accept it or not, I have a suggestion that I feel I must give you... ” David saw Fang Heng deep in thought and asked, “Are you really not going to chase after Lucia? ”
“I almost forgot! ” Fang Heng thought as he came back to his senses again and immediately chased after Lucia.
Over in the prison.
The cold wind that blew against Lucia’s face made her feel better. She sat alone on the bench in the prison square.
When she thought of the things that were buried deep in her memory, Lucia’s eyes couldn’t help but turn red.
She clenched her fists and restrained herself from crying out loud.
Looking up, Lucia saw Fang Heng walking toward her.
“I’m sorry, Fang Heng. I... I didn’t mean to. It was an accident. I... ” Lucia was a little flustered and seemed eager to explain something.
“Yes, of course, I believe you. “Fang Heng sat next to Lucia. “I just found out about Plan Scorpio. It’s actually related to the global outbreak of the zombie virus that we’re investigating. ”
Lucia’s eyes were filled with confusion. “It’s related to the outbreak of the virus? ”
“You might not be comfortable with sharing your past. It’s okay. I just need to... ”

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - One More Time
paragraphs: “No, I’m not. ” Lucia pulled a corner of Fang Heng’s shirt and rested her head on his shoulder. “When I was young, I had a special ability. After that accident, I was brought to my grandparents’ house. Not long after, a psychiatric treatment center came to my grandparents’ house. They told my grandparents that they had the ability to cure my illness and were willing to provide free treatment... ”

She continued, “At the beginning, we didn’t know that it was actually the secret research institute of Meteorite Company. Like other children with special abilities, I was a research subject of Meteorite Company. They think that children like us who have some kind of special ability are extremely special. They call us spiritual energy users. Spiritual energy users usually awaken their strength gradually from the age of three. After that, they will enter a period of trainable growth. When they reach the age of 30, their strength will completely stop growing. From the age of 3 to the age of 12, this period is the best time to train their special abilities. ”

Lucia then uttered, “Actually, it wasn’t as bad as you imagined at the beginning. I met many friends of the same age there, and they encountered all kinds of problems in their lives just like me. In that place, we didn’t have to endure the strange gazes of others like the outside world, and we didn’t have to worry about our own strength being unable to be controlled and causing damage to others. We were actually very happy during that time. ”
Fang Heng mused, “Children’s psychiatric treatment center! That’s right! That should be a place similar to the orphanage in District 7! ”
He felt that he was getting closer and closer to the truth. He asked, “What happened after that? ”

“After that... ” Lucia shook her head. “After that, we were separated, and Plan Scorpio was terminated. It was only after a long period of time that I understood. Meteorite Company discovered that after spiritual energy users came into contact with the G-virus, they were able to have a stronger mutation reaction, and they were able to control the zombie virus more freely. At that time, we were considered by Meteorite Company as the best people for carrying out research projects. ”

“We were sent to Meteorite Company’s research rooms around the world for research on virus fusion. And after that... ” Lucia’s eyes showed resolution. “I found an opportunity and escaped from there. ”
Fang Heng’s eyes narrowed.
He had guessed more than half of it correctly!
Next, as long as they found the orphanage, they would be able to find District 8’s Hila tissues and the few spiritual energy users who had stayed in the orphanage.
From those users, they would be able to obtain the next clue to uncovering the hidden mission line!
“It’s all right, ” Fang Heng comforted Lucia and patted her back gently. “Do you still remember where the psychiatric treatment center was built at that time? ”

“Hmm, I don’t remember most events from my childhood. I don’t know the specific address either. I only know that it’s in the Western region’s ice field area. I can go there with you to look for it. I remember the route there. We’ll definitely be able to find it. ”
“Let’s go and check it out together. ” Fang Heng looked at Lucia. “Are you feeling better? ”
“Yes, I’m fine. We can set off now. ”
“Really? ”
Lucia raised her head, met Fang Heng’s gaze, and gently pecked forward.
Instantly, Fang Heng’s face flushed red.
“Damn it! I’ve been teased by an NPC! ” he mused.

According to the information obtained from Colonel Barker, the orphanage where Lucia and the others were experimented on had been purchased by a relevant member of Meteorite Company and converted into a private manor.

Through the teleportation gates left by the Dark Knights, Fang Heng and Lucia teleported to the ice field area of the Western region, specifically a Dark Knights’ contact point that was the closest to the manor.
The two of them asked for a military truck and followed Lucia’s memories to find the former children’s psychiatric treatment center.
This time, Fang Heng was prepared.
The trailer behind the truck was loaded with a truckload of vine zombies and a few Lickers.
The two of them drove around for a long time until the next morning and stopped outside a manor located halfway up the mountain.
After getting out of the truck, Lucia looked up at the building in front of her. Memories of the past gradually surfaced in her mind.
“Fang Heng, this is the place. I’m very sure that I lived here for a few years when I was young. ”
“It might be dangerous inside. ”
Fang Heng also sized up the manor building in front of him, secretly making plans in his heart.
The previous time, he accidentally destroyed the research data in District 7, causing the follow-up mission to fail. This time, he had to change his plan.

“Lucia, there’s a lot of important information in the secret research room under the manor. Later, I’ll think of a way to lure out the people hidden inside. They should have the information we need. It’s best if we can capture them alive. ”

Fang Heng explained the next step of the battle plan to Lucia, “These people might have been modified by Meteorite Company’s virus and possess extraordinary spiritual energy, but their physical strength is not high. ”
Fang Heng stretched his wrists and arranged the mission tactics, “You stand guard at the door and listen to my instructions. We will try to capture them alive. ”
“Okay, you have to be careful too. ” Lucia set up the sniper rifle and aimed the muzzle at the door.
Fang Heng walked to the door, raised his shotgun with one hand, and fired at the door lock.
Bang!
The door lock was destroyed.
Fang Heng turned back to look at Lucia, then pushed the door open.
This time, Fang Heng deliberately made a lot of noise, trying to attract the people hiding in the manor.
The vine zombies got off the trailer behind the truck, moved their feet, and walked into the building to search.
Fang Heng stood at the entrance of the building and waited quietly.
A row of game hints began to refresh.
“Hint: you have given instructions to the zombie clones to search the building. ”
“Hint: your zombie clone has begun to search the first basement. ”
“Hint: your zombie clone has killed a common mutated zombie (agility) . ”
“Hint: your zombie clone has obtained 1 wheelchair... ”
After waiting for more than ten minutes, Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
“Hint: your vine zombie is dead. ”
They were coming!
Common Tier 1 and Tier 2 mutated zombies could not defeat a vine parasite zombie.
Therefore, the spiritual energy users hiding in the building must have taken action.
Fang Heng strode into the hall and walked in the direction of the mutated zombie’s death.
Soon, Fang Heng saw a familiar figure in the corridor leading to the underground storage room.
It was a young man with long hair.
Swoosh!
The man realized that there was something behind him and turned his head to look at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng was also staring at him.
“Wallace! ”
It was confirmed! Wallace must be a character who had a great influence on the plot, so he existed in both District 7 and District 8!
Wallace was stunned for a moment, obviously very curious as to why the stranger in front of him was able to call out his name.
In the next moment, Wallace’s eyes were filled with killing intent.
“So you guys are just unwilling to let me go, is that it? ! ”

“So you guys are just unwilling to let me go, is that it? ! ”

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - Acquaintances
paragraphs: Fang Heng frowned. He felt that Wallace might have misunderstood something. “No, I just want to talk to you. ”
“Why are you not willing to let us go... ” Wallace stared at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted. He felt a momentary daze in his brain.
When he regained consciousness again, Fang Heng only saw an old iron door spinning in the air and whizzing toward him.
“Hint: you have received a mental attack. ”
“Hint: check passed. You have been affected by the mental attack and have entered a state of mental shock for 0.5 seconds. ”
Fang Heng did not feel anything during the 0.5 seconds. It was as if he had been erased from the world!
Danger was approaching. Fang Heng raised his fist and threw a fierce punch forward.
Bang! !
The iron door was sent flying, and Fang Heng turned around and ran.
It wasn’t that he couldn’t beat Wallace.
It was that Fang Heng was afraid that he would accidentally force Wallace into a corner. When that happened, the latter would go crazy and destroy all the useful information in the manor.
Even though they were all in the first basement, Fang Heng still wanted to play safe.
The confidential information in the manor might be an important piece of the puzzle leading to the truth!
He had to ensure the safety of the information.
“You can’t escape! ” When Wallace saw Fang Heng escape, he gritted his teeth and chased after him.
It was not easy to find such a place to hide. If his hiding spot was exposed...
With that thought, Wallace quickly chased after Fang Heng until he saw Fang Heng run out of the manor gate.
Just as he stepped out of the manor gate, Wallace felt that something was not right.
Eh?
Where was he?
Wallace narrowed his eyes and noticed the reflection of the sniper scope in the distance.
Before Wallace could see clearly, a voice sounded by his ear.
“You’re looking for me? ”
Wallace was stunned, instantly sensing great danger.
Fang Heng, who was hiding at the side, flashed out from beside Wallace, and his huge fist smashed fiercely toward him.
Weng! ! !
A visible spiritual barrier opened up in front of Wallace, whose pupils constricted.
Pa!
A soft sound rang out.
Fang Heng’s fist had smashed against the barrier.
Creak, creak...
The visible spiritual barrier actually caved in, emitting a creaking sound and seeming like it was about to shatter.
Piang!
The visible spiritual barrier smashed like glass. Fang Heng took advantage of the situation to smash Wallace’s face, sending him flying toward the other side of the manor main gate.
Fang Heng’s heart was extremely calm as he observed Wallace’s every move.
Following that, the enraged Wallace would most likely use Tier 2 control skills that ignored defense!
After landing on the ground, Wallace propped himself up with one hand and stood up shakily. He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth.
As expected, he wasn’t dead yet!
Fang Heng was already prepared. With a flip of his wrist, the vampiric spirit cane appeared in his hand.
“Lucia! Do it! ” Fang Heng shouted and knocked the vampiric spirit cane hard on the ground.
A red light spread out in all directions with the spirit cane as the center, enveloping Wallace almost instantly.
Wallace was stunned. He felt that all of his abilities could not be controlled and awakened in an instant.
Everything was in Fang Heng’s plan!
Three seconds was enough to complete the plan!
Just as Fang Heng had planned in advance, he used the silence skill to prevent Wallace from using control skills. Then, Lucia would shoot Wallace with a tranquilizer gun!
After knocking Wallace out, Fang Heng would pack him up and bring him back to the research institute for Qiu Yaokang to study!
However, the plan did not proceed as Fang Heng had expected.
He did not hear the sound of Lucia firing the tranquilizer gun.
“Oh no! Lucia might be in trouble! ” Fang Heng’s heart sank as he thought.
His back was facing Lucia, so he was unable to determine Lucia’s condition.
Then, it was time for plan B!
Fang Heng immediately controlled the four Lickers hidden in the surroundings to pounce on Wallace.
Wallace was not as crazy as he had imagined. He did not make any moves to dodge or counterattack. Instead, he looked behind Fang Heng in surprise.
“Lucia? ”
Then, Fang Heng heard Lucia’s surprised voice. “Wallace? Is It really you? ”
Fang Heng was stunned.
What was going on? Did they know each other?
A look of joy appeared on Wallace’s face. “Lucia, it’s great to see you again... ”
As he said that, Wallace fell backward.
Bang...
Wallace fell heavily to the ground and fainted.
Fang Heng turned around and looked at Lucia behind him in confusion. “You know him? ”

“He’s Wallace. He’s a friend of mine who was being treated with me in the psychiatric treatment center when I was young. I wasn’t sure until he called my name, ” Lucia explained and quickly walked forward to help Wallace up from the ground.
“He probably just fainted. ” She heaved a sigh of relief and took out the treatment spray.
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. “If you know Wallace, do you know Hila? Hila Rui Qi? ”
Lucia opened her mouth and nodded. “I know her. Rui Qi is different from us. She’s the strongest among us. She’s also the oldest one who has stayed in the treatment center for the longest time... ”
In the basement, Wallace looked at Fang Heng with a hint of fear in his eyes.
When he was young, countless people said that he was a monster. But currently, the person in front of him could break his enhanced spiritual defense barrier with one punch.
That guy was the real monster!

“Wallace, why are you here? ” Lucia asked with concern, “I’ve been trying to find you ever since I escaped from Meteorite Company. The government has searched and seized several of Meteorite Company’s secret research bases, but you were not inside when the police went to find you. ”

“Of course they couldn’t find us. We were immediately teleported after the incident. ” Wallace recalled the situation at that time and said with a wry smile, “It wasn’t until the zombie apocalypse that Meteorite Company was completely destroyed and I escaped from them. ”

He continued, “I don’t have any other relatives. I didn’t know where to stay during the zombie apocalypse, so I thought of this place. I thought that the other companions who escaped might also come back here, and my guess was right. I found Tang Bai here. ”
Tang Bai looked very young. He hid in a corner, curled up, and looked at Fang Heng with fear.

“Don’t mind him. Tang Bai is a bit autistic. ” Wallace explained, “After the disaster broke out, Tang Bai escaped from the research institute and has been hiding here. After we found Tang Bai, we decided to stay here temporarily. It took me a lot of effort to fix this place. ”

Wallace scratched his hair in embarrassment and thought of something, “Oh, right, Lucia, I have another piece of good news to tell you. When I left, I found a file in the research institute where I was imprisoned. It recorded the exact location of the research institute where our companions were imprisoned. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - New Main Storyline
paragraphs: “I originally wanted to wait until we settle down before heading out with Tang Bai to look for them. Now that you’re here, we can go together. We’ll soon find Frege and the others. ”
“Really? That’s great. ” Lucia revealed a happy expression. “We can go look for them together. ”
Fang Heng was stunned. “Wallace, are you saying that you and Tang Bai are the only two people in the shelter? ”
“Yes, just the two of us. ”
Fang Heng opened his mouth and understood.
The timeline of District 8 was more than ten years earlier than the timeline of District 7.
The zombie apocalypse had just happened, and Wallace had just returned to the manor. He still hadn’t found his companions and the Hila tissue sample!
In other words, the entire mission line of the Hila tissue sample had yet to be triggered!
Fang Heng pressed on, “In the materials that you retrieved from the research institute, was Hila Rui Qi’s location included? ”
“Yeah, Rui Qi is in there too. ”
A line of game hints popped up in Fang Heng’s vision.
“Hint: player has triggered the main storyline Hila Rui Qi. ”
Mission name: Hila Rui Qi.
Mission difficulty: S
Mission description: you have learned about the story of Wallace. Please follow Wallace to find Hila Rui Qi.
Mission requirements: find the research institute where Hila is at. Find the missing Hila Rui Qi.

“Great! I have to take the initiative to search for the mission, ” Fang Heng thought to himself. “On the bright side, District 7’s Wallace was able to find the Hila tissue sample by himself. The mission difficulty shouldn’t be too high. With this mission, I’ll also be able to find more clues related to the Hila experiment. I might be able to earn more main storyline contribution points, too. But time isn’t on my side. After two days, it’ll cost 400 main storyline contribution points in order to delay the announcement for another 24 hours. I can’t afford that. ”
Fang Heng looked at Wallace. “Wallace, are you feeling better? Time is limited. I suggest that we set off immediately to look for Rui Qii. ”
“Now? So soon? ”
The sky gradually darkened.
Recently, the Federation of District 7 was having a very difficult time.
That was especially so for the federal shelter in the Songxi Mountain area.
The large number of high-tier zombie creatures that had previously been left behind in the Edge Creek Town region were still roaming about there.
As the ones closest to Edge Creek Town, the federal shelter had been dealing with the large group of high-tier zombies that came out of Edge Creek Town almost 24 hours a day.
Apart from the zombie group, there was also the mutant worm bodies that appeared from time to time.
“Sir, the latest file from superiors! Please review it. ”
“Give it to me. ” Liang Hucheng took the file from his subordinate and opened it to read it carefully.

He mused, “Strange! He immediately started to prepare to build a space tearing teleportation stabilizing device in District 7? Is it to deal with the Scavenger Army? Kou Huai persuaded the Federation’s upper echelons to make use of the strength of other game worlds to make a move against District 7, and the Federal Central Assembly actually agreed? ” Liang Hucheng’s brows were tightly knitted.
He had heard some rumors.

In recent years, the Federation’s influence in advanced game worlds had suffered repeated setbacks, and resources were extremely tight. Normally, they would not waste their limited resources on low-tier game worlds.
“Make the arrangements. Immediately prepare the needed materials according to the list given by superiors. ”
“Understood! ! ”
It was close to midnight.
Fang Heng and his group of four others took a helicopter and hovered in the sky above Haimu City.
Haimu City used to have the most prosperous economy and advanced scientific research in the entire Western region.
After the outbreak of the zombie virus, the place had since long been reduced to ruins.
The densely packed zombie team crowded the street.
Wallace and Tang Bai looked at the scene of the zombie rampage from the helicopter, their faces slightly pale.
Fang Heng also felt his head throb. It was as if he had sabotaged himself.
Because of the anti-virus vaccine, a large number of high-tier zombies resurrected and formed a giant-sized zombie wave.

His zombie clones temporarily stayed in District 7 to cooperate with the Scavenger Army to resist the aftermath of the zombie wave that had wandered out of Edge Creek Town. He was unable to help District 8.
Considering the large number of zombies in Haimu City of District 8 and the fact that it was an S-level main storyline mission, he had to put in substantial effort.
Without his cheat key, Fang Heng didn’t think that his team alone could complete the mission in a short time.
For safety reasons, Fang Heng still thought of a solution.

Through the authority of the deputy commander of the Dark Knights, Fang Heng directly announced the highest level of operations within the Dark Knights and pulled 20 elite teams over to carry out the mission.
Fang Heng had always thought that he was very good at coordinating human wave attacks.
The only trouble was that he had used up a large amount of Dark Knights contribution points.
The walkie-talkie kept transmitting the feedback from the various combat squads.
“Reporting to Commander! Squad One has arrived at the specific location. Landing completed. Clearing the landing platform of zombies... ”
“Squad Three has arrived at the predetermined location. Landing in progress. ”
“Squad Seven has completed landing. Setting up the communication tower. ”
“Squad Two has arrived and is trying to land according to the plan. ”
“Squad Twelfth is expected to arrive in two minutes... ”

Fang Heng took out his walkie-talkie and said in a deep voice, “Colonel Barker, you will be in charge of the whole operation. My team and I will invade from the roof. We will meet up in the central research room. By the way, tell the others to be careful when searching for the materials. Try not to damage them. ”
“Understood! ”
“Start the operation! ”
“Yes! ”
Mo Jiawei shrunk his neck in panic. The plane crash that happened when he went to Pine City with Fang Heng was still vivid in his mind.
Who would have thought that in just a month, Fang Heng had become the highest-ranking commander of the operation?
“Hey, guys, we’re here! ” The pilot waved to the back and dropped a rope down.
Using the rope, Fang Heng and the other four landed on top of a building in the city.
Gunshots were heard.
The few of them cooperated and quickly took care of the few wandering zombies gathered on the roof of the research institute.

After coming all the way here and seeing the scene of zombies rampaging in Haimu City, Wallace had a premonition. He raised his head and asked, “Fang Heng, Rui Qi has probably left this place, right? ”
“Maybe partially... ” Fang Heng mused. He didn’t tell Wallace and the others about the Hila tissue sample in advance.
In District 7, it had been confirmed that Hila had been dead for several years.
No, to be precise, Hila didn’t die. Her cells were still alive.
She had just been taken apart for several years.
“Maybe. There are still a lot of experimental data in this place. These data are very useful to us. Maybe we can find out where Rui Qi went through them. ”
“Okay. ”

“Don’t think too much. Focus. ” Fang Heng nodded. He took out his machete from his backpack and swallowed a bottle of powerful anti-infection potion. Then, he continued, “For our next part of the plan, to put it simply, we’ll rashly go in and find a way to infiltrate the central research room and find information related to Hila. Then, immediately evacuate. ”

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - Confusion
paragraphs: In Meteorite Company’s advanced research institute in Haimu City, Entrance C.
Xiao Jing and Xu bin descended from the helicopter one after the other through the rope ladder.
The two of them looked at each other.
Until now, the two of them still did not understand the situation.
In the early morning, the two of them suddenly received an emergency gathering mission from the Dark Knights.
Upon closer inspection, it was actually related to the main storyline quest? !
The two of them were immediately dumbfounded.
Hadn’t the main storyline of District 8 been interrupted by the Night Owl organization a long time ago? Could it be that they had made some new discoveries?
Ever since the first-generation meteorite was destroyed, the players deployed by the Federation and hidden within the Dark Knights had stopped taking action.
In any case, the main storyline progress was also frozen, so they should just do whatever they were supposed to do.
However, who would have thought that in the middle of the night, the Dark Knights would suddenly launch such an emergency operation?
A total of 20 elite team members had been dispatched, and the scale of the operation was even larger than the previous operation in Pine City.
After receiving the news, the Federation’s headquarters in District 8 was also dumbfounded.
The incident had happened so suddenly that the command post immediately asked Xiao Jing and Xu Bin to join the mission to investigate.
When they were in the helicopter, Xiao Jing also tried to ask the Dark Knights’ NPC team leader.
Unfortunately, his honor was too low, so the team leader ignored him.

“Now, let’s announce the mission plan. We are now at the Meteorite Company’s advanced research institute in Haimu City. Our mission is to seal and clean up the research institute’s Entrance C, and then invade the research institute from Entrance C to carefully search for the research materials. Do you understand? ! ”
“Yes! ! ”
The 9th elite team received the order and immediately rushed to the right side of the research institute.
“Xu Bin, do you feel that the voice coming from the communication station is a bit familiar? ”
“Huh? Is it? ” Xu Bin patted Xiao Jing’s shoulder. “You heard wrong. I heard that he has gone missing. There are also rumors that he was kidnapped by Night Owl. ”
“So you also think that it sounds like his voice, right? ”
Xu Bin curled his lips. “Don’t think too much. Work seriously. This mission is related to the main storyline. We must do our best to ensure that we can join the main storyline mission chain. ”

“Yes, I understand. ” Xiao Jing nodded. He was in high spirits and said, “This operation is so sudden. Night Owl probably won’t know in advance. It will most likely be smoother than the previous operation in Pine City. ”
Everything was as Xiao Jing had expected. The movement of the Dark Knights was unusually smooth!
The Dark Knights only used less than half an hour to control all the entrances and exits of the central research room.
The squads invaded the research institute and thoroughly cleaned up the zombies inside, collecting all kinds of research materials.
In order to complete the main storyline, Xu Bin and Xiao Jing worked hard. They did their best to kill zombies and earn points along the way, and they were praised by the team leader.
They even relied on Xu Bin’s special skills to find the hidden blueprint. They even found the access card to the secret research room!
They went around to the central research room and found a sturdy alloy door in place.
Xu Bin and Xiao Jing found a way to find the spare battery pack from the reserve materials warehouse. They brought the battery pack back to the second basement to repair the power supply.
After almost an hour, the two of them finally completed the installation of the battery pack with the help of the elite Dark Knights and returned to the secret research room.
“Well done! ” Colonel Barker nodded in approval.
Xu Bin and Xiao Jing stood at the side obediently, waiting for the hint of the mission.
Barker turned on the walkie-talkie. “Commander Fang Heng, the power supply of the underground secret research room has been restored. You can come down now. ”

“Huh? ” Hearing what Barker said, Xu Bin and Xiao Jing were stunned. Then, they looked at each other at the same time and quickly communicated with their eyes. “He said Fang Heng, right? Did I hear wrong? ”
Ding.
The elevator door opened. Fang Heng and the others walked out of the elevator and walked straight to the entrance of the secret research room through the passage.
Xu Bin looked at the people who walked out of the elevator and was stunned for a moment. He shouted in disbelief, “Fang Heng? ! ”
Fang Heng looked at Xu Bin and Xiao Jing, a little stunned as well.
“That’s right! The two old acquaintances from the operation in Pine City! The two of them can barely be considered elite Dark Knights, ” he mused.
Time was too tight, and Fang Heng had contacted Dark Knights to carry out the operation plan while forgetting that they still had players from the Federation.
Several thoughts flashed through Fang Heng’s mind.

“Forget it. It’s outside of the plan, but it wouldn’t have much of an impact. My main storyline contribution points can only last for another four days at most. When the contribution points leaderboard rankings of District 8 are released, it will be revealed that my contribution points are far ahead. The Federation would then most likely be able to deduce that I have the means to open a Tier 2 dimensional door.

Currently, since the other party still didn’t have enough information, he might be able to influence the judgment of Kou Huai from District 7 and make Kou Huai mistakenly think that he was returning to District 8.
Thinking of that, Fang Heng smiled and greeted the two of them, “It’s you two. Thank you for your hard work. It’s so late at night. ”
“This... ” Xu Bin and Xiao Jing stood awkwardly on the spot, not knowing how to answer for a moment.
Was it really Fang Heng?
Wasn’t it rumored that he had gone missing?

There were also people who said that he had become the leader of the Scavenger Army and was part of the anti-federation forces in District 7, causing havoc in the game and turning District 7 into a mess.
When did he return to District 8?
And he even became the deputy commander of the Dark Knights? !
Why? Why were they only at the private rank?
So Fang Heng had transferred back to District 8?
Putting everything else aside, how did he manage to raise his reputation points in the Dark Knights to such a high level in such a short time?
Could it be...
As they thought about it, the two of them simultaneously shifted their gazes to Lucia who was next to Fang Heng.
By living off a woman?
It couldn’t be that. Barker was only a colonel.
It wasn’t the right time to ask. Although he was full of doubts, Xu Bin noticed Colonel Barker’s gaze and nudged Xiao Jing. “Hurry up and open the door. ”
“Oh, okay. ”
Xiao Jing came to his senses and walked forward. He swiped the magnetic card he had collected on the door sensor.
“Verification successful. The system is rebooting... ”
Ka...
After the verification was completed, the metal door was unlocked.
Xiao Jing pushed the door open. Before he could take a step, he heard Fang Heng say sternly, “Wait! Don’t go in yet! ”
Xiao Jing quivered and immediately retreated.
Then, everyone heard a dense sizzling sound coming from the door.
Behind them, the elite Dark Knights immediately raised their weapons and aimed at the entrance.
Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle...
In the blink of an eye, a large group of Lickers pounced out from inside the room!
“Fire! ”
The elite Dark Knights immediately aimed at the Lickers and pulled the trigger.
With the continuous firing, the Lickers that rushed out of the door crazily fell one after another at the narrow entrance.
