chapters.title: Chapter 483 - Private Diary
paragraphs: The gunfire continued for a full five minutes until the Lickers in the room no longer appeared. Only then did Fang Heng put away his guns and carefully stepped into the room to investigate.
“Buzz...”
Automatic sensor lights lit up, illuminating the entire hall.
Many elite Dark Knights filed in and began to raise their guns to clean up the remaining Lickers in the secret research hall.
After a while, the gunshots stopped.
Colonel Barker nodded and said, “It’s confirmed that it’s safe!”
Fang Heng looked around the secret research hall and observed.
The first thing he saw was a thick book placed next to the main control platform.
Fang Heng picked up the book on the table.
Found it! Private diary!
[Hint: Player obtained item-Ken’s private diary.]

Through Dr. Kailin’s recommendation, I was promoted to become a member of the secret research team for the first-generation virus. I will be in the research team to deeply study the fusion of virus and spiritual energy users.
Through fusion, I believe that we can unlock the secret of eternal life.
Hila Rui Qi.
After hundreds of experiments, I am sure that we have found the perfect experimental subject.
Her cell tissue has extraordinary strength, can perfectly withstand the virus body erosion and even fusion of the first-generation virus.
She is so perfect...
Rui Qi and I fell in love.
She is innocent, kind-hearted and she looks really good when she smiles.
Despite the pain of the experiment, she still does her best to cooperate.
Rui Qi and I share the same ideals.
I believe that we can develop a cure for everything so that people will no longer suffer from the pain of illness.
We have the crystallization of love.
We held a wedding and received everyone’s blessings.
I have a career and also my love.
I am the happiest person in the world.
What on earth is that?
Rui Qi doesn’t know either. She told me that a few months ago, she started having these horrible dreams.
They were happening more and more.
She felt like something was trying to control her brain.
Was it a mutant worm?
During the investigation, we found a mutant worm body in the first-generation meteorite.
That worm body can control humans. It’s extremely dangerous...
I’m a little scared, but I’m trying to be calm, and I don’t want Rui Qi to worry too much.
Last night, Rui Qi had another nightmare.
This is definitely not normal postpartum syndrome.
I heard her shouting ‘Ouroboros’.
What is that thing?
A lot has happened during this time, and Rui Qi’s mental condition is getting worse, and she’s becoming more and more irritable.
The experimental data showed that she was showing signs of losing control.
What should I do?
Too many things had happened in the past three years.
Rui Qi’s loss of control was a foregone conclusion.
As for me...
I’m a waste, and I can’t change this outcome!
Rui Qi told me that she was willing to make sacrifices, and she was willing to respect my choice. If sacrificing her alone could guarantee everyone’s safety...
Eudora was right.
We have to make a decision.
I love her.
Rui Qi went missing.
I should have thought of this earlier!
The day before she went missing, she was already acting strangely. She kept telling me that she was sorry and that I had to take good care of Milia.
I knew that it was Eudora’s doing! What on earth did she do to Rui Qi!
I really want to find Eudora and interrogate her, but I have to take good care of Milia.
What should I do?
Eight years!
I’ve been looking for Rui Qi for eight years.
I finally heard a terrible truth from an old friend.
They actually...
I hate myself for being too weak and unable to protect Rui Qi!
He finally agreed to take me to see Rui Qi.
A part of Rui Qi was placed in the high-level research room of the Meteorite Company in Haimu City.
I’ll disguise myself as an experimental personnel and blend in.
It’s great to be able to see Rui Qi with my own eyes.
Milia can finally see her mother.
I’ll think of a way to save her.
The contents of the diary ended here.
On the last page, a photo fell out of the notebook.
Fang Heng picked up the photo album from the ground and fell into silence again.
On the photo album was a group photo of a family of three. It should be Ken, Hila and their daughter, Milia.
After reading the entire diary, Fang Heng felt his heart stop.
Taking a deep breath, Fang Heng forced himself to calm down and analyze the contents of the diary.
Eudora.
One of the three pioneers who founded the Meteorite Company.
The Hila experiment should refer to the special experiment of fusing the first-generation virus and psychic Hila Rui Qi.
During the experiment process, Hila lost control.
The experiment was ultimately beyond the Meteorite Company’s control.

Referring to District 7, the description of Hila’s disappearance in the notebook should refer to the fact that after being dismembered by Eudora, Hila’s tissue samples were hidden by the Meteorite Company in every corner of the world.
The problem was...
“Ouroboros...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
This was the third time he had seen this name.
The first time was in his own home, the second time was when he was searching for the first-generation meteorite in District 8, and the third time was in Ken’s diary...
What did it represent?
What was the connection with the main storyline?
Also, at the end of the diary...
Fang Heng heard a soft sound behind him and could not help but look back.
Wallace was tapping on the main control platform in the hall. Tang Bai was standing beside him with his eyes closed and his hands on the main control platform.
“Tang Bai’s special spiritual ability can hack into the electronic system. This method can quickly crack the password in a short period of time.”
Wallace noticed Fang Heng’s gaze. As he operated the platform, he explained to Fang Heng succinctly, “Did you find anything in the book?”
“Yes, before the apocalypse, Hila may have already disapp...”
Fang Heng had just finished speaking when the main control screen in the hall suddenly lit up.
A game hint flashed in front of his eyes.

[Hint: Player has completed the current stage of the mission Hila Rui Qi. Player has received 1,000 main storyline contribution points. Player has triggered the next stage of the mission-Hila’s out-of-control tissue sample.]
Mission difficulty: SS
Mission description: In the research institute, you seem to have learned some truth about the Hila experiment. However, at this time, danger has already arrived.
Mission requirements: Kill the mutated Hila’s tissue sample.
Mutated Hila’s tissue sample?
Fang Heng’s heart trembled.
At the same time, upon receiving the mission hint, the expressions of Xiao Jing and the others changed drastically.
What was going on? They were going to have a Boss fight?
“Kaka kaka kaka kaka kaka...”
There was a sound coming from the metal door behind the secret research room.
The elite Dark Knights in the hall immediately turned their heads around and aimed their muzzle at the door.
“Bang!!!”
There was a muffled and heavy sound.
Bang Bang!!
Along with the continuous sounds of collisions, a huge dent appeared on the metal door.
It was as if something powerful was continuously banging against the metal door!
Under the continuous banging, a small crack had appeared on the joint between the door and the door frame.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted.
Small grayish-brown worm bodies continuously came out from the crack in the door.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - Confrontation
paragraphs: “Be careful!!!”
Fang Heng recognized the thing on the ground at first glance.
Mutant worm body!
Unlike the mutant worm body that was released by the fusion Tyrant form, the mutant worm body that came out from the crack of the door was grayish brown.
The densely packed mutant worm bodies came out from the crack of the door crazily.
The elite Dark Knights also reacted immediately, raising their guns and shooting at the worm bodies on the ground.
However, there were too many worm bodies!
Seeing that the worm bodies were about to surround them, Wallace suddenly raised his hand forward.
“Buzz...”
A transparent spiritual barrier opened up in front of everyone.
The spiritual barrier completely isolated the densely packed worm bodies outside!
Behind them, Xu Bin immediately reacted and shouted, “Use the Molotov cocktail!”
Fire attacks were a good move against a small mutant worm body.
Fang Heng immediately switched to the focused flamethrower and started to burn the mutant worms that were swarming outside.
With the Molotov cocktail thrown out continuously, the ground burned with balls of flames.
The worm bodies pounced into the burning flames one after another, emitting a creaking sound and a burnt smell.
Mo Jiawei hid within the spiritual barrier, still feeling his right eyelid twitching. Looking up, his heart instantly chilled.
“This is troublesome. There’s something up there too. We have to think of a way!”

Hearing this, Xu Bin and Xiao Jing looked up at the ceiling, only to see that there were still densely packed worm bodies climbing up the ceiling! Instantly, a layer of cold sweat broke out on their foreheads.
After experiencing it personally, Fang Heng realized that his own mutant worm body was actually so difficult to deal with!
“Leave it to me.”
Wallace gritted his teeth and said in a deep voice, “Cover your ears.”
Fang Heng instantly understood what Wallace was about to do. He immediately reached out his hands to cover his ears tightly.
Wallace’s eyes were scarlet red as he shouted, “Get lost!!”
His mental strength instantly exploded!
The densely packed mutant worm bodies on the ceiling received a mental shock and fell from the air to the ground.
F*ck!
Covering his ears was useless.
Just like last time, Fang Heng lost his senses for a full 0.5 seconds before he recovered from it.

He glanced at Wallace and saw the blue veins on the latter’s neck and the sweat continuously dripping down his face. He held back his ridicule and continued to raise the focused flamethrower to burn the unconscious mutant worm bodies on the ground.
The other players and elite Dark Knights also gradually woke up from the mental shock state and scrambled to deal with the mutant worm bodies.
No more worm bodies came out from behind the door. Seeing that the number of mutant worm bodies had decreased significantly, everyone once again tried to take control of the situation.
Wallace let go of the spiritual barrier and held the table by the side with one hand, breathing heavily.
“Crack...”
Before they could catch their breath, they heard a faint sound again.
Looking in the direction of the sound, there were granulation-like tentacles extending out from the crack through the metal door.
Seeing this, Xiao Jing could not help but curse, “D*mn it! It’s endless! What the hell is that thing!”
Colonel Barker glanced at Xiao Jing and shouted, “Be careful! Everyone, be on alert! It might be Tier 2!”
The members of the Dark Knights, who had just heaved a sigh of relief, suddenly felt their hearts skip a beat. At the same time, they raised their guns and aimed at the tentacles at the entrance.
“Whoosh!!!”
The squirming tentacle extended to a certain length before it suddenly swung towards the crowd.
“Bang Bang Bang Bang!”
The elite Dark Knights aimed at the granulation and fired!
The granulation was hit by the bullet and danced wildly in the air.
“Bang!!”
“Bang!!”
The door was still being hit.
“There are more and more d*mn things.”

As Mo Jiawei said that, he retreated to the back of the team while raising his right hand to block in front of his right eye. He used his skill to read the information about the creature’s attributes.
He quickly read out the information he had heard from the skill.
“The out-of-control Hila’s mutated form, the product of the long-term fusion of Hila’s tissue sample and rotten flesh. It does not possess any intelligence and will attack any living being.”

“Hila’s mutated tissue has a total of three stages. Currently, it is at Tier 2. It controls its tentacles to engage in battle. The tentacles have a corrosive effect and possess extremely strong infectivity. Its life form’s strength is evaluated to be at Tier 4. Its weakness is corrosive attack. You need to increase the level of your skill to obtain more information...”
Tier 4 mutated life form!
Its weakness is corrosion!
With these two pieces of information, Colonel Barker immediately made arrangements and shouted, “Team 7! Quick! Get ready!”
“Bang!!”
The metal door finally couldn’t take it anymore and was sent flying after a violent impact.
The out-of-control Hila’s mutated form finally revealed its true appearance.
What kind of monster was that!!
Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but feel disgusted.
A disgusting piece of flesh had more than ten tentacles growing on it, waving wildly like an octopus.
“Whoosh! Whoosh!”
Several sulfuric acid bombs were fired at the monster at the first moment.
“Boom! Boom Boom!!”
The strong corrosive sulfuric acid bombs bombarded the monster’s body, causing streams of green mist to rise up!
The chemical burn caused an additional huge amount of damage to the monster!
Fang Heng, Lucia and the others hid behind a cover on the side.
He was glad that he had made sufficient preparations this time and brought 20 elite Dark Knights to provide support.
Fang Heng took out his sniper rifle and loaded it with armor-piercing bullets. He aimed at the target and began to shoot.
“Bang!”
The bullet hit a piece of flesh and the bullet splattered a pool of putrid juice.
Fang Heng secretly frowned.
Unfortunately, the weapons of the Dark Knights were still not as powerful as the sniper rifle specially developed by Ding Min.

After all, the equipment of the Scavenger Army was for NPCs who had been modified by the divine potion. They needed a high amount of basic attributes to equip it, so it was considered late-stage equipment.
When he had time, he would need to run to District 7 to bring one back.
Fang Heng pondered in his heart and continued to lower his head to shoot.

Tier 2 was a little simpler than Fang Heng had expected. The out-of-control Hila’s tissue mutated form extended more than ten tentacles from its body, which could cause huge physical damage, but the mutated body itself could not move, moreover, the main body was extremely huge, so it was very easy to be hit by sulfuric acid bullets.
Slow and steady, victory was in his grasp.
The bullets crazily rained down on the monster.
“What the hell is this Hila mutant?!”
Other than armor-piercing bullets, explosive bullets and sulfuric acid bullets, the Hila mutant completely ignored other attacking methods!
On the other side, Xu Bin, who was hiding behind the cover, thought that the monster was terrifying.
He switched armor-piercing bullets while continuing to attack.
Time was too tight. They had not prepared for this mission at all, nor had they obtained any information. They were completely dumbfounded.
“It’s too difficult. I’ve never seen such a scene before.”
Xiao Jing wiped the sweat off his forehead. He realized that his damage output could not cause any damage to the monster, so he decided to trash it. He took out his notebook and began to record.
“It’s an honor to meet Fang Heng again. I’ve heard rumors about Fang Heng in District 7...”
Just when he was halfway through writing, Xiao Jing heard the roar of the monster!
“Roar!!!”
Xiao Jing’s heart skipped a beat, and he turned his head to look.

Mutant worm body!
Unlike the mutant worm body that was released by the fusion Tyrant form, the mutant worm body that came out from the crack of the door was grayish brown.
The densely packed mutant worm bodies came out from the crack of the door crazily.
The elite Dark Knights also reacted immediately, raising their guns and shooting at the worm bodies on the ground.
However, there were too many worm bodies!
Seeing that the worm bodies were about to surround them, Wallace suddenly raised his hand forward.
“Buzz...”
A transparent spiritual barrier opened up in front of everyone.
The spiritual barrier completely isolated the densely packed worm bodies outside!
Behind them, Xu Bin immediately reacted and shouted, “Use the Molotov cocktail!”
Fire attacks were a good move against a small mutant worm body.
Fang Heng immediately switched to the focused flamethrower and started to burn the mutant worms that were swarming outside.
With the Molotov cocktail thrown out continuously, the ground burned with balls of flames.
The worm bodies pounced into the burning flames one after another, emitting a creaking sound and a burnt smell.

“This is troublesome.
There’s something up there too.
We have to think of a way!”

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - State of Fear
paragraphs: The outermost layer of Hila’s mutant form gradually faded away, revealing an orange eyeball in the center of the flesh.
Xiao Jing felt that the pupil in the center of the eyeball was staring at them!
The moment he looked at the eyeball, Xiao Jing felt a shiver rising from the depths of his soul!
“F*ck, what the hell is that eye...”
[Hint: You are mentally disturbed by an unknown creature. You have entered a state of fear.]

A line of small words appeared in front of his eyes. Following that, Xiao Jing felt his limbs instantly become extremely stiff, like he was in a living nightmare. He was unable to move his body at all!
In the next second, Xiao Jing saw a huge tentacle in front of him charging towards him.
“Bang!”
Xiao Jing was hit directly by the tentacle. He was sent flying and crashed heavily into the wall!
The part where he was hit by the tentacle was burning with pain!
However, Xiao Jing was still in a state of fear and could not make any moves!
He could not even take medicine to recover his HP!
Hila’s mutated form crazily waved its huge tentacles. The Dark Knights were all in a state of fear and were completely passive!
Fang Heng and the others were also affected by the state of fear. They were frozen on the spot.
It was not that he was completely unable to control his body. Instead, every movement required a lot of strength. As for the action of running, it was simply impossible!

Mo Jiawei whispered, “When the mutant body is in Tier 3, it possesses a powerful mental fear ability and is judged to have the strength of a Tier 4 creature. Its weakness is that eyeball. As long as you attack that eyeball, you will be able to cause fatal damage to it.”
“The eyeball can continuously create a state of fear. As long as that eyeball is still there, the state of fear will last forever.”
“Fang Heng,” Wallace said in a deep voice, “I can help you break free temporarily. It will only last for three seconds at most. You must think of a way to get rid of it within three seconds.”
Fang Heng glanced at Lucia beside him. The latter nodded very seriously and quickly came up with a reckless plan.
“I’ll go and attract its attention first. You go up and stab it.”
“Okay, let’s do that,” Fang Heng felt that this plan was pretty good, so he immediately nodded and started counting down. “Three, two, one.”
“Start!”
Wallace shouted loudly, and the veins on his forehead bulged. His spiritual defense barrier opened up again.
Fang Heng felt his body suddenly loosen up.
Almost instantly, Lucia took a step forward and rapidly approached the eyeball in front of her!
Several tentacles immediately pounced towards Lucia, trying to stall her in her footsteps.
“Whoosh! Whoosh Whoosh!”
The tentacles waved in the air, producing several air-piercing sounds!
Lucia was unable to dodge and could only try to block with her dagger.
The moment the dagger touched the tentacles, Lucia’s heart trembled. She felt as if the dagger had slashed onto an extremely hard metal.
Then, a powerful force came at her. Lucia could not stand still and was forced to fly backward.
While her body was flying in the air, Lucia still maintained her balance. She aimed at the target and threw the dagger forward with all her might!
“Chi!!”
The dagger passed through the gaps of the waving tentacles and stabbed into the upper right corner of the eyeball of the out-of-control mutated form!
“Roar!!!”
A brutal and painful roar sounded in everyone’s minds!
The tentacles that extended from the giant-sized piece of flesh shook crazily!
“Fang Heng! Now!”
On the side, Fang Heng dashed out and took advantage to approach the eyeball form which had lost control!
It was unknown when, but Fang Heng had a butcher’s machete in his hand.
Machete was the most convenient for melee attacks.
“Chi!!”
The machete stabbed into the depths of the eyeball, all the way to the hilt.
Fang Heng’s eyes revealed a hint of viciousness.
“Die!”
Fang Heng used all his strength, dragging the machete and pulling it to the side!
Chi!!!
From left to right, the machete drew a huge tear on the eyeball!
“Chi!”
A stinky thick juice spewed out along the tear!
The tentacles that were constantly waving gradually lost their strength, and the entire piece of flesh rapidly withered in the blink of an eye.
In an instant, the originally huge piece of flesh melted into a pool of stinky blood in front of Fang Heng.
In the end, only a piece of flesh that was still slightly squirming was left on the ground.
As the eyeball form was destroyed, everyone gradually recovered from the state of fear.
“Quick! Don’t just stand there! Quickly go and treat the injured!”
Colonel Barker was the first to recover from the state of fear. He shouted at everyone.
The elite Dark Knights also reacted one by one and immediately began to treat the injured.
Xiao Jing and Xu Bin looked at each other. They could feel a sense of relief in each other’s eyes.
It was too terrifying.
There was no way to resist such a mental attack!
Then, the two looked at Fang Heng together.
That guy!
They had no doubt that Fang Heng could turn District 7 upside down by himself.
Judging from the way Fang Heng cut the eyeball in half, he was definitely a ruthless character!
Fang Heng still stood where he was, carefully staring at the piece of flesh on the ground.
It was not dead yet!
Fang Heng’s gaze occasionally swept across the game log.
He had never received the game hint that he had killed Hila’s mutated form.
Could it be that there was still a Tier 4?
Wait a minute...
Fang Heng thought of something.
He carefully squatted down and tried to touch the piece of flesh on the ground.
[Hint: You have found a special item-Hila’s tissue.]
[Hint (triggered by low-level game difficulty): There is a high probability that Hila’s tissue will mutate when exposed to the outside world. Please be careful!]
[Hint: Player has completed the mission-out-of-control Hila’s tissue sample.]
Fang Heng roughly skimmed through the game hint and came to a realization.
Hila had an immortal body, so she could not be destroyed. That was why he didn’t receive the game hint that she was killed.
From the looks of it, the reward for killing a Tier 4 out-of-control mutated creature whose strength had reached Tier 5 was Hila’s tissue sample!
Hila’s tissue sample could not be kept in his backpack, and there was a risk of subsequent mutations at every moment. He had to think of a way to store it.
Where was it originally stored?
There should be a special container made by the Meteorite Company in the small room behind the emergency exit?
There might even be an item that could trigger the next stage.
Fang Heng was about to go to the back of the door to check when he suddenly heard a painful cry behind him.
Tang Bai curled up and rolled on the ground in pain. He kept wailing.
The people around him did not know what had happened. They all formed a circle.
“Tang Bai! Tang Bai!”
Wallace was scared out of his wits. He quickly ran over and grabbed Tang Bai’s shoulder, trying to calm him down. “What happened to you?”
“Maybe he was affected by the mental fluctuations of the mutated Hila’s tissue just now.” Lucia switched to the tranquilizer gun. “I will give him a sedative and let him rest for a while.”
“No... No!”
Tang Bai almost shouted.
He clenched his teeth, his nails deeply embedded in his palm and cold sweat kept dripping down his face.
“I saw it!”

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - Illusion
paragraphs: “What did you see?”
Tang Bai did not answer. Under everyone’s gaze, he panted heavily and slowly stood up from the ground, propping himself up against the wall.
Step by step, he walked to Fang Heng’s side and reached out to touch the flesh on the ground.
“Sister Rui Qi, her memory...”
As soon as he finished speaking, a white light flashed in front of Fang Heng’s eyes!
The dazzling white light made Fang Heng unable to see anything for a moment.
When the white light dissipated, Fang Heng saw a third perspective image appear in front of him.
It was an illusion!
Fang Heng clearly knew that this was an illusion, but he still felt that everything was extremely clear, as if he was there.
A young man who looked to be in his thirties was kneeling in front of a large cultivation pod.
His face was filled with pain and guilt.
Fang Heng recognized him at a glance.
It was Ken!
And the little girl standing beside him! Milia!
They were the ones whom he saw in the photo in the notebook!
“Bang!”
Gunshots rang out.
Fang Heng’s heart sank.
The flesh formed from Hila’s tissue in the cultivation pod began to throb crazily!
Ken clutched his chest as he watched the blood oozing out of his wound slowly dye his coat red. He slowly turned his head with great effort and looked behind him.
“Eudora...”
“Ken, I’ve advised you many times. Why can’t you let it go?”
“Don’t blame me. I have to do this. For the sake of this world, you should understand me. We all have lofty ideals, and we’re willing to sacrifice everything for it, right?”
“You’ve disappointed me too much, Ken.”
Without waiting for Ken to answer, Eudora waved her hand.
Behind Eudora, a few Meteorite Company guards fired at the same time.
“Bang! Bang!!”
Gunshots rang out.
Ken and Milia fell into a pool of blood.
“Crack...”
A crack appeared on the glass of the cultivation pod.
Eudora seemed to have realized something. She looked up at the cultivation pod with a look of surprise on her face.
The tissue sample of Hila in the cultivation pod actually started jumping crazily.
“Why? Does she still have consciousness? What kind of perception does she use to perceive the outside world?”
This was the first time Eudora saw such a scene. She muttered to herself and turned to the guard. “Quick! Tell Dr. Liang Han to find me. There’s a big discovery. Go now! Quick!”
“Yes!”
Eudora turned around and reached out to touch the cracked tempered glass.
“Rui Qi...”
Suddenly, Eudora’s expression changed drastically.
As if she had seen something extremely terrifying, her body suddenly twitched!
Then, she frantically reached out with both hands to strangle her throat.
All the guards in the room did the same thing. Their expressions were terrifying as they frantically grabbed onto their necks. They were in so much pain that they were unable to speak.
At that moment, a deep voice sounded in Fang Heng’s ears.
“At the cost of my life, I curse this land that the dead will no longer go to the land of the afterlife...”
A red mutant worm body as thick as an arm crawled out from Eudora’s mouth with all its might.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted!
The red mutant worm body pounced in front of his eyes almost instantly.
The face of the mutant worm body twisted into a human shape and opened its huge mouth to face him!
Fang Heng could even smell the stench!
“I want to... resurrect!!!”
Resurrect?!
“Bang!!”
In the next second, the illusion in front of him shattered like a mirror.
Everything returned to normal again.
Fang Heng slowly adjusted his breathing and looked around.
He was back.
This was the hall of the secret research room.
Most of the elite Dark Knights in the hall were still busy treating the injured. Xu Bin and Xiao Jing felt that something was wrong and looked at Fang Heng and the others in confusion.
In their eyes, Fang Heng and the others were absent-minded for a few seconds. Their faces were extremely pale as if they had experienced an extremely terrifying scene.
Xu Bin walked up and asked, “Fang Heng, what happened to you guys? Are you guys okay?”
“Yes, thank you. I’m fine.”
The illusion just now was too real. Fang Heng’s back was drenched in cold sweat.
The other four members of the team also experienced the illusion. They were all desperately breathing in the fresh air.
Mo Jiawei opened his mouth.

Recalling the scene just now, he felt as if he had understood something. However, after thinking about it carefully, he did not seem to be able to explain it clearly. So, he simply looked at Fang Heng to await his answer.

Fang Heng and Lucia exchanged glances, he said to Xu Bin and Lucia, “It might be the backlash of mental power after killing the Boss just now. It will be fine after a short rest. You guys go and check the room at the back. There might be clues related to the main storyline mission in there.”
“Okay.”
Xu Bin and Lucia were also concerned about the main storyline mission. They nodded their heads and followed the Dark Knights into the emergency exit to explore.
After the two Federation members were dismissed, Fang Heng’s gaze swept past Wallace and the others.
After experiencing the illusion together, everyone fell silent for a moment.
“You guys saw it too, right?”

“Yes.” Tang Bai explained, “At the start, I felt Sister Rui Qi’s mental power undulations, so I took the initiative to search for her. I didn’t expect her undulations to be too intense, and I suffered a backlash all of a sudden.”
“The second time, I was prepared. I tried to communicate with the mental power of the flesh, and we saw this scene.”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng nodded.
In the entire illusionary realm, the thing he was most puzzled about was that in the end, the red worm body shouted the word “Resurrection” at him.
“So Rui Qi is dead?”

Wallace guessed, “That’s Sister Rui Qi’s curse ability. At the last moment, she sacrificed her life as the price of the curse. I think her soul has already died, but because of the fusion of her body cells with the first-generation virus, her body is still immortal.”
Mo Jiawei blurted out, “So now she has become a monster without consciousness?”
Tang Bai stared at Mo Jiawei.
“Uh, no, I don’t mean that. I mean...”

Lucia patted Tang Bai’s shoulder comfortingly. “Well, Rui Qi has lost her soul and consciousness, but her body may still be affected by the remnant will of hatred before she died, and she retains a few short memories.”
Everyone fell silent again.

Fang Heng pondered for a moment and broke the silence. He said, “Let me analyze it. After Hila’s fusion with the first-generation virus, she gradually lost control. Eudora divided Hila’s body into 12 parts and hid them in every corner of the world.”
“Maybe during the process, Eudora kept one of them and was still secretly studying it.”
“But Eudora didn’t expect that even after she was divided, Hila still had a part of her consciousness and she could even sense the outside world through her special ability
“After witnessing, or perhaps sensing, the death of her family members at Eudora’s hands, Hila cursed the world.”
“The origin of this game’s apocalypse world was actually a curse.”
“In the past, we have always wondered why almost all the top management of the Meteorite Company, including Eudora, disappeared overnight.”

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - Two Hidden Endings
paragraphs: Fang Heng looked at everyone and made a judgment, “I think it’s not because the Meteorite Company has some special plan to secretly hide somewhere in the world and develop in secret.”
“In reality, they’re all dead.”
“They were cursed by Hila at the first moment and became the first batch of zombies in the Zombie Apocalypse.”
The game hint refreshed in Fang Heng’s vision.
[Hint: Player has completed the main storyline mission-Hila’s curse, the origin of the world has been revealed (85%), player has received 20,000 main storyline contribution points.]
[Hint: Player has triggered hidden ending (SSS): Eternal Moon.]
Ending description: You think that Hila is right. There are too many tragedies in this world. Death is not the final salvation. Sinners should be reincarnated in pain forever.
Ending trigger condition: Find all of Hila’s tissues buried by the Meteorite Company, revive Hila Rui Qi, and the Blood Moon will be eternal on Earth.
Mission description: If you choose to change the ending, this will cause strife between you and the Dark Knights.
[Hint: Player has triggered hidden ending (SSS): Final Purification.]
Ending description: Hila has suffered too much pain, but this world should not be a victim. Find a way to find all of Hila Rui Qi’s life form and seal it, ending the curse entirely.
Mission description: Find a way to destroy (seal) Hila’s life form and destroy (seal) all of Hila’s tissue samples, ending (break) Hila’s curse.
[Hint: Player, please choose your ending carefully.]
It’s done!
Fang Heng sighed in his heart when he saw the line-by-line game hints that popped up.
His judgment was correct.
Then there was only one question left.
Ouroboros.
If this riddle was solved, the final 15% of the secret would be answered.
Unfortunately, there was still no clue to this riddle.
“Holy shit, God, we’re awesome.”
Mo Jiawei’s eyelids twitched when he saw the new game hints. He patted Fang Heng’s shoulder heavily, his excited voice trembling.
“3S hidden ending! Did you see it, God! 3S!!!”
“Yes!”
Fang Heng’s attention shifted away from Ouroboros and let out a soft grunt.
3S hidden ending!
No wonder Mo Jiawei was so excited.
According to the information he received from special sources, the player who completed the ending would receive a high reward. The higher the level of the ending, the more generous the reward.

Most of the endings of the Zombie Apocalypse were A-level. For example, the Mechanical Dawn and the Gardener’s Path that were exposed by the players were A-level and B-level respectively. According to reliable sources, although the Federation obtained first place in the contribution points, the player who completed the final ending received an extremely bountiful reward.
The rewards for 3S and A-level endings were definitely worlds apart.
Fang Heng’s heart was also itching.
Up till now, he had never heard of anyone who had completed 3S ending missions.
However, the problem now was that both options were 3S, so which one should he choose...
Mo Jiawei’s heart was filled with excitement as he asked, “God, then which one should we choose?”
“Is there a need to ask? Of course, we have to choose both!”
Fang Heng had already decided that the player could only complete the ending mission once. Therefore, he would complete one for District 8 and another for District 7!
However, District 8 was still the main area for the time being.
One was to resurrect, and the other was to destroy.
He had to consider the efficiency of completing the missions.

Resurrecting Hila was very dangerous, and in theory, Hila had already lost consciousness, so it was uncertain whether special conditions would be required to resurrect her. In addition, breaking up with the Dark Knights was not part of the plan...
It would be troublesome if they chose to destroy Hila’s tissue.
After all, Hila’s tissue was immortal. Meteorite Company had been researching for so long, but they still could not think of a way...
As he was thinking, Fang Heng re-examined the game hint.
Seal?!
That’s right! He could think of a way to seal it!
Fang Heng immediately thought of Xiao Ruoruo.
In the Nightmare World where she lived, people relied on some kind of power to seal the Nightmare Demon.
“Mo, have you heard of sealing?”
“Er... Seventh Uncle should know a little about this.”
Thinking of his strict Seventh Uncle, Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but shrink his neck.
“You want to directly seal Hila’s tissue sample?”
“Yes.”

“It’s a bit difficult. Seventh Uncle isn’t as easy to talk to as Fourth Uncle.” Mo Jiawei thought for a moment, then flipped through the hidden ending explanation and asked, “Also, we have a big problem. How can we find a sample of Hila’s tissue?”
“I can sense Sister Hila’s location, but if we seal her...” Tang Bai couldn’t bear it. He looked at the crowd, “Fang Heng, is there no other way?”
Fang Heng shook his head.
The path to resurrecting Hila was too difficult, and it was filled with too many unknowns.
Time did not permit that.
Tang Bai’s eyes gradually dimmed.

“Tang Bai, Hila has already used up her life curse. She has already lost consciousness,” Lucia gently persuaded. “Meteorite Company has already been punished. We have chosen to help her rest in peace.”
“Yes, I understand.”
Tang Bai nodded and did not continue to insist.
Fang Heng thought to himself.
The next step was to collect the remaining 11 tissue samples of Hila and complete the main storyline!
“Tang Bai, where is the nearest location of Hila’s tissue?”
Tang Bai closed his eyes and tried to sense it. Then, he opened the map and pointed at a location on the map.
“It’s here.”
Fang Heng looked at the map. It showed an unexplored area, which the player might not have searched before.
“Hurry up, we’re leaving now.”
In this world, the Dark Knights already had absolute strength, plus his prison force and zombie team.
If everything went smoothly, if Mo Jiawei could take care of the seal.
Hmm..
Even if Chen Yu was reliable and willing to help him..
Two days!
Two days were enough!
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes, “Let’s return to the headquarters immediately. I have to go to the parallel world to bring back some things.”
Fusion Tyrant form!
Based on the difficulty of District 7, as long as there was a fusion Tyrant form, it wasn’t difficult to gather a tissue sample of Hila!
“Alright, then I’ll go find Seventh Uncle and ask him about the seal.”
Lucia nodded, “Tang Bai and I will first confirm the remaining 11 specific locations of Sister Rui Qi and plan the route of action.”
In the middle of the night, Chen Yu received an emergency notice.
The next day, before dawn, he rushed to attend a video conference held by the headquarters of District 8 of the Zombie Apocalypse.
At first, Chen Yu was thinking that ever since Fang Heng went to harm District 7, District 8 had been peaceful for a long time.
This time, he didn’t know what kind of trouble he had encountered, so he specially called for an emergency meeting.
Then, after the meeting started, Chen Yu received an unexpected piece of news.
“What? Fang Heng?!”
Fang Heng had returned to District 8?

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - Seeking Coperation
paragraphs: Chen Yu’s first reaction was that there must be a mistake!
Fang Heng should be fighting with Kou Huai in District 7 right now. In theory, both sides were already in deep water. Why did he suddenly come back to District 8?
After personally seeing the complete report on the main storyline mission of the Dark Knights provided by Xu Bin, Chen Yu was still dumbfounded.
Deputy commander of the Dark Knights?
A special mission related to the main storyline mission?
And the mission was successfully completed? Was it confirmed that Fang Heng had obtained the information on the next main storyline mission?
Chen Yu was completely confused.
At the main video conference venue, the acting chief commander of the Federation’s District 8, Han Jiong, had clearly stated the mission target for the next stage.
Restart the main storyline mission and do your best to participate in the main storyline mission!
After the meeting had ended, Chen Yu was still a little confused about the situation.
Just as he walked out of the conference room, two Federation soldiers blocked Chen Yu’s path.
“Mr. Chen Yu, Officer Han wants to see you. We will bring you over now.”
Ten minutes later, in the meeting room, Fang Heng met the acting chief commander of District 8, Han Jiong.

Not long ago, the former chief commander of District 8 had been dismissed by the Federation due to his poor performance in dealing with Night Owl’s various problems. The temporarily replaced chief commander had just taken office and was seriously ill and unable to work.
As a result, Han Jiong, who had temporarily replaced him, became the acting chief commander of District 8 and temporarily exercised his command authority.
Other than him, more than twenty people in the hall were all high-level commanders of District 8 and commanders of large-sized shelters.
Han Jiong was a young man in his early thirties.

After learning that Fang Heng had returned and that the main storyline of District 8 had been restarted, he immediately summoned the Federation of District 8 to immediately start restarting the main storyline mission plan.
However, when it came to the specific operation, a problem arose.
The higher-ups of District 8 were divided into two factions, and there were some disputes.
One side thought that the Federation should cooperate with Fang Heng now and think of ways to join the main storyline mission to obtain the right to unlock the final game ownership.

The other side thought that there was a high probability that Fang Heng was involved with District 7 and was a troublesome character. It might even be related to Night Owl. It was best to control him, bring him in for investigation, and then think of ways to investigate the main storyline mission on their own.
Before the video of the previous meeting, everyone had been arguing for more than an hour without coming to a conclusion.
The entire meeting room was silent. Everyone’s gaze was focused on Chen Yu, which made Chen Yu feel extremely uncomfortable.
He had rarely seen such a scene and was even more nervous at this moment.
“Chen Yu.”
Chen Yu suddenly quivered, “Here!”

“I’ve seen some of your information. You have worked with Fang Heng in the past. Based on your understanding of Fang Heng, what do you think of Fang Heng’s attitude towards our Federation? Is it possible for him to cooperate with us?”
Chen Yu pondered for a moment and nodded. “In the past, Fang Heng has always been close to our District 8. I believe that he is willing to work with us.”

“Then do you think that Fang Heng can be trusted?” Han Jiong stared at Chen Yu. “District 7 doesn’t have a good impression of him. District 7’s chief commander, Kou Huai, believes that Fang Heng is the mastermind behind this. What do you think?”
“This...”
Faced with this question, Chen Yu hesitated.
Personally, he felt that there was a high probability that the matter in District 7 was orchestrated by Fang Heng.
In the past, he thought that Night Owl was a terrorist organization, but now...
At least from the situation in District 7, ten Night Owls combined could not compare to Fang Heng’s destructive power.
“Sir, I can’t confirm this, but I think that Fang Heng is not from the anti-federal organization. District 7 must have made a mistake.”
Han Jiong nodded and continued to ask, “Chen Yu, if I let you communicate with Fang Heng and convince Fang Heng to let us join the main storyline mission, how confident do you think you are?”
Chen Yu frowned.
Convince Fang Heng to join the shared main storyline mission?
It would be very difficult!
“I can give it a try. I’ll definitely do my best!”
“Alright, I’ll authorize you to carry out this mission. Report to me immediately if anything happens.”
“Yes!”
Han Jiong looked at Chen Yu. “You can make the call now.”
Now?
Chen Yu was stunned.
He realized that everyone was waiting for him to make the call.
Chen Yu smiled bitterly, took out his mobile phone and turned it on.
He did have Fang Heng’s number, but in most cases, Fang Heng would not pick up the phone.
“Sir, I’ll try, but he may still be in the game, so he can’t pick up the phone.”
As Chen Yu spoke, he dialed Fang Heng’s number.
After three busy tones, the phone was picked up.
Chen Yu heard a familiar voice.
“Yo? Chen Yu, long time no see!”
He picked up the call!
Fang Heng actually picked up the call!
Initially, he only wanted to give it a try. He did not expect Fang Heng to really pick up the call!

“Quiet!”
Han Jiong signaled for everyone in the office to quiet down. He turned his head to look at Chen Yu and immediately said, “Put him on speakerphone, pick up!”
Chen Yu’s heart pounded wildly. He thought to himself, “Fang Heng hasn’t answered the phone for tens of thousands of years. Why is he picking up the phone at this time?”
Please don’t mess around!
Chen Yu took a deep breath and steadied his mind. “Hello? Fang Heng?”
“Hey, Chen Yu, I have good news for you. I’m back in District 8. I was looking for you. Are you free today? Come to the prison to play. How about I treat you to some barbecue?”
Barbecued meat?
Chen Yu recalled the time when he had barbecued meat with Fang Heng and the others in the prison not long ago. For a moment, he was stunned.
On the side, a Federation soldier nudged him gently.
Chen Yu quickly came back to his senses and said, “Sure, barbecued meat. When?”

“Anytime is fine. It’s up to you. After all, I have something to ask you for help.” Fang Heng’s giggling voice came from the other end of the phone. “I remember someone said that as long as I return to District 8, he will take care of me.”
Hearing this, Chen Yu was so flustered that cold sweat was about to break out. He saw countless pairs of eyes staring at him in the meeting room.
This Big Brother who caused trouble wherever he went...
How could I, Chen Yu, have the ability to protect you!
“Cough cough, Fang Heng, let’s be serious...”
“Hahaha, Chen Yu, I’m just joking. After all, I’m not a bad person. Why have you become more timid recently?”

On the phone, Fang Heng’s tone was unusually relaxed, “I’m a law-abiding citizen of the Federation. Look, I was kidnapped some time ago. Once I escaped, I immediately cut off contact with District 7 and immediately came back to District 8. I completely cut off all contact with District 7.”
“Actually, the reason why I am inviting you to have a barbecue with me is that there’s something I need to consult with you.”
“I heard that Night Owl seems to have done a lot of bad things in District 7 in my name. I don’t know anything about it. Will the Federation arrest me?”
Hearing Fang Heng’s words, Chen Yu heaved a huge sigh of relief.
Even though he did not believe a single word Fang Heng said.

In theory, both sides were already in deep water.
Why did he suddenly come back to District 8?
After personally seeing the complete report on the main storyline mission of the Dark Knights provided by Xu Bin, Chen Yu was still dumbfounded.
Deputy commander of the Dark Knights?
A special mission related to the main storyline mission?
And the mission was successfully completed?
Was it confirmed that Fang Heng had obtained the information on the next main storyline mission?
Chen Yu was completely confused.

Restart the main storyline mission and do your best to participate in the main storyline mission!

One side thought that the Federation should cooperate with Fang Heng now and think of ways to join the main storyline mission to obtain the right to unlock the final game ownership.
The other side thought that there was a high probability that Fang Heng was involved with District 7 and was a troublesome character.
It might even be related to Night Owl.
It was best to control him, bring him in for investigation, and then think of ways to investigate the main storyline mission on their own.
Before the video of the previous meeting, everyone had been arguing for more than an hour without coming to a conclusion.

Is it possible for him to cooperate with us?”

“District 7 doesn’t have a good impression of him.
District 7’s chief commander, Kou Huai, believes that Fang Heng is the mastermind behind this.
What do you think?”
“This...”

District 7 must have made a mistake.”

It would be very difficult!

I’ll definitely do my best!”
“Alright, I’ll authorize you to carry out this mission.
Report to me immediately if anything happens.”
“Yes!”

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - Sharing?
paragraphs: “Uh, it might be a little troublesome. The specifics will depend on the situation. Fang Heng, you have to believe us. The Federation will not malign good people.”
“Alright, let’s meet at night to talk about the specifics.”
“Wait.” Chen Yu stopped Fang Heng and his gaze swept across everyone in the meeting room. He said seriously, “Cough cough, Fang Heng, actually the Federation wants to ask you for a favor.”
“Oh... your tone is so serious. What is it?”
“I heard that you triggered the main storyline mission in District 8 last night. The Federation also wants to join...”
After saying this, the other end of the phone went silent.
Chen Yu felt that it was very difficult to say this.
If it was the Federation themselves, they would definitely not share the main storyline with Fang Heng.
“I thought it was something major. Since you’ve already said it, it’s fine. After all, it’s also a great thing to help stabilize District 8. I understand.”
Hearing the reply from the loudspeaker, everyone in the room was stunned.
Agreed?!
Fang Heng actually agreed!

Just a moment ago, the various upper echelons of District 8 were discussing Fang Heng’s attitude towards the Federation. Now that they heard that he had agreed to share the main storyline mission, most of their worries about Fang Heng were immediately dispelled.
Everyone in the meeting room was excited and couldn’t help but start discussing in low voices.
Chen Yu was also stunned when he heard that. Then, his heart was completely at ease.
He knew it!
He had worked with Fang Heng for so long before. He knew that Fang Heng was a law-abiding citizen who understood the big picture!
He was willing to sacrifice himself to cooperate with the Federation and even share the main storyline mission.
How could such a person be a terrorist like Night Owl!
It must be the work of those idiots in District 7, forcing a person to go against the Federation!
The more Chen Yu thought about it, the more he felt that there was something wrong with the chief commander of District 7, Kou Huai. He was a complete idiot!
“What’s the situation? It seems a little noisy over there?”
“It’s nothing. I was just in the middle of a video conference. The leader was giving a speech, and everyone had some insights.”
“Oh, oh, oh.” Fang Heng continued, “However, I still have two requests regarding cooperation.”
“Tell me, I’ll try my best to negotiate with the leader and try my best to satisfy your request.”

“Then I won’t stand on ceremony. The first point, recently, the Night Owl organization used my name to cause some trouble in District 7. I think you should think of a way to prove my innocence. There are also rumors that I’m related to the anti-federal organization. I think you should help me clear my name.”
Chen Yu raised his head and looked at Han Jiong.
Han Jiong immediately nodded.

“It’s not a big problem. District 8 will give you a certificate that proves that during this period, you are participating in the secret-related main storyline mission in District 8. You are suspected of being kidnapped by the Night Owl organization and have nothing to do with the recent series of events in District 7.”

“Hey, thanks. The second point, at this stage for the main storyline mission, I need to gather some mission items. I will provide the coordinates. If you help me find them, you can also earn a large amount of main storyline contribution points. However, my request is that you must give me the items that you have gathered and let me trigger the next stage of the mission.”
Chen Yu looked at Han Jiong again.
This time, Han Jiong hesitated for a moment.
He nodded again.
“Sure, I’ll think of a way to talk to the leader about the cooperation. I think it won’t be a big problem.”
“Okay.” Fang Heng chuckled. “Then let’s talk tonight?”
“We will set ‘tonight’ aside. I’ll go and report to the leader. I’ll inform you immediately if there’s any news.”
“Alright, I’ll wait for your good news!”
After hanging up the phone, the entire meeting room was in a heated discussion.
It was a success!
The cooperation was a success!
They could start the main storyline mission from Fang Heng so quickly!
Fang Heng’s attitude was very cooperative. The requirements he put forward were not harsh either. This was much simpler than they had expected!
“Alright everyone, the things that happened today must be kept a secret from the public.”
Han Jiong looked around at everyone present and warned, “I don’t want Night Owl’s people to get this news.”

“Chen Yu, I’ll leave this matter to you. We’ll try our best to fulfill Fang Heng’s request. My request is to join the main storyline mission and think of a way to obtain the main storyline contribution points and join the final competition for the world belonging to District 8.”
“Report to me as soon as you have any news.”
“Yes!”
Inside the villa, Fang Heng hung up the phone in satisfaction.

Mo Jiawei heard a small part of Fang Heng’s conversation from the side and was dumbfounded. “What’s going on? God, are you crazy? Do you want to form an alliance with the Federation? Share the main storyline with the enemy?”
“Sigh, the situation is too small for Old Mr. Mo. How can there be eternal enemies? We’re just taking what we need.”
“We are talking about the Federation! We can’t trust them so easily!”
“I know what you mean, but I have a plan.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes slightly.
He had long realized that something was wrong when Chen Yu called.
There should be someone by Chen Yu’s side.
Fang Heng was not sure if the Federation wanted to cooperate or if they would play dirty tricks like District 7.
No matter what, he had already made full preparations.
To be more precise, Fang Heng was now waiting for the Federation to play dirty tricks.
Fang Heng continued, “Don’t worry about this for now. Where’s the seal? How’s the matter with the seal?”

“Uh...” Recalling the scene when he called his seventh uncle for advice not long ago, Mo Jiawei couldn’t help but smile wryly, “I’ve asked my seventh uncle. In his words, the sealing technique is unrivaled in the world. For just a lousy specimen, it can be easily sealed. If you want to learn it, just go and look for him.”
“You have to learn it yourself? Isn’t it just like in the anime, get a cooking pot and put on a cover?”
Mo Jiawei was at a loss. “Huh? Cooking pot? Which movie?”

Fang Heng felt that he had misunderstood. Previously, he had thought that he could easily seal Hila’s tissue sample with the help of props from the real world. Now, it seemed that it was not that simple.

Now, the Dark Knights and the Federation were helping to find the metal box that was hidden by the Meteorite Company. It was just the right time for him to think of a way to solve the problem of the seal.
“Alright, where is your seventh uncle? Let’s go and meet him.”
“He’s in the gym. I’ve already called for a car. He’ll be waiting at the entrance.”
On the third floor of the gym.
Every Saturday and Sunday, Mo Jianghe would be here to facilitate the teaching of the seal.
During the lesson, the back door of the classroom was opened.
Mo Jiawei lowered his head and bent over, pulling Fang Heng to sit in a corner on the side.
On the main podium was Mo Jianghe. Mo Jiawei’s seventh uncle looked somewhat similar to Mo Jiawei.
Fang Heng sat cross-legged and looked around.
There were not many students in the room, only a dozen or so. The age difference was huge. The youngest was only in his early twenties, and the oldest looked to be almost a hundred years old.
In front of them, Mo Jianghe’s main podium was hung with majestic calligraphy. The words written on it were even more domineering.
“The art of sealing is invincible in the world!”
“I have a brother who talks about being invincible all the time. He says that there is nothing that cannot be broken by a single slash.”

A mocking smile appeared on Mo Jianghe’s lips, he continued, “It sounds very powerful, right? But if you think about it carefully, so what if it is broken by a single slash? There are some things that can be endlessly resurrected even if they are broken ten thousand times.”

“The sealing technique is different. People, ghosts, aliens, demons, nightmares, creatures, spirits, anything tangible or intangible, will, thought, spirit, life force, and everything else can be sealed.”
“We have already learned the sealing technique for several years, and it is not a short time. Today, we will try to seal something of a higher level, fear!”

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - Learning
paragraphs: “Sealing fear has its pros and cons.”

“There are many pros. For example, it will allow us to block the negative effects when we see a terrifying scene, maintain our calm at all times, and even be immune to the negative spirit effects brought about by the ‘fear’ skill. As for the cons, it will make us dull and insensitive, and we will lose part of our perception of the danger that occurs.”
“To be able to seal and unseal our own fear and control our own fear as we wish, this is the purpose of our study.”
After the lecture, while the students were beginning to make arrangements and carry out practical operations, Mo Jiawei led Fang Heng to the front of the lecture table.
Mo Jiawei took out a bottle of wine from his backpack and handed it to Mo Jianghe.
“Seventh Uncle, look what I brought.”
Mo Jianghe’s eyes lit up. He stretched out his hand and put the “God’s intoxication” into his bag. “‘God’s intoxication?’ From the King of Gods’ game?”
“Hehe, I specially brought it to show my respect to Seventh Uncle.”
“Hmph, not bad. You’re a little more sensible.” Mo Jianghe nodded in satisfaction and looked at Fang Heng. “This is your friend.”
Fang Heng cupped his fists at Mo Jianghe. “Hello, Seventh Uncle. I’m Fang Heng.”
“Mmm, I heard Jia Wei say that you want to learn seals, right? Good choice!”
Mo Jianghe praised and pointed at the banner on his finger. “See? After learning it, you’ll be invincible.”
Invincible...
Fang Heng felt that Mo Jianghe was bragging a little.
However, it was just a matter of fact. Regarding the sealing of fear that Mo Jianghe mentioned just now, Fang Heng felt that it was very awesome.
“Okay, since you want to learn it, I’ll explain it in detail.”

“There are three entry requirements to learn the basic seal. First, intelligence points, second, mental strength, and third, vitality,” Mo Jianghe said as his gaze swept across Fang Heng’s face, “Other than that, the sealing technique burns a hole in your pocket. Don’t learn it if you don’t have the money.”

“How is it? Is it very difficult? In addition, talent is also extremely important. When we started enrolling students until now, only one or two people in a year were able to truly pass the entry level and enter the novice stage. You have to consider it carefully.”
Fang Heng nodded. “Seventh Uncle, I’ve thought about it. I want to learn it.”

“Regardless of it being expensive and difficult, after learning it, the sealing technique will be invincible in the world.” Mo Jianghe pointed at the people sitting down, “Any of these people were to stand out, they will be the experts of the various major factions in the mid-and advanced game. They will be the mainstay of the large-scale gaming union.”

“That white-clothed vice president of Qinghe Guild, the overlord of an area in the advanced game, that old man monopolizes the entire sealing business in District 3. That pockmarked face in the corner, don’t look at him just because he has been hiding in the corner. He is the minister of the assassination department in the Federation’s advanced game. Countless people have died at his hands...”
Although Fang Heng didn’t know him, he was a little surprised when he heard about it.
A glimpse of a spot and see the whole leopard.
The strength of the Mo Family in the game wasn’t just a base or a gaming union on the surface. They had infiltrated every corner of the game in a different way.
Even Mo Jiawei felt his blood boil when he heard those few words. It was as if he could soar to the sky after learning it.
Mo Jiawei swallowed his saliva and asked, “Seventh Uncle, do you think it’s still too late for me to learn the seal now?”
“Forget it. If you don’t have the willpower, it would be a waste for you to learn it.”
“No, I can do it. I’ll bring you more wine tomorrow.”
“That’s fine too.”
Mo Jianghe was happy and agreed immediately.

“Here, take this.”
Fang Heng stretched out his hand.
The moment he touched the paper, a line of game hints appeared in his vision.
[Hint: Player has obtained a special item-Spirit of Seal.]
Item: Spirit of Seal.
Hint: After binding, you can learn basic sealing techniques.
[Hint: Player’s basic intelligence points exceed 10 points, and his basic will exceeds 10 points. If you meet the requirements, you can learn skill-basic sealing techniques.]
[Hint: Player needs to consume 100 King of Gods’ points to learn. Do you want to consume them?]
King of Gods’ points...
Fang Heng thought for a moment and chose yes.
The piece of paper melted into Fang Heng’s hand and slowly flowed into the mark on the back of Fang Heng’s hand.
Mo Jianghe noticed the change in the piece of paper and narrowed his eyes.
Mo Jiawei, on the other hand, was different. The piece of paper burned up in his hand.
Similarly, both of them fell into a dazed state at the same time. Two burning flames reflected in their pupils.
Mo Jianghe could clearly see that the color of the flames in his eyes represented the player’s fire of origin.
To a certain extent, the fire of origin also represented the player’s talent in sealing techniques.
From the color, Mo Jiawei’s talent was normal, while Fang Heng’s talent was extremely weak.
This meant that the two of them would not be able to develop their sealing techniques in the long run.
After a while, Fang Heng was the first to wake up.

He felt like a long time had passed just now. A large number of miscellaneous memories were imprinted in the depths of his mind. It was extremely clear, and he could easily find relevant information with just a thought.
At the same time, a line of game hints appeared on his retina.
[Hint: Player has acquired skill-basic sealing technique.]
[Hint: Initial talent strength of your seal technique: 23.1 (extremely weak).]
[Hint: You are not suitable to cultivate the sealing technique. It is recommended that you choose another method to cultivate it.]
Skill: Basic seal (Level 1).
Skill description: This skill can be upgraded to Level 10 at the most. After you reach level 10, you can try to advance your skill.

Skill description: Seal an item into a specially made card, sealing probability, sealing success rate, and effect duration are related to the player’s skill level, current status, current basic attribute and so on. (Your current level cannot perform permanent seals.)
Fang Heng looked at the game hint and fused the information flow into his brain.
So that was it. This was the sealing technique.
From the point of view of the sealing technique, anything could be sealed.
So...
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat as he realized that something was wrong.
According to the theory of the sealing technique, his zombie clone could also be sealed!
Normal seals were fine, but special seals, such as permanently sealing a zombie in a card...
Therefore, to him, the zombie clone was sealed instead of dead, which meant that it couldn’t be resurrected.
The solution was...
His zombies need to become stronger.
The stronger the creature, the more difficult it was to seal.
Fang Heng felt that he had encountered a difficult problem.
Fortunately, at this stage, he wouldn’t be able to meet high-level players like the sealer in the low-tier game.
“The new students in Room 2325 next door are all new students who have just entered the school for less than ten years. Go and learn from them. Teacher Cheng will tell you how to do it.”
“Okay, thank you, teacher.”
Fang Heng nodded and left the room with Mo Jiawei who had just woken up.

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - Talent
paragraphs: After watching Fang Heng and Mo Jiangwei leave, Mo Jianghe gulped down a mouthful of wine.
It was difficult to learn the art of sealing, and it was even harder to master it!
In addition to outstanding talent, it also required constant practice.
Once the talent was mediocre, the achievements were bound to be limited.
In the face of talent, it was hard to find even one person out of a million who could make up for the lack of talent with diligence.
He had seen many people who had a brief period of enthusiasm.
Especially that brat Mo Jiawei!
Next door, Room 2235.
There were more than thirty players scattered in the room.
The players here were all much younger.
Fang Heng was still secretly shocked by what he saw.
Each of these people had spent at least 100 King of Gods’ points to learn the sealing technique.
It seemed that in the advanced game world, the method for players to obtain King of Gods’ points was not as difficult as he had imagined.
Mo Jiawei exchanged a few words with Teacher Cheng, then returned to Fang Heng’s side with two wooden cups and some casting materials.
The most basic sealing technique was relatively simple.
Using a special mix of casting ink, a simple sealing rune was carved on a piece of paper.
After the rune was carved, it would be effective for a few minutes. The person who sealed it would need to use the rune to seal the object.
Mo Jiawei looked around curiously. He noticed that a student was sitting on a futon beside him in a daze, so he patted him.
“Brother, how long have you been here?”
That student looked at Mo Jiawei and sighed. “More than three years.”
“So long?”
Mo Jiawei was a little surprised.
“Three years is nothing. I’m considered young here. Most of the people here have practiced for more than five years.”
“Ah?”

“What’s so good about it? Talent is limited. For those of us with talent ratings below excellent, we can only slowly get through it. It’s still considered good here. As long as we pay the money, we can study for 10 years.”
“Oh?” Mo Jiawei answered casually, “I just came here. How should I learn it?”

“It’s quite simple.” The student pointed at the bottle on the low table in front of him, “After learning the basic sealing technique, you can try to seal this bottle into the card. Every time the seal is successful, you will gain some experience points for the sealing technique. When you reach Level 10 for the sealing technique, you will have completed it.”
“Is it very difficult?”
The student looked at Mo Jiawei up and down, “That depends on the person.”
“Eh, I don’t quite understand. Can you explain it to me?”

The student sighed, he said, “To put it bluntly, it has something to do with talent. The stronger the talent, the higher the success rate of completing the seal and the more experience points you get after successfully sealing. The gap in talent would become more obvious. What’s your talent again?”
“Talent score: 55 points. Normal.”
“That’s all? With your talent, no matter how hard you try, you’ll need at least 20 to 30 years to get started.”
“Ah? It can’t be that bad, right?” Mo Jiawei rolled up his sleeves, rubbed his hands and said unwillingly, “Let me give it a try.”
The rune of the most basic seal was also very simple. Mo Jiawei bit his finger and gently dipped it in the special casting ink in the bowl. With a stroke, he drew a clear sealing rune on the paper.
“Pa!”
The rune paper was stuck on the bottle.
A faint light flashed.
The bottle disappeared and a cup appeared on the pattern on the card.
“Haha! It worked!”
“What the f*ck? This works?”
That student was also shocked and he looked at Mo Jiawei with a strange expression.
This kid’s luck was too good!
With a talent rating of 55, theoretically, the success rate was around 1%.
He actually succeeded on the first try?
“Pu!”
Mo Jiawei had just picked up the sealing paper. Before he had the time to examine it carefully, the card in his hand exploded with a “Pu” sound.

The wooden cup that fell from the air was steadily caught by the student. “Your luck seems to be pretty good. Take your time to learn it. The sealing technique is different from other things. The requirement to advance is very troublesome. You need to be patient.”
Mo Jiawei looked back at Fang Heng with a bitter face.
“Let me give it a try.”
Fang Heng imitated Mo Jiawei. He bit his finger and quickly dipped it in some ink. He quickly wrote a rune and stuck it to the cup.
“Pa!”
The cup remained where it was.
A game hint quickly swept across his vision.
[Hint: Judgement failed. Player’s seal was incomplete.]
“Tsk, failed.”
Judging from the sealing technique information that poured into his mind, biting his finger and using his own blood could slightly increase the probability of completing the seal.
It did not seem to be of much use.
Every production probably required mental strength and vitality, and even some HP.
Fang Heng lowered his head and calculated.
This way, he would have room for manoeuvre.
Fang Heng thought of the zombie clone in the game world.
His talent was limited?
It didn’t matter, he could make up for it with hard work!
Thinking of this, Fang Heng patted Mo Jiawei’s shoulder and said, “Old Mr. Mo, don’t waste time. Let’s go back to the game first. We still have a lot of things to deal with.”
After saying that, Fang Heng put down the wooden cup in his hand and walked to Teacher Cheng who was standing at the edge of the podium.
“Hello, Teacher Cheng, sorry to trouble you. May I bring some of the rune paper and the casting materials needed to make medicinal ingredients back for practice?”

Teacher Cheng glanced at the young master of North River Heavy Industry behind Fang Heng. He nodded and said, “Yes, you can. Normal paper will do. As for the casting materials, they have a limited shelf life and need to be used as soon as possible. By the way, how much do you want? I’ll register it.”
“Um...” Fang Heng pondered for a moment, then exchanged a look with Mo Jiawei. “Let’s take five tons first.”
Teacher Cheng raised his head in surprise. “Huh? What did you say?”
District 8.
Late at night.
The ground was full of coal.
At first, Fang Heng used a glass cup.
Later, Fang Heng found that the glass cup was too fragile and the entire storage room was filled with the sound of glass breaking, so he changed it to coal ore.
[Hint: Your zombie clone failed to seal the coal ore.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone failed to seal the coal ore...]
He waited for a full eight minutes!
The twenty zombie clones stuck seven rounds of seals. Finally, a hint appeared in front of Fang Heng.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has completed the seal on the coal ore. You have gained 0.001 experience points for basic sealing techniques.]
Only 0.001 experience points?
“Isn’t this a little too much...”
While he was muttering to himself, a line of game hints refreshed once again.
[Hint: Player has completed the sealing technique for the first time.]
[Hint: Player’s skill-occult ritual (binding soul seal) has activated a new special ability.]
“Eh?”
Fang Heng let out a soft “eh” sound. He could not help but reach out his hand and look at the mark on the back of his hand before opening the skill description.
Skill-occult ritual (binding soul seal).
Level: Tier 1.
Skill description 1: After mastering this skill, you can synchronize your basic attribute skill into the game world. Current synchronization rate: 100%.
Skill description 2: You can directly enter the game through the ritual seal.
Skill description 3: Skill-low-efficiency energy storage.
Special ability 1 (Main World): Outside of the game, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.

Special ability 2 (Vampire Apocalypse): You will not be affected by the distortion of the Vampire Apocalypse game world. In the Vampire Apocalypse game, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.

Special ability 3 (Zombie Apocalypse): You will not be affected by the distortion of the Zombie Apocalypse game world. In the Zombie Apocalypse game, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.

Special ability 4 (Nightmare Hell): You will not be affected by the distortion of the Nightmare Hell game world. In the Nightmare Hell game, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes and your sealing talent will receive an extremely weak increase.
Fang Heng was stunned.
Special ability 4 was a new ability! It did not appear before!
It was triggered after he completed the seal!
It was slightly different from the previous few skills, skill 4 had an additional talent upgrade?
As he was thinking, a game hint appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
[Hint: You have completed the sealing technique. Through skill-occult ritual, your sealing technique talent has increased by 0.001.]
