chapters.title: Chapter 492 - Expansion, Maxed out
paragraphs: His talent level increased?!
Fang Heng was pleasantly surprised.
This was the best news!

Unlike other skills in the game, because his initial talent was weak, the success rate of sealing the wooden cup was around 0.6%, every time the sealing skill succeeded, only 0.001 experience points would be gained.
No wonder the students in the gym spent more than 10 years to complete it!
Fang Heng did not know what other shortcuts could increase the efficiency of leveling the skill in the advanced game world.
Fortunately, he could hack!

In addition, the occult ritual could increase the effect of his talent. Although it could only increase by 0.001 points each time, as long as he was given enough time to develop, he would use hundreds of clones to continuously farm experience points, his trash talent could also be maxed out!
Fang Heng’s spirit was lifted.

At this stage, the zombie clones that stayed in District 8 had to bear a large amount of work, such as smelting and producing various ores, making tools and grinding tools, planting and gathering, and so on.
Now was the crucial time to complete the main storyline mission.
Stop production!
Fang Heng immediately ordered the zombie clones to stop production and gathered the zombie team to the basement.
Target the sealing technique!
With that, there wasn’t enough space in the basement.
It needed to be expanded.
Fang Heng thought about it and opened the shelter page to observe.
During this period of time, Fang Heng was fighting with the Federation in District 7. The development of the prison in District 8 was entrusted to Mo Jiawei and Liao Bufan.
Fang Heng checked carefully and found that the prison shelter had already met the requirements for Tier 4 level up.

Thinking back, he remembered that Liao Bufan came to him not long ago to discuss the expansion of the prison. However, he was too busy rushing to District 7 to fight with the Federation, so he couldn’t be distracted, so the matter was temporarily put on hold.
What was he waiting for?
Expansion!
Maxed out!
Full maxed out!
Fang Heng opened the custom building page and began to plan the expansion of the prison.

[Hint: Refer to player’s blueprints (custom). Currently, the expansion of the prison shelter requires wooden planks*601,100, wooden frames*207,100, nails*74,700, elite iron ores*237,800, stones*205,500, firewood*290,100...]
[Hint: You have completed the fourth expansion of the shelter. Overall judgment, your shelter level has been upgraded to Level 178.]
[Hint: Currently, your shelter can accommodate up to 420 players. If you exceed the capacity, your shelter will be more vulnerable to zombie attacks at night.]
[Hint: Your shelter’s durability has been increased by 800%.]
[[Hint: Your survival radio has been upgraded again. The attractiveness of your shelter to the survivors in the outside world has been increased.]
It was done!

After the fourth expansion of the building, the exterior did not look any different. The only difference was that the wooden door frame had been replaced with refined iron, and the floor was covered with a layer of hardwood.
In fact, the overall defense of the entire prison had been greatly improved, and the internal space had been expanded by a full third!
Fang Heng left the room and walked along the basement pathway. He pushed open the door and walked into the newly opened temporary workshop.
A room that was the size of a football field!
It was enough!
Everything was ready!
Begin! Do it!
Fang Heng rubbed his hands together and commanded the zombie clones that were crowding the prison square to enter the workshop one by one.
Next, he placed the materials needed for the practice seal.
[Hint: You have discovered an unknown sample (No. 3). The unknown sample (No. 3) has been discovered for the first time. You have obtained 2,000 main storyline contribution points.]
Mission name: Unknown sample body.
Mission description: You have discovered an unknown sample body.
Mission requirements: Unknown sample body. You can obtain more relevant information through the research project of the shelter.
“Unknown tissue sample?”
After receiving the game hint, the chief commander of District 8, Han Jiong, looked at the tissue sample in the metal box and pondered.
After reaching a preliminary agreement with Fang Heng, the Federation obtained a vague coordinate point from Fang Heng.
After a careful search, the Federation found a strange box in the abandoned research institute at the coordinate point.
The box was escorted to the shelter and opened by Han Jiong himself, triggering the mission.

The person in charge of the Intelligence Department of District 8 stared at the tissue sample in the box and said, “The preliminary judgment is that the sample may be related to the Scavenger Army in the late-stage of the game.”

“We will immediately confirm the information and evaluate it. At this stage, I think this sample may be related to another main storyline mission that has never been discovered before. Its main storyline level may be higher than what has been discovered before.”
“Okay.”
Han Jiong nodded and reached out to touch the tempered glass on the cultivation pod.
“Immediately mobilize all the research personnel Level B and above in all the shelters in District 8 of the Federation to focus on the analysis of the unknown sample.”
“Yes!”
Chen Yu, who was following behind Han Jiong, felt strange.
He asked, “Sir, are we going to carry out the analysis now? Aren’t we going to return the sample to Fang Heng?”

Han Jiong glanced at Chen Yu and ignored his question. He continued, “Act as soon as possible. We need to complete the sample development immediately and think of a way to trigger the follow-up mission!”
“Understood!”
Chen Yu felt that something was wrong and asked again, “Sir!”
Han Jiong turned around and looked at Chen Yu. “Chen Yu, what are you trying to say?”
Chen Yu took a deep breath. “Sir, aren’t we going to send the item back to the Dark Knights? We have an agreement with Fang Heng. After we get the box, we will return it to them immediately.”
“Chen Yu, think about it carefully. Fang Heng is our potential competitor.”

Han Jiong continued, “We have already triggered the main storyline mission. The sample in our hands is very likely to be a tool related to triggering the main storyline mission. Do you think we should return it to Fang Heng?”
“But... we have an agreement...”
“Agreement? Indeed, we have an agreement, but we did not say when we would return the box to him.”

Han Jiong shook his head and looked away from Chen Yu, “There’s a high chance that the unknown sample is related to the follow-up main storyline mission. Do you want to see the main storyline mission fall into the hands of an ordinary player? What if one day, Fang Heng is controlled?”

“Fang Heng’s performance in District 7 doesn’t make me feel at ease. Controlling the future in our own hands is the most reassuring. We have to seize the time to take the initiative to study the unknown sample and trigger the next mission as soon as possible.”
Chen Yu looked at Han Jiong.
He felt that he had been deceived.
No matter how much Han Jiong tried to quibble, the truth was they had betrayed the agreement.
He believed that Han Jiong had already planned the subsequent break-up with Fang Heng from the very beginning.
Han Jiong was using his relationship with Fang Heng to swindle the main storyline mission from Fang Heng!
Other than the anger from being deceived, Chen Yu was more worried now.
If they angered Fang Heng and the incident in District 7 happened again in District 8...

Fang Heng was pleasantly surprised.
This was the best news!

Unlike other skills in the game, because his initial talent was weak, the success rate of sealing the wooden cup was around 0.6%, every time the sealing skill succeeded, only 0.001 experience points would be gained.
No wonder the students in the gym spent more than 10 years to complete it!
Fang Heng did not know what other shortcuts could increase the efficiency of leveling the skill in the advanced game world.
Fortunately, he could hack!
In addition, the occult ritual could increase the effect of his talent.

Although it could only increase by 0.001 points each time, as long as he was given enough time to develop, he would use hundreds of clones to continuously farm experience points, his trash talent could also be maxed out!
Fang Heng’s spirit was lifted.

At this stage, the zombie clones that stayed in District 8 had to bear a large amount of work, such as smelting and producing various ores, making tools and grinding tools, planting and gathering, and so on.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - Farm
paragraphs: “Sir, Fang Heng, he...”

“There’s no need to say anymore.” The corners of Han Jiong’s mouth revealed a look of disdain, “We’ve already obtained the unknown sample and triggered the main storyline mission. Even if Fang Heng completely breaks away from us and refuses to tell us the follow-up main storyline, we’ve already entered the trap.”
“Chen Yu, don’t be naive. Fang Heng also obtained a large number of materials from us. This is a collaboration, he won’t lose out.”

Han Jiong’s tone softened, “I don’t want to fall out with Fang Heng either. Fang Heng is not our enemy, but the Night Owl organization is. You and Fang Heng are old friends. Go and persuade him. Communicate with him calmly and let him tell us the remaining unknown sample locations. In exchange, we are willing to pay a higher price.”
Chen Yu clenched his fists tightly, closed his eyes and shook his head. “I refuse.”
“It seems that you made a wrong choice.” Han Jiong took a deep breath and said, “From now on, Chen Yu will be quarantined.”
“Go back and think about it. Without you, we still have someone to communicate with Fang Heng.”
Two hours later.
Lucia and Mo Jiawei arrived at the door of the newly-built basement workshop.
“Fang Heng is inside?”
“I think so...”
Mo Jiawei decided to give it a try.
After all, he had just received the news that the prison had been expanded. He saw that several new workshops had been built in the prison shelter.
He searched for half a circle but didn’t find Fang Heng. He thought that Fang Heng should be in these two newly-built rooms.
Lucia knocked on the door of the basement workshop.
“Fang Heng, are you there? It’s me, Lucia. We’re ready to go.”
“Okay, please come in.”
Lucia pushed the door open and entered.
Seeing the scene in the room, Lucia stood at the door and was momentarily stunned.
She felt as if she had entered a super-sized factory.
The zombies lined up in orderly rows in a room as big as a football field, sitting cross-legged on the ground.
In front of each zombie, there was a small bowl, a small wooden cup and a stack of paper.
Strangely, the zombies were drawing something on the paper and then sticking the paper to the wooden cup.
What were they doing?
“I will...”
Following Lucia into the room, Mo Jiawei was also stunned. He couldn’t help but spit out two words.
Mass production of seals?
He couldn’t understand what Fang Heng was doing.
What was the meaning of mass production?
“You’re here.”
Fang Heng had just finished arranging 90% of the production line. He wiped the sweat from his forehead and hurried over from the back of the hall.
The assembly line greatly increased the efficiency of sealing skills and talents.
The game hint in the lower right corner of Fang Heng’s retina was still refreshing.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has failed to seal.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has failed to seal.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has failed to seal...]
Although the success rate was low, the experience points and talent points of basic sealing techniques were rising continuously under the accumulation of tens of thousands of times.
With the increase in skill level and talent points, the zombie clone’s sealing success rate gradually increased from 0.6% to 0.9%. The efficiency was once again increased, forming a positive cycle.
The feeling of accelerating and becoming stronger was simply exhilarating!
“Why? Is there something urgent?”

Lucia moved her gaze away from the zombies and looked at Fang Heng. She nodded and said, “Fang Heng, the next target point marked by Tang Bai is ready. We can set off at any time to look for Hila’s tissue sample.”
“Okay, get ready. We’ll set off in half an hour.”

Previously, they had obtained two tissue samples of Hila in District 7. After completing the transformation of the two new fusion Tyrant forms, Fang Heng immediately had them stab each other to death and wait for the rebirth in District 8.
After half a day, together with the two newly born proliferators, Fang Heng now had four fusion Tyrant forms as his combat strength in District 8.
The four of them were enough to complete the mission of finding Hila’s tissue sample.

“Fang Heng,” Mo Jiawei shook his head, no longer thinking about these zombies. He then said to Fang Heng, “The people from the Federation have come. They brought all the materials here, saying that they want to talk to you face to face.”
“Eh? The person who came isn’t Chen Yu?”
“No?” Fang Heng glanced at the time. “Let’s go and take a look!”
“Mr. Fang Heng, I’m Xin Mengchao. I’m here on behalf of the Federation of District 8 to deliver the goods to you. Our first batch of goods has already been delivered to the prison.”
“You’re quite fast. Where’s Chen Yu?”

“We’ve encountered some trouble. Captain Chen is currently dealing with it urgently. In order not to waste any time, my superiors have assigned me to carry out the next step of the handover with you.”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. He had a premonition that something bad had happened.
The Federation!
They had made their move!
Fang Heng remained expressionless and continued to laugh. “Is that so? Is Chen Yu alright?”
“It’s not a big problem. Perhaps he’ll be a little busy during this period of time.”
“Send my regards to him. How’s the box at the previous coordinates? Have you found it?”
“En, we’re still in the process of searching. We were wondering if you could provide us with more locations so that we can deploy earlier. What do you think?”
“Oh, I see... you guys have to hurry up.” Fang Heng sneered in his heart. He said calmly, “I’ll provide you with two more coordinates. We’ll complete this stage of the mission before Night Owl.”

“Alright, alright. We’ll do it as soon as possible.” Xin Mengchao glanced at Mo Jiawei who was beside Fang Heng, he suggested, “Fang Heng, why don’t we stay here for this period of time? If there’s any news from the Federation, we can immediately communicate with them. What do you think?”
“That’s great! That would be my wish! I’ll get someone to bring you to your room to rest.”
“Thank you.”
After watching the NPC leave with Xin Mengchao, Fang Heng turned his head to look at Tang Bai.
“He’s lying. Hila’s tissue at the target point has already been moved.”
As Tang Bai spoke, he pointed at a point on the map. “It’s currently at this place.”
“F*ck, I knew those b*stards from the Federation couldn’t be trusted!”
Mo Jiawei exploded upon hearing that. He slammed the table angrily and cursed, “Fang Heng, what do we do now? Are we going to fall out with them?”
“There’s no need to be in such a hurry to fall out with them. give them two more remote coordinates and let them continue to help us find the samples.”
Fang Heng spread his hands.
Those idiots from the Federation still thought that they could compete with him for the ownership of the main storyline mission?

Originally, most of the locations of the remaining 11 Hila’s cell tissues were in remote areas. There wasn’t even a teleportation array nearby. The difficulty level of collecting them wasn’t that high, however, it would take a lot of time.
Fang Heng had originally planned to hand them over to the people of the Federation to search for them so that everyone could work together.

Now, since the Federation was rather greedy and wanted to snatch the Hila’s tissue samples, he would satisfy them and let them collect more. When the time came, he would capture them all and snatch them from their hands!
If it wasn’t for the special reward for completing the 3S-level hidden endings, Fang Heng would have directly handed over the mission to the Federation of District 8 to complete it.
“Ah? Giving them coordinates? What if, what if they...”
Mo Jiawei couldn’t come up with a reason even after a long time.
“What if what?”
That’s right!
After giving it some thought, Mo Jiawei suddenly understood.
So what if the Federation obtained a portion of the Hila’s tissue sample?
Would they be able to create two fusion Tyrant forms?
Fang Heng’s contribution points were already far ahead of the rest of the players.
After the Federation obtained Hila’s tissue sample, it would take them ten days to half a month to figure out what the sample was.
In reality, the Federation’s sneaky actions posed no threat to them at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - Living Creature Seal
paragraphs: Fang Heng already had a plan.
The Federation had no idea that with Tang Bai around, Fang Heng would have a global positioning radar.
He knew the exact coordinates of Hila’s tissue samples!
When the time came, when the Federation had almost collected all the hila tissue samples from the remote areas, they would go rob them and obtain all the Hila’s tissue samples.

Other than that, if he guessed correctly, the Federation must have thought that they were good at fighting. In order to obtain the main storyline mission, they would most likely gather all the senior researchers to conduct research on Hila’s tissue sample.
At that time, they might even be able to think of a way to poach the high-tier research NPCs from the Federation.
He was good at figuring out their plan!
The only problem left now was the seal.

Fang Heng thought about it and glanced at the mission log. Nearly 1,000 zombie clones had been hacking for more than half an hour, and the basic sealing technique had been successfully upgraded to Level 2!
Hacking to gain experience was still awesome!
He estimated that it would take some time to hack to the maximum level, so he couldn’t stay idle during this time. He had to find a way to speed up the collection of Hila’s sample.
Fang Heng gave Mo Jiawei a look.
“Old Mr. Mo, go and communicate with the people of the Federation. Think of a way to get more resources from them. It would be best if they are researchers. That’s what we are lacking right now.”
“No problem.”

Fang Heng opened the game log and controlled the four fusion Tyrant forms to gather at the prison’s teleportation hall. Then, he looked at Lucia and said, “Lucia, let’s go. Let’s go look for Hila’s tissue sample.”
“Okay!”
“Fang Heng went to District 8?”
The next day, Kou Huai received the news.
His first instinct was that there was something wrong with this matter!
Kou Huai immediately dialed the intelligence department’s internal line. “Xiao Changle, what’s the Scavenger Army’s latest movement?”
“The super-sized zombie wave is still raging. The Scavenger Army has also been greatly affected. They are still in a defensive state and have barely shown their faces in the past two days.”
“What about the spies planted in the Scavenger Army? What kind of feedback did they give?”
“They were sent away on purpose long ago. We couldn’t find any useful information.”
Kou Huai secretly felt that something was wrong.
There must be something wrong!
It was very likely that Fang Heng had deliberately created false information to make people believe that he went to District 8!
Combined with the two days of peace in the Scavenger Army, Kou Huai felt that Fang Heng must be planning something big in the dark.
The purpose of spreading false news was to lower the vigilance of District 7?
Kou Huai was not sure what Fang Heng was up to, but he was still panicking.
“I got it. Report to me as soon as you have any news.”
Kou Huai hung up the phone and looked at the soldier who walked into his office.
The man’s face was twisted and returned to a familiar face.
“Ji Qiubei.”
Kou Huai turned his head and looked at the door behind Ji Qiubei. “I told you that we don’t meet unless it’s necessary.”
Ji Qiubei closed the door and smiled warmly. “Commander Kou is careful and thoughtful, which is admirable.”
Kou Huai snorted.
“What the hell is Fang Heng doing? Why did he make up some fancy smoke bombs and say that he was going to District 8?”
“Hehehe...” Ji Qiubei laughed. “It’s not a smoke bomb. Fang Heng is in District 8.”
“Impossible. With my understanding of Fang Heng, he has no reason to give up District 7.”
“Then it seems that your understanding of Fang Heng is not enough.”
“What do you mean?”
“I have personally confirmed that Fang Heng is in District 8.”
“You are also in District 8?”
“Don’t worry, leave Fang Heng to me this time. Our Night Owl’s control over District 8 is beyond your imagination.”
Kou Huai’s pupils constricted. He seemed to have thought of something and stared at Ji Qiubei. “You mean...”
“Shh.”
Ji Qiubei made a gesture to keep quiet.

“Now that things have come to this, I suggest that you don’t think too much and focus on cooperating with us.” Ji Qiubei licked his lips, “This time, Fang Heng has helped me a lot. In short, I want both District 5 and District 8. District 7 belongs to you.”
Kou Huai took a deep breath. “How did he get to District 8?”

“I’m not sure. Theoretically, we have already cut off the mission line of District 8 in advance. District 8 is unable to establish a Grade 3 teleportation passage. District 8 is currently in the new server protection zone. Other districts are also unable to forcefully enter District 8 through the spatial rift...”
Ji Qiubei had never been able to figure this out.

“It’s possible to achieve such an ability with an extremely rare S-level spatial teleportation talent and an upgrade of S-level talent. However, I prefer to believe that this was possible due to some high-grade tools. Usually, these tools can be used several times.”

Ji Qiubei was unwilling to waste time on such a problem, “In short, I will handle Fang Heng’s matter. After confirming that Fang Heng is not in District 7, now is the best opportunity for us to attack the Scavenger Army. Don’t waste this opportunity.”
“I understand.”
Kou Huai nodded.
Ji Qiubei continued to ask, “How much longer do you need to prepare?”

“Three to four days. Activating the stabilizer requires a large amount of energy. District 7 does not have a lot of energy reserves, and it has consumed a lot recently. We are in the process of preparation.”
“Okay. Four days later, the Scavenger Army will be destroyed. After that, District 7 will belong to you.”

Hint: You have completed the sealing technique. Through skill-occult ritual, your sealing technique talent has increased by 0.001].
Hint: Your sealing technique initial talent strength: 83.1 (Good). You are more suitable to cultivate the sealing technique.]
After the sealing technique had reached Level 5, the experience points gained had stagnated!
The journey was smooth. Fang Heng swept through an abandoned research institute of the Meteorite Company and obtained a tissue sample of Hila before rushing back to the prison.
The first thing he did was head to the basement workshop to check on the sealing technique’s leveling situation.
On the way, Fang Heng searched through the knowledge related to the sealing technique in his mind.
Under normal circumstances, after the level of the basic sealing technique had reached Level 5, sealing ordinary objects would no longer be able to gain experience points.
At this time, he needed to seal something more difficult to gain experience points.
For example, a living creature with a life form!
Generally speaking, the stronger the life form, the higher the intelligence level, and the larger the body, the more difficult the seal would be.
Fang Heng thought for a moment, then took out a bottle from his backpack.
In the bottle was a small ladybug that was still crawling.
Then, Fang Heng called over a dozen zombie clones to come over with the sealing materials, then poured the ladybug out of the bottle and dropped it on the ground.
More than ten zombies came over and formed a circle to cast a sealing spell on the ladybug.
The ladybug had never seen such a scene before. It curled up on the ground and pretended to be dead.
A row of game hints quickly refreshed on Fang Heng’s retina.
[Hint: Your zombie clone has failed to seal.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone has failed to seal...]

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - Ladybug
paragraphs: Compared to sealing the wooden cup, the success rate of sealing a living creature had decreased once again!
Fang Heng patiently waited for 10 minutes before the hint of successful sealing appeared in his vision.

[Hint: Your zombie clone has completed the sealing of the coal ore. You have received 0.001 experience points for basic sealing skills. Through skill-occult ritual, your sealing skill talent has increased by 0.001.]
It was done!!
Fang Heng immediately held the piece of paper in his hand and observed it.
[Item: Sealed card: Ladybug.]
Description: There is a ladybug sealed in this piece of card.
There were fine lines drawn on the normal piece of card. There was a ladybug in the center of the card.
Even though the success rate of sealing was only around 0.8%, as long as the scale of the sealing increased and the assembly line was created...
Wait a minute...
Just as he was rejoicing, Fang Heng suddenly thought of something.
His heart started beating faster and faster.
“It seems to be possible...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself as he tried to stuff the card sealed with the ladybug into the player’s backpack.
It worked!!
It really worked!
The card could be stuffed into the player’s backpack!!
Before Fang Heng’s excitement subsided, another hint flashed in the game log.
[Hint: The seal in your backpack has failed.]
Fang Heng frowned and opened his backpack to take a look.
There was a dead ladybug in his backpack.
Looking at the dead ladybug in his backpack, Fang Heng stroked his chin and muttered to himself, “Seal...”
Fang Heng was even more certain of his previous guess!
First of all, at this stage, seals could be used on living objects.
Secondly, after the live sample was sealed into the card, the card could be put into the backpack! It could even be stacked.
Combining the above two points, he came up with a deduction.
That meant...
Fang Heng looked at the zombie clones beside him.
If he sealed a large number of zombie clones and threw them into the backpack...
Under ideal conditions, he could carry a large number of zombies with him?!
He would no longer need the zombie clones to commit suicide in order to teleport from a long distance!
Let’s give it a try!
Fang Heng called a Licker to enter the basement workshop.
Seventeen or eighteen zombie clones immediately surrounded the Licker and placed a seal on it.
Larger and stronger life forms had a lower success rate of sealing them.
After a short while, the Licker was covered with small cards. At first glance, it looked a little comical.
After nearly a thousand attempts, a game hint appeared.
[Hint: Your zombie has completed the sealing of the Licker. You have obtained...]
It worked!!
Fang Heng didn’t even finish reading the game hint. He directly held the sealed card in his hand and observed it.
Licker’s sealed card!
Exquisite!
[Hint: You have obtained the sealed card: zombie clone-Licker proliferator.]
The card flashed with a weak light in Fang Heng’s hand. It disappeared instantly and was stuffed into his backpack.
He had really succeeded!
He didn’t need to carry too many sealed cards with him. He just needed to carry a few fusion Tyrant form sealed cards with him for life-saving.
With him carrying them around, his strength would definitely increase greatly!
Fang Heng was secretly excited. A line of game hints appeared on his retina again.
[Hint: Your seal has failed. Your zombie clone-Licker dies (proliferator).]
Bang!
Seeing the hint, Fang Heng cursed in his heart again.
After the seal had failed, the Licker in his backpack would also die along with it, leaving no corpse behind.
Even so, Fang Heng didn’t feel dejected at all.
He was full of fighting spirit now!
Fang Heng was very clear that he only had Level 5 basic sealing technique.

He just needed to spend some time to make up for his shortcomings. When his skill level reached Level 10 and his basic sealing technique leveled up to elementary sealing technique, he would be able to learn the technique to quickly lift the seal and greatly prolong the sealing time!
After that, as the sealing technique leveled up continuously to the intermediate sealing technique, permanent sealing could be done!
When the time comes, with a few hundred fusion Tyrant forms, he could go anywhere and defeat others...
Fang Heng currently wanted to shout out, “The sealing technique! Invincible!”
Taking a deep breath, Fang Heng adjusted his state of mind.

He still had nearly a day and a half to collect all the tissue samples of Hila. The most important thing is to upgrade the level of the basic sealing technique as soon as possible to the elementary sealing technique level, and master the method of permanent sealing so that he could permanently seal the tissue samples of Hila!

If everything went smoothly, the nearly 1,000 zombie clones would hack overnight. The next morning, they would be able to raise the basic sealing technique to Level 10. At that time, he would look for Seventh Uncle to advance the elementary sealing technique!
This plan would work!

With that thought, Fang Heng turned on the survival radio and hurriedly sent a message to Mo Jiawei, “Old Mr. Mo, help me get some small insects like ladybugs, preferably those that are docile and can’t run around randomly. I need a lot of them and this matter is very urgent and crucial!”
After hurriedly getting the zombies to tidy up the room, Fang Heng began to arrange and modify the assembly line for the next stage.
Compared to the previous assembly line of the sealed wooden cups, it was much more troublesome to seal the live sample this time!
Considering that there were fewer insects to seal at this stage, the efficiency of a few zombies working together to seal one insect was relatively high.
“I still have to consider the situation where the insects are accidentally killed.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself as he thought about the layout of the assembly line. Then, he took another big gulp of coffee.
Tonight, he was going to charge through again.

In the prison shelter, Mo Jiawei just had a battle of wits with Xin Mengchao of the Federation to decide on the next batch of materials and resources to be sent to the shelter. He had also asked for three A-level researchers from the Federation. Before he could send Fang Heng any good news, he suddenly saw Fang Heng’s urgent message.
When he saw the contents of the urgent message, Mo Jiawei was stunned for a while.
Huh? Ladybug?
Why did God want that kind of thing?
He had played the game for so long, but he had never seen anyone buy ladybug.
No one would be selling this thing now!
Mo Jiawei scratched his hair.
Since there was no ready-made one, he could only find someone to catch it personally.
There were still a lot of small insects on the plains near the prison.
Thinking of this, Mo Jiawei immediately called for the players, NPC survivors, mercenaries and Dark Knights guards in the shelter to gather urgently. He gave them a mission to catch bugs outside.
The NPCs were still fine. After receiving the order, most of them began to carry out the mission.
When the players heard about the mission, they were all dumbfounded.
Catching bugs?
What was the prison shelter up to again?
Although they did not understand, the prison offered a really high price. They would obtain 300 survival points for catching a bug or they could stay in the prison for a week for free!
The players were overjoyed. One after another, they started to catch bugs outside the prison with flashlights.
The news that the Prison Army was rich enough to buy ladybugs quickly spread.
In addition to the player mercenary group, many players who were temporarily living in the prison also volunteered to join the search for bugs.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - Genius Level
paragraphs: Xin Mengchao stayed in the prison temporarily. Apart from communicating with the prison, he was also tasked with a special mission to investigate the prison’s movements.
When he noticed that the prison was suddenly in chaos in the middle of the night, Xin Mengchao immediately became alert.
He walked out of the room and pulled a player into the pathway. “Brother, I have something to ask you. It’s so noisy outside. What are you guys planning to do?”
“Catch ladybugs.”
“Huh?”
“I don’t have time to chat with you. You’ll know when you look it up on the internet. Hurry up and leave. Don’t hinder me from getting money.” That player glared at Xin Mengchao and left quickly.
Xin Mengchao’s brows were tightly knitted. He returned to his room and went offline. He opened the player forum in District 8.“”
“Brother! Bring the sacks and follow me! North River Heavy Industry prison is buying ladybugs! 300 survival points each! Only accept up to 100,000! While stocks last!”
Looking at the red and shiny hot spots on the eastern region forum, Xin Mengchao was instantly stumped.
Ladybugs?!
What was the prison up to this time?
Shouldn’t it be time to fight for the main storyline mission? Why did they start buying ladybugs?
Xin Mengchao had a bad premonition. He narrowed his eyes and pondered for a moment.
Fang Heng would never do something meaningless.
Not to mention that he had spent a large sum of money...
Could it be...
The ladybug was related to the next stage of the main storyline mission!?
That was definitely the case!
Xin Mengchao could not sit still.
It was very likely that Fang Heng was playing a very big game with high stakes.
He had to report this situation to his superiors immediately!
Waking up groggily from the bed, Fang Heng rubbed his eyes and shifted his gaze to the setting sun outside the window.
“Oh no! I overslept!”
Fang Heng woke up instantly and straightened up from his bed.

Last night, Fang Heng spent an entire night setting up the assembly line for Tier 2 live samples. It wasn’t until the next morning that all the ladybugs purchased from outside were in place, and the assembly line finally entered the automatic mode.
He had originally planned to go offline to take a nap, but he didn’t expect to sleep until noon.
Fang Heng quickly turned on his phone and looked at the time.
There were still 20 hours left before the announcement of District 8’s main storyline contribution ranking.
He had to hurry!
Fang Heng quickly put on his clothes, got out of bed and entered the game cabin.
As soon as he went online, a dense number of game hints refreshed.

[Hint: During the time you are offline, your zombie clone has completed the seal-ladybug*428,284. Your current sealing technique level has reached the upper limit of Level 10. You can find a way to increase the level of your seal skill and obtain a higher level.]

[Hint: Through skill-occult ritual, your sealing technique talent has increased by 0.001. Your current sealing technique talent strength: 545.287 (unique). You are a genius who practices sealing techniques.]
Success!
He had reached Level 10!
However, it seemed that he could continue to increase the strength of his talent?
Whatever! He had to think of a way to increase the level of his sealing technique first.
Since the assembly line was still functioning perfectly, Fang Heng decided to let the assembly line continue farming his talent and go offline on the spot.
After exiting the game, Fang Heng took a taxi to the gym.
In less than half an hour, Fang Heng returned to the gym.
In a hurry, Fang Heng was just about to run to the third floor to look for Mo Jianghe when he met Cheng Jingguo at the end of the pathway.
“Teacher Cheng.”
Fang Heng greeted him.
Cheng Jingguo knew Fang Heng and had a deep memory of him.
The ruthless person who asked him for five tons of ingredients yesterday.
It was all because of the young master of the Mo family.
In the end, Cheng Jingguo simply gave Fang Heng the formula and let Fang Heng take the ingredients and go home to make his own.
Cheng Jingguo adjusted his glasses and looked very calm.
He nodded and said, “Fang Heng, why are you in such a hurry? You can’t be impatient when practicing the sealing technique. Did you encounter some problems when practicing the sealing technique?”
“Yes, there’s a small problem. Is Teacher Mo around?”
“At this time, he should have gone to a restaurant on the neighboring street to eat.”
“Huh?”
“He’s used to eating in that restaurant. Wait until he has a class in the evening. He usually comes back at six o’clock. Teacher Mo doesn’t like to be disturbed when eating.”
Cheng Jingguo glanced at the time on his phone and said, “You can go have a meal first. If you’re looking for him to ask about the sealing technique, I should be able to answer it for you.”
“Thank you, Teacher Cheng.” Fang Heng nodded and thanked him. “Teacher Cheng, do you know how to level up the next stage of the basic sealing technique?”
Level up the basic sealing technique?
Cheng Jingguo frowned and felt a little displeased.
He looked Fang Heng up and down and wanted to advise him not to aim too high.
But he swallowed his words.
He had been young before, so it would be weird if he would listen to his advice.

Cheng Jingguo nodded and said, “It’s more troublesome to level up the sealing technique compared to learning it for the first time. First, you need to level up the basic sealing technique to the maximum level. After that, you can come to Mr. Mo or me.”
“I’ve already reached the maximum level.”
“Ah?”
Cheng Jingguo was surprised for a moment.
He suddenly understood.
Right, Fang Heng was a friend of the Mo Family’s young master.
Perhaps he had already learned the sealing technique in the game and was only one step away from leveling up.
In the game, although the number of items that could increase the sealing technique and experience points was extremely rare and expensive, they still existed.

“Alright, then follow me. The basic upgrade will cost 500 King of Gods’ points. It’s not for us, it’s for the game. You just need to prepare it in advance,” Cheng Jingguo explained to Fang Heng, “We will help you trigger the next stage of the mission chain in the game. After completing the mission, your sealing technique level will be upgraded to elementary level.”
“Don’t worry. The mission difficulty isn’t high. Our people from North River Heavy Industry are also helping you in the game.”
“Okay, thank you.”
Fang Heng felt that it was a little troublesome. He still had to do the mission?
Taking this into consideration, he might not be able to make it in time.

Cheng Jingguo led Fang Heng to the office and said, “By the way, we need to register. Which game are you in? Which district are you from? The missions in the game chain in each district are different.”
“Zombie Apocalypse, District 8.”
“Em, Zombie...”
Cheng Jingguo stopped mid-sentence.
He stood where he was, turned around and looked at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng saw him staring at him and couldn’t help but ask curiously, “Teacher Cheng? What’s wrong?”
Are you kidding me?
Zombie Apocalypse?
Isn’t that an elementary game?!
If Fang Heng wasn’t a friend of the young master of North River Heavy Industry, Cheng Jingguo would have kicked Fang Heng out right now.
Practicing high-tier sealing techniques in the elementary game would be heavily punished by the game, and the success rate of sealing techniques would be reduced.
Fang Heng had practiced the sealing techniques to Level 10 in the Zombie Apocalypse?
Was he a peerless genius who practiced the sealing arts?
Or was he one of those hotheads who had practiced the sealing arts for more than twenty years in the elementary game?
This is not bullshit!

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - The Crack
paragraphs: Cheng Jingguo was speechless for a long time.
However, seeing that Fang Heng’s expression didn’t look like he was joking, Cheng Jingguo was stunned.
He didn’t know whether Fang Heng was joking or not.
“Alright.”

Cheng Jingguo took a deep breath, “Then there’s nothing I can do. In the elementary game, there’s no way to trigger the next stage of the mission. At the very least, there’s no corresponding method in our database. Mr. Mo probably doesn’t have such a method either. You can come back later to confirm with Mr. Mo.”
Fang Heng’s heart sank.
At every critical moment, there would always be changes to the plan.
Fang Heng didn’t want to give up so quickly, so he continued to ask, “Teacher Cheng, can we only seal it permanently after the level of the sealing technique has reached the peak of elementary?”
Since in the game, Hila’s tissue sample was the main storyline mission, Fang Heng couldn’t go into detail. He could only roughly change the Hila sample to an analogy and describe it.
Fang Heng gestured, “If it’s an extremely special thing that can’t be killed or destroyed, can I seal it permanently?”
After listening to Fang Heng’s explanation patiently, Cheng Jingguo lowered his head and thought carefully for a moment. After thinking for a while, he nodded.
“Fang Heng, you need to understand something first. Theoretically speaking, a permanent seal doesn’t exist.”

“Time is the greatest enemy of seals. If it’s the strength of an A-level seal, after 100,000 to 200,000 years, the strength of the seal will drop to B-level. After a few million years, the strength of the seal will drop to C-level. After tens of millions of years, the seal may automatically be lifted.”
“If the sealed object is extremely powerful, then the time for the seal to be weakened will be greatly shortened.”
“From your description just now, the thing you described has some sort of undying ability. In theory, even a Level 20 elementary sealing technique would find it difficult to permanently seal it.”
Fang Heng felt even more uneasy. “Then what should we do? Teacher Cheng, is there any other way?”
“There is.”
“What?”
“The alternate dimension.” Cheng Jingguo opened his mouth to explain again. “You can open a hole to the alternate dimension and throw the sealed card into the alternate dimension.”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up, and he suddenly understood.
Oh right, there was still the alternate dimension!
Relevant information about the alternate dimension immediately appeared in Fang Heng’s mind.
It was a special space, very out of the ordinary, and the human’s understanding of it was also very limited.
As far as he knew, normal items and creatures would be repelled by the space.
But after being sealed, the card could easily pass through the alternate dimension spatial rift.
Therefore, for hundreds of millions of years, the alternate dimension had almost become a trash can for the sealers.
Anything that was unwanted, or any monster that could be sealed, was thrown into the alternate dimensional space.
Theoretically speaking, with so many miscellaneous items being thrown into it for hundreds of millions of years, the space should already be filled with all kinds of dangerous things.
However, in reality, it was almost never heard that there was any danger in the alternate dimensional space.
The alternate dimensional rift was more like a one-way passage. One could only enter but not exit. It was like a bottomless pit.
One only needed to throw the sealed artifact into the alternate dimension and it would disappear completely.
The only problem was that the thing that was thrown into the alternate dimension would never be found again.
A good place!
Fang Heng was overjoyed.

Therefore, he did not need any upgraded sealing technique to perform permanent sealing. He only needed to think of a way to open the alternate dimensional rift and throw the sealed Hila tissue into it!
Completely solve the mission!
Fang Heng thought and clenched his fist.
“Thank you, Teacher Cheng!”
After getting Cheng Jingguo’s answer, Fang Heng hurried to the materials claim room.
“It’s starting again, so impetuous...”
Cheng Jingguo watched Fang Heng leave and shook his head.
He had just taken a few steps forward when he saw Mo Jianghe walking up from the stairs on the other side of the pathway.
“Eh? Mr. Mo? Didn’t you go to eat today?”
“The chef at that restaurant is on vacation today, so I came back.” Mo Jianghe glanced in the direction where Fang Heng had left. “Is that Fang Heng? What were you guys talking about just now?”

“Fang Heng said that he wanted to learn the advanced sealing technique.” Cheng Jingguo smiled bitterly. “I told him that he couldn’t do it in the elementary game for the time being. Later, he even asked about the permanent seal, as if he wanted to seal something.”
“Is that so...”

“I told him that even the elementary sealing technique couldn’t do it permanently. Usually, when we encounter this kind of problem, we would choose to open the alternate dimensional spatial rift and throw the sealed artifact into the rift.”
“Yes, it’s indeed a very common way to deal with it. However, looking at how excited he is...”
Mo Jianghe looked in the direction where Fang Heng left and was deep in thought. “So he probably thought that a person could open the alternate dimensional spatial rift, right?”
Cheng Jingguo hesitated for a moment, recalling Fang Heng’s expression just now.
“That seems to be the case... Should I...”
“Young people are so energetic.” Mo Jianghe praised and pulled Cheng Jingguo. “Let’s go, let’s not eat dinner, let’s drink together.”
“No, Mr. Mo, we still have class later.”
“What are you afraid of? It’s not too late.”
Fang Heng walked toward the materials claim room.
Along the way, he carefully thought about the memories in his mind.
The alternate dimension was an extremely special space.
There were many ways to open the alternate dimension space.
For sealers, they needed to build a passage.
During the construction process, they needed to use part of the magic materials.
Fang Heng organized his thoughts along the way and came to the counter.
“Hello, Uncle Pang.”
Behind the counter, Pang Feilong was filling in the form and taking notes. When he raised his head and saw Fang Heng, his heart skipped a beat and he wiped his forehead out of habit.
He remembered the guy who asked for five tons of materials yesterday.
He was a ruthless person.
He had tormented him quite a bit.
“Fang Heng, you came to collect materials again today?”
“Yes, sorry to trouble you, Uncle Pang.”
Pang Feilong was somewhat traumatized by Fang Heng. “Don’t tell me you want another five tons of materials?”

“It’s not that.” Fang Heng scratched the back of his head, picked up the pen and paper on the table, and quickly wrote down the list of materials on it. He said, “Give me three sets of materials first. Do you have any free meditation rooms?”
Seeing that Fang Heng did not ask for five tons like last time, Pang Feilong heaved a sigh of relief.
“Yes, Room 1255 is empty now. You can use it. As for the materials...”
Pang Feilong took the list of materials that Fang Heng handed over and skimmed through it. He couldn’t help but frown slightly.
What Fang Heng wanted were extremely rare materials. Even they didn’t have much stock here.
Normally, these kinds of materials wouldn’t be released to ordinary students.
However...
Yesterday, Fang Heng came with the young master of North River Heavy Industry, Mo Jiawei.
“We have all the materials you need. Go to your room first. I’ll make some preparations. In ten minutes, I’ll send someone to send them to your room.”
“Thank you so much, Uncle Pang.”

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - The Rift
paragraphs: In the meditation room, Fang Heng sat cross-legged on the spot and meditated.
The construction of the dimensional crack required mental strength.
Therefore, he needed to adjust his body to its best condition.
After meditating for a full three hours, Fang Heng opened his eyes again.
After all the casting materials were prepared and mixed, there was only a small bowl placed in front of Fang Heng.
Fang Heng dipped his finger into the mixed potion and drew a simple mark on the floor.
The moment the mark was completed, a purple-red flame instantly rose into the air!
The flame burned fiercely in the air, reflecting Fang Heng’s face.
Fang Heng stared at the flame, his forehead covered in sweat.
He did not see the so-called wheel of seal in the flame, but he vaguely saw a huge door!
It was a very familiar door.
The patterns on the side of the door gradually revealed a strange creature.
Sometimes it was clear, sometimes it was illusory.
From this door, Fang Heng felt a sense of disorder and chaos.
The door slowly opened before his eyes.
A game message flashed in the corner of his vision.
[Hint: Player’s skill-occult ritual (binding soul seal) unlock special ability.]

Special ability 5 (Alternate Dimension Hell): You will not be affected by the distortion of the Alternate Dimension Hell game world. In the Alternate Dimension Hell game, you will receive an additional 10% increase in all attributes.
Fang Heng was extremely focused at this moment. He did not even realize that the message had been refreshed.
“Dong!!!”
A heavy knock sounded as if it had hit his heart.
Fang Heng’s body shook.
At the same time, in the study hall on the third floor, Mo Jianghe, who had drunk too much and was dozing off, suddenly woke up.
In the huge room, all the students who were practicing sealing felt something at the same time.
The sealing in their hands all failed instantly without exception.
Everyone raised their heads and looked at Mo Jianghe.
“Click.”
The door of the room was pushed open from the outside.
Cheng Jingguo looked at Mo Jianghe in the room.
He didn’t say a word, but the surprise and confusion in his eyes had completely explained everything.
“You guys continue, I’ll go take a look.”
Mo Jianghe waved his hand at everyone, then stood up and left the room.
The door behind him closed again.
Cheng Jingguo’s voice trembled slightly.
“It’s a dimensional rift... could it be...”
He absolutely did not believe that a player who had just mastered the basic sealing technique could open a dimensional rift in the real world!
Not to mention him, only a few of the veteran players who had studied the sealing technique for decades could open a dimensional rift, and the success rate could not even be guaranteed.
Fang Heng?!
A newbie who was still in the elementary game.
He could do it?
But...
Everything was too coincidental.
A few hours ago, he was still asking him about the sealing technique, and a few hours later...
They all matched up.
Who else could it be besides him?
Cheng Jingguo had lived for most of his life, but he had never felt like he had lost his composure like this.
It was as if he had seen a ghost.
It was not shock, but terror!
“In theory, even a Level 1 sealing technique can open a dimensional rift.”
Mo Jianghe was calm.
Even though he was also very confused.
He had personally verified it yesterday.
He was very sure that this was Fang Heng’s first time coming into contact with a sealing technique.
Moreover, Fang Heng’s sealing technique talent was simply weak.
In theory, only extremely rare and valuable items in the advanced game could slightly increase one’s talent.
There was no reason that he could open a dimensional spatial rift in a day’s time.
As Mo Jianghe spoke, he turned to look at Cheng Jingguo. “You’ll know once you go take a look. In short, no matter what you see, don’t mention today’s matter to anyone.”
“Yes, I understand.”
In the room, Fang Heng instantly opened his eyes.
A rift appeared in the space in front of Fang Heng.
A pale purple rift.
It was an extremely tiny rift, like a crack in the glass.
It was about 10 centimeters long and less than 0.3 centimeters wide.
Purple light constantly seeped out from the rift.
A powerful tearing force leaked out from the rift!
Apart from Fang Heng himself, almost all the items in the room were affected by the tearing force and were pulled to the side of the rift.
Tables, chairs, tea sets, futons, all sorts of casting materials...
They were all pulled and floated around the rift. They twisted and overlapped one another, forming a strange distortion.
It was not them that were distorted, but space.
Fang Heng stared at the dimensional rift in front of him.
Maintaining this extremely small rift required almost all of his mental strength!
It was unknown when it started, but sweat kept flowing down Fang Heng’s face.
Fang Heng felt that he could control this rift, and even the items around the rift.
Only sealed cards could pass through the dimensional spatial rift.
Fang Heng slowly raised his hand forward, aiming at the purple spatial rift.
Just raising his hand, Fang Heng felt that he had used up almost all of his strength.
“I can’t hold on any longer!”
His mental strength was almost exhausted, and his head was swelling so much that Fang Heng could barely hold on any longer.
Finally, Fang Heng raised his hand and aimed at the spatial rift, shouting softly, “Withdraw!”
“Chi!”
In an instant, the dimensional rift released an extremely powerful tearing force!
Along with the powerful tearing force, everything that was suspended around the dimensional rift was sucked into it.
“Pu!”
A muffled sound.
The rift instantly disappeared.
Tables, chairs, tea sets...
Everything that was sucked into the rift also disappeared.
In the next moment.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted!
He seemed to have expected what was about to happen and hurriedly raised his hands to block his face.
“Bang!”
In the space, the point where the spatial rift had disappeared exploded out of thin air!
At the same time, a powerful repulsive force bounced out from the point in the space.
Tables, chairs, casting materials, and everything else that had just been sucked into the spatial rift were repelled by the spatial rift and bounced out in all directions from the exploded space.
“Bang! Bang! Dong Dong!”
Miscellaneous items were sent flying one after another, crashing into the wall of the room, and then falling to the ground.
The room was a mess.
“Phew!!!”
Fang Heng put down his hand and let out a loud breath.
Too d*mn tired!
Fang Heng simply lay flat on the ground, breathing heavily.
Constructing a dimensional rift was like staying up all night to play more than forty disappearing games!
It was clearly stated in the information flow that the activation of the dimensional rift was simple, but it was actually so troublesome in reality.
“No! I can’t sleep now!”
“There are still more than 10 hours left, I need to continue fighting.”
Fang Heng struggled to turn over on the ground.
The good news was that the verification was successful, at least he was sure that he could open the dimensional rift.
Moreover, apart from the three special materials needed to open the dimensional rift, most of the other games had them.

In theory, he only needed to take six hours to bring the special materials into the game in three sessions. At that time, he would be able to open the rift in the game and completely seal Hila’s tissue samples!

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - Seal Completed
paragraphs: “I won’t waste any more time!”
With this thought, Fang Heng lay on the ground and casually grabbed a rare material on the ground. He stuffed it into his space-time jump backpack and closed his eyes on the spot.

A magic array appeared below Fang Heng’s body. Countless greenish-black tentacles stretched out from the magic array and pulled Fang Heng firmly into the magic array. After a while, the magic array dispersed and Fang Heng disappeared.
A minute and a half later, Mo Jianghe and Cheng Jingguo stepped into the room together.
Cheng Jingguo looked around the room and his expression changed slightly.
Obviously, the traces and aura left in the room had explained everything.
Someone had opened a dimensional rift here!
But...
Where was he?
Cheng Jingguo couldn’t help but look at Mo Jianghe from the side. “Mr. Mo, this...”
Pang Feilong also rushed over at this time.
“Mr. Mo, Teacher Cheng, you were looking for me?”
Cheng Jingguo couldn’t help but ask first, “Teacher Pang, who booked this room?”
“Oh, it’s Fang Heng. He came around dinner time and asked me for an empty room, as well as a lot of rare materials.”
Although he had already confirmed the answer in his heart, now that he had received Pang Feilong’s final confirmation, Cheng Jingguo still felt surreal.
“This...”
Cheng Jingguo turned to look at Mo Jianghe. “Then where is Fang Heng? Why did he disappear? Did he lose control?”
“No, if he lost control, his aura will definitely be much more violent than now.”
Mo Jianghe felt a little strange as well. He shook his head and nodded at Pang Feilong. “Teacher Pang, there’s nothing much. I’m just making sure. You can go back to work
first.”
“Okay, I’ll go first.”
After Pang Feilong left, Mo Jianghe walked into the room and carefully checked the situation inside.
Cheng Jingguo still couldn’t understand. “Mr. Mo, Can Fang Heng really do it?” “Theoretically, yes. This requires an extremely powerful sealing technique talent.”
As Mo Jianghe spoke, he carefully observed the messy room.
He noticed some special traces.
“Cheng Jingguo, today’s matter must be kept a secret from the public.”
Cheng Jingguo rarely saw Mo Jianghe show such a serious expression. He nodded and said, “Yes, okay.”
“Hahaha!” Mo Jianghe laughed and patted Cheng Jingguo’s shoulder. “Don’t be so nervous. Since we’re already out, let’s go and continue drinking. We didn’t have a good time just now.”
(Hint: Player has obtained the tissue sample of Hila for the first time*5. Player has obtained the main storyline contribution points*10,000.)

“Including the initial tissue sample, the two that we found together, and the four tissue samples of Hila that the Dark Knights have collected, we now have a total of seven tissue samples of Hila. There are only five left.”

Lucia handed the special boxes collected by the Dark Knights to Fang Heng and asked, “Fang Heng, the coordinates of the next nearest hiding place of Hila’s tissue is in the southern region. Are we going to go there now?”
Fang Heng opened the map and looked at it.
The hiding places of the 12 boxes were precisely marked by Tang Bai.
The last two boxes were extremely remote.
Even with the help of the Dark Knights’ nearest teleportation point, it would still take him half a day just to go there and back.
He needed to spend some time completing the seal, and it seemed that he would need the help of the Federation to find the boxes.
After all, the Federation had been working very hard for the main storyline mission during this period of time. He needed to give them a chance to show off.
If everything went smoothly, he estimated that he would be able to gather all 12 tissue samples of Hila tomorrow afternoon.
“We won’t be going over personally. I still have to think of a way to completely seal the tissue samples of Hila.”
Fang Heng pondered for a moment before looking at Mo Jiawei. “Old Mr. Mo, what’s the situation on the Federation’s side?”
“They said that they’ve already found three samples, but they encountered some trouble on the way back. It’ll probably take some time.”
“However, Tang Bai has already sensed that three samples of Hila’s tissue have already gathered together half an hour ago. The Federation is playing tricks with us again.”

Mo Jiawei revealed a disdainful expression and said, “They even thought that they were smart enough to teleport the tissue samples, thinking that by doing so, we wouldn’t be able to find the samples.”

“Heh.” Fang Heng chuckled, “Alright, then we still have to continue playing dumb. Tell them the location of the last two Hila’s tissue samples and ask them for more materials. You go and communicate with them. Act like it and don’t screw it up.”
“No problem. Leave it to me. I guarantee that it will be done properly.”
Mo Jiawei made an ‘OK’ gesture to Fang Heng as he thought of something else.

“Oh right, God, the Federation has also started to purchase ladybugs. Right now, a lot of people are choosing to sell their captured ladybugs to the Federation. Should we increase the price?” “Ha? Federation? Ladybugs...”
Hearing this, Fang Heng immediately felt a little baffled.
He was collecting ladybugs to obtain a sealing technique level, and the Federation was also buying ladybugs?
Could it be that the Federation was also farming?
Most likely not.
Fang Heng pondered for a moment and asked tentatively, “Why don’t we secretly sell ladybugs to the Federation later?”
“Uh, okay...”
Mo Jiawei nodded his head silently.
When he heard that the Federation was buying ladybugs, he felt that something was wrong.
Now, he heard that Fang Heng was going to sell them...
Mo Jiawei decided to give up on this.
He felt that the game between God and the Federation was too challenging, so it was normal that he didn’t understand.
After discussing with Mo Jiawei, Fang Heng brought Lucia and Mo Jiawei back to the basement of the prison.

Seeing that he had more than half of the tissue samples, Fang Heng was prepared to seal some of them first. It would be a wild ride say if all the tissue samples of Hila gathered together and triggered some special plot that would directly revive Hila.
“A total of seven tissue samples of Hila.”
Lucia stood beside Fang Heng and carefully protected him.
“Okay.”
Fang Heng nodded and cleared out an empty space in the center of the studio. He signaled a few zombies to take the sealing materials and surround Hila’s tissue samples.
The zombie clones began to seal the tissue samples of Hila.
The good news was that although the tissue samples of Hila had a strong vitality, they didn’t have independent consciousness.
This writhing piece of flesh doesn’t move or fight back.
(Hint: Your zombie clone failed to seal.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone failed to seal.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone failed to seal...]
A string of messages about the failure of the seal came out.
Hila’s tissue strength was much stronger than Fang Heng expected.
Two minutes later, after two pages of the game log, the flesh on the ground finally lit up with a faint light.
A line of small words appeared in front of Fang Heng’s eyes.
(Hint: Your zombie clone has completed the seal. Through the occult ritual, your sealing talent +0.008!]
The success rate was very low, only about 1%.
Fang Heng reached out his hand and took the card after the seal was completed.
[Item: Sealed tissue sample of Hila.)
Description: A high-strength unknown life form is sealed on this piece of card.
Description: The sealed life form has high strength. This card is a special item. It cannot be put into a backpack or pass through the spatial rift.

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - Expulsion
paragraphs: Fang Heng quickly glanced at the card’s description.
Fortunately, there was no such thing as ‘unable to be thrown into the dimensional rift’.
Next, he would open the dimensional spatial rift, throw it into the rift, and complete the mission!
Fang Heng took a deep breath and tried to calm his mind down completely.
But before he could take out the casting materials he had prepared beforehand, he heard a ‘bang’.
The card exploded.
(Hint: Your seal has failed.]
Hila’s tissue sample also fell to the ground with a thud.
Fang Heng was stunned for a moment.
“D*mn it!”
Fang Heng cursed softly.
He realized that he had encountered a big problem.
According to his previous experience, living creatures could only maintain their sealed state for at most three minutes after completing the seal.
Only three minutes!
This was not enough for him to complete the opening of the alternate dimension spatial rift!
He needed to be fully focused when constructing the spatial rift. He could not control the zombie clone to seal and at the same time, open the spatial rift.
Fang Heng scratched his head.
Lucia stood by the side. She saw Fang Heng’s distressed look and stepped forward to volunteer, “Fang Heng, are you in trouble? Can I help?”
“Hmm... let me think about it.”
Fang Heng thought for a moment. Lucia could indeed control a zombie clone.
However, asking her to help was too dangerous.
Even he was cautious when controlling the dimensional rift. If he was not careful, Lucia might be dragged into the dimensional rift as well...
Unlike non-living beings, once a life form was dragged into the dimensional rift, it would most likely die.
Fang Heng did not want to take this risk unless it was absolutely necessary.

“Lucia, I’ve encountered a problem.” Fang Heng tried to describe the problem, “The duration of the seal is too short, and the spatial rift needs a period of time to open. I can’t split my attention to create the seal and open the spatial rift at the same time.”
“Then...”
Lucia did not quite understand either. She suggested, “Can’t we let someone else do the
seal?”
Fang Heng thought to himself that it was impossible to ask for help now. Although Mo Jiawei’s luck was heaven-defying, he didn’t know how long it would take for him to reach Level 10.
It was also impossible to find someone from the outside to come to District 8.
Currently, District 8 was still under newbie protection. Players from the high-level game world couldn’t enter, and only players who had transferred servers could enter.
However, once they completed the game world, the player’s skill level would all be reset to zero.
At that time, it would be a blank slate. Even if they came, they would not be able to help.
“Then, can we extend the sealing time? For example, try to seal it multiple times?”
“That won’t do either. The skill level has already reached the upper limit. The longest sealing time is estimated to be three minutes. There’s no way to extend it...”
As Fang Heng spoke, he suddenly thought of something, and his eyes lit up!
That’s right! There’s such a move!
In his excitement, Fang Heng hugged Lucia, “Lucia, you’ve helped a lot. You’re really a genius!”
This was the first time that Fang Heng had taken the initiative to hug Lucia. Lucia felt her body go soft, and she let out a soft grunt.
“Fang Heng, I...”
Russian nesting doll!!
These three words appeared in Fang Heng’s mind.
In theory, ordinary players couldn’t extend the seal by a small number of times.
But he was different. He had a large zombie team, and it was enough to complete this move!
Fang Heng let go of Lucia, turned around, and stared at the zombie team with a burning gaze.
If one level didn’t work, then two levels!
If two levels didn’t work, then three levels!!
Fang Heng immediately gave the order to the zombie team.
More than twenty zombie clones crowded together and stuck the completed rune to the tissue sample of Hila.
(Hint: Your zombie clone has failed to seal.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone has failed to seal.]
(Hint: Your zombie clone has completed the seal of the unknown tissue sample! Through the occult ritual, your sealing talent +0.008.]
It’s here!
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat!
Different from before, the second batch of zombies didn’t stop. They walked toward the piece of card left behind after the seal was completed and sealed it again!
(Hint: Your zombie clone has failed to seal...]
(Hint: Your zombie clone has completed the seal of the unknown tissue sample! Through the occult ritual, your sealing talent +0.006.]
It worked!
This method worked!
Fang Heng was ecstatic. He asked the zombies to continue sealing the tissue sample after they had completed two rounds.

Only three minutes!

He needed to be fully focused when constructing the spatial rift.

Fang Heng scratched his head.
Lucia stood by the side.
She saw Fang Heng’s distressed look and stepped forward to volunteer, “Fang Heng, are you in trouble?
Can I help?”
“Hmm... let me think about it.”
Fang Heng thought for a moment.
Lucia could indeed control a zombie clone.
However, asking her to help was too dangerous.
Even he was cautious when controlling the dimensional rift.
If he was not careful, Lucia might be dragged into the dimensional rift as well...
Unlike non-living beings, once a life form was dragged into the dimensional rift, it would most likely die.
Fang Heng did not want to take this risk unless it was absolutely necessary.
“Lucia, I’ve encountered a problem.” Fang Heng tried to describe the problem, “The duration of the seal is too short, and the spatial rift needs a period of time to open.
I can’t split my attention to create the seal and open the spatial rift at the same time.”
“Then...”
Lucia did not quite understand either.
She suggested, “Can’t we let someone else do the
seal?”

Although Mo Jiawei’s luck was heaven-defying, he didn’t know how long it would take for him to reach Level 10.
It was also impossible to find someone from the outside to come to District 8.
Currently, District 8 was still under newbie protection.
Players from the high-level game world couldn’t enter, and only players who had transferred servers could enter.
However, once they completed the game world, the player’s skill level would all be reset to zero.
At that time, it would be a blank slate.
Even if they came, they would not be able to help.
“Then, can we extend the sealing time?

He had a large zombie team, and it was enough to complete this move!
